articleTitle: Cooling, Heating and Electric Load Forecasting for Integrated Energy Systems Based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As “carbon peak and carbon neutrality” have become an important strategic goal of my country's “14th Five-Year Plan”, it is particularly important to accelerate the adjustment and optimization of the energy structure. Forecasting cooling heating and power load of integrated energy system can effectively improve energy utilization efficiency. Aiming at the problem of low prediction accuracy about a single load forecasting method, this paper proposes that a short-term cooling, heating and electric load forecasting method base on CNN-LSTM(Convolution Neural Network-Long Short Term Memory). First, the Pearson correlation coefficient method is used to analyze the correlation between cooling load, heating load and electric load. Then the Z-Score standardization method is used to standardize the data. The standardized data input into a single CNN(Convolution Neural Network) model, a single LSTM(Long Short Term Memory) model, and a CNN-LSTM combined model for cooling heating and electrical load prediction. The results show that CNN-LSTM model has a higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Advanced Optimal Design of the IoT Based University Campus Microgrid Considering Environmental Concerns and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Rising energy prices and depletion of fossil fuel seriously affect the comfort of energy consumers. The integration of renewable energy resources with the legacy system is a striking solution to mitigate such problems, especially for developing countries. For this purpose, an IoT based university campus is taken as a case study, which comprised of dispatchable and non-dispatchable energy sources along with a battery bank. Different case studies have been carried out to the analytic assessment of the proposed system. The conventional campus can consume energy from the utility grid, while the prosumer microgrid can exchange the power with the utility grid considering the price-based demand response and environmeatal concern. For the analysis, advanced linear programming is used as a solution technique in MATLAB software. The obtained results using the demand response scheme reduced the energy cost by 20.5 % that shows the efficiency of the proposed model. Furthermore, the comparison with the existing work also shows the significance of the proposed linear campus model.

articleTitle: Short-term Photovoltaic Power Prediction of Bi-LSTM Based on MIC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation has certain volatility and randomness. In order to reduce the impact of photovoltaic power on the stable operation of power grid, this paper proposes a short-term Bi-LSTM photovoltaic power method based on MIC. Firstly, the correlation degree between the predicted PV power and meteorological factors was analyzed based on the maximum information coefficient (MIC), so as to screen the characteristics of high-dimensional meteorological data in the power grid. Then, the historical similar days were selected by the weighted sum of the maximum information coefficient. Finally, a bi-directional long neural network was built short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) was used to predict the short-term photovoltaic power. Case simulation shows that the proposed MIC-Bi- LSTM power prediction model has lower prediction bias and higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term Wind Power Forecasting Based on Improved LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate wind power prediction can reduce the negative impact of wind power on power grid and reduce the operation cost of power system. Wind power forecasting is of great significance in spot trading, but the instability of wind power series brings difficulties to forecasting. With the rapid development of deep learning technology, prediction algorithm based on deep learning has been widely used in wind power prediction. The long short-term memory (LSTM) network performs well in a variety of prediction scenarios, but there is still room for improvement. In order to improve the prediction accuracy of LSTM in wind power prediction, this paper adopts a new gating mechanism in LSTM network, which can improve the context information modeling ability of LSTM network. The experimental results based on real data show that the proposed improved LSTM prediction model can improve the prediction accuracy of LSTM prediction model in ultra-short term wind power prediction scenarios.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Four-Wire LCL Filter Active Damping Control Based on Common Mode Capacitor Current Feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: LCL filters active damping methods of the three phase three-wire (3P3W) grid-connected inverter have been extensively studied, but no study has been done for the active damping control of the three-phase four-wire (3P4W) LCL filters. In this paper, the differential mode (DM) and common mode (CM) models of the 3P4W LCL filter are decoupled, and it is shown that a separate active damping control is needed for the CM circuits besides the DM circuits. The active damping of the CM circuit of LCL filter is realized by the proposed CM capacitor current proportional feedback. The proposed CM active damping control also features the new deterministic design method to obtain the proportional coefficient in one step, so that the maximum damping ratio is obtained. Finally, the proposed method is validated by simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting: Based on Hybrid CNN-LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate load forecasting greatly impacts how energy suppliers plan for real power generation, distribution, system maintenance, and electricity pricing in their operations centers. Owing to the non-linearity in most time-series datasets developing a single linear or nonlinear model is insufficient for predicting and forecasting load power consumption. This study constructs a hybrid forecasting model that combines conventional neural network (CNN) with long short-term memory network (LSTM) for short-term forecasting of time series to exploit the upper performance of a hybrid model on load forecasting over an individual LSTM model. The suggested architecture addresses both linear and nonlinear patterns in the actual dataset, allowing it to extract more precise features to better forecast power consumption. The suggested models rely on merging two deep learning architectures in a hybrid model to forecast more precisely the load consumption of a household-based in Morocco. Hence, the originality of this work resides in predicting load consumption over different time intervals by utilizing the record measurements from various former weeks. Thus, using records from the past two weeks resulted in highly accurate predictions for the one 1 day ahead and 5 days ahead of time windows with MAE of 5.48 and 6.51 respectively. However, the last three weeks' data was more valuable for the LSTM model resulting in more efficient predictions when compared to CNN-LSTM with an MAE of 6.69 and 8.45 respectively for the three days ahead of the time window and 7.59 and 8.84 for the five days ahead. The empirical results show that the proposed model adequately learns the load consumption patterns of the household and accurately predicts the short-term power consumption.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Data-Driven Machine Learning Approach for Fault Detection of Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Wind farms have received much attention in recent years due to the ever-increasing demand for clean and renewable energy. In order to effectively meet that demand, wind farms' operation and maintenance abilities must be optimized, and therefore, condition-based maintenance plays an important role. Compared with professional condition monitoring systems, supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems offer an inexpensive technology that enables wind farm operators to monitor wind turbines' health condition. However, the SCADA dataset is often unlabeled, and therefore, how to effectively detect faults without any prior knowledge is a major concern. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an innovative method based on machine learning. The proposed method is validated on real operational wind turbine data. The obtained results indicate the effectiveness and impact of the method when applied in realworld application.

articleTitle: Research Progress of Distribution Network Digitization Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Digital twin technology plays an important role in the process of digital distribution network. By means of digital twin and situation awareness, the data flow of distribution network can be fully utilized so as to promote the development of new forms of virtual and real combination and twin interactive distribution network. Focusing on the characteristics of the above-mentioned digital twin and combining the characteristics of the distribution network, the key technology of the digital twin system of the distribution network is proposed, and several applications of the digital twin in the distribution network are discussed. Finally, its development is prospected. The future digital twin technology will enable the distribution network system and other links of the power system to develop in the direction of digitization, networking, intelligence, and transparency.

articleTitle: Research on Output Voltage Stabilization of LLC Resonant Converter Based on LADRC with Simplified Linear Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: LLC resonant converter has gained popularity in a wide number of industrial applications due to its high efficiency and power density. However, disturbances such as input voltage fluctuations and parameter perturbations make the control of output voltage still a challenging problem. In order to reject the influence of disturbances on the stability of the output voltage, the linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) method is proposed in this paper. First, based on the equivalent circuit method, the analytical expression for control to output voltage is obtained and compared with the second-order transfer function obtained by the swept frequency method in the frequency domain. The second-order model that does not change the characteristics of the LLC resonant converter is used for analysis and design of the controller. Then, the linear extended observer (LESO) is designed to estimate the value of state variables and total disturbance. Finally, the simulation results demonstrated that LADRC can effectively control the stability of the output voltage compared with PI controller.

articleTitle: Design Method of Totem-Pole PFC and CLLC Resonant Converter Based on SiC MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: SiC power semiconductor devices are becoming increasingly popular due to their excellent performance. Based on the advantages of SiC, this paper demonstrates the design method of a two-stage converter for plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs). It features in the implementation with full SiC device, including MOSFET and Diode. The converter is composed of the bridgeless totem-pole power factor correction (PFC) and the CLLC resonant converter. For the dynamic performance of the SiC devices, a double pulse test (DPT) is taken and an optimized gate driver of SiC is demonstrated. Then, the design method for a 6.6kW totempole PFC and the CLLC resonant converter is presented. Finally, the experimental results with electric vehicles (EVs) charging validate the feasibility of the proposed design method.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Optimization of Active Distribution Networks Based on Multi-Port SOP Integrated Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, with the increased penetration of distributed power sources such as photovoltaic and wind turbines in the distribution network, the uncertainty of their power output has brought lots of challenges to the stable operation of the distribution network. Derived from the background analyzed above, soft open points (SOPs) are new intelligent power distribution devices. The appearance of the SOP integrated energy storage system has improved the SOP utilization ratio, reduced the system construction investment and operation cost greatly. The SOP capability to deal with transient disturbances and improve system power flow distribution has also been enhanced. Consequently, to minimize the voltage deviation and active power loss, a power flow optimization model of multi-port SOP integrated energy storage system for active distribution networks (ADNs) is established. Then multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) algorithm and compromise optimal algorithm are used to solve the above multi-objective problems. Finally, the power flow optimization effects of the modified IEEE 33-node network with different port numbers of SOPs integrated energy storage system are compared and analyzed.

Author Keywords: multi-port SOP integrated energy storage system

articleTitle: Data-based Reinforcement Learning with Application to Wind Turbine Pitch Control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel data-based reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed for the the discrete time-delay system. First, the state, time delay and control input of the controlled system are used to construct an augmented vector, so as to construct an augmented time-delay system. Next, based on the augmented time-delay system, a new augmented Bellman equation is designed. Then, a Data-based reinforcement learning algorithm with delay is designed and applied to the variable pitch control of wind turbine, simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Equilibrium Analysis on Deep Peak Regulation Market Considering the Participation of Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Virtual power plant could effectively regulate the internal distributed energy, and could be used as an emerging peak regulation resource to cope with the increasing penetration rate of renewable energy. The participation of virtual power plants in the deep peak regulation market would affect the competition result. Firstly, the cost of each market entity participating in the deep peak regulation market is analyzed, and the corresponding deep peak regulation market bidding model on this basis is established. Then, based on the Nash equilibrium theory, an equilibrium model of deep peak regulation market is established. Finally, the nonlinear complementary method is applied to solve the equilibrium model, and the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed model are verified through typical case analysis. The effectiveness of above-mentioned model and method is validated by the analysis on given example, and it is shown that the virtual power plant could reduce the market clearing price and the corresponding payment cost of peak regulation service buyers. Besides, the peak regulation pressure of thermal power units could be reduced.

articleTitle: A Novel Source-grid-load-storage Coordinated Power System Expansion Planning Model: A Case Study on China's Power system Transition
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Since power sector will play a crucial role in energy transition, it is necessary to have a reasonable power system planning model that can figure out the optimal development pathway from the perspective of the whole system. Traditionally, power systems consist of three part, generation source, transmission grid and load demand. In the future, energy storage will also become an indispensable part in power systems, since more flexibility is required to render the systems optimal operation with high penetration of variable energy resources. This paper proposes a novel source-grid-load-storage coordinated power system planning model, in which all the resources in power source side, grid side, load side and storage side are considered simultaneously. All the relations among them are reflected in the mathematical formulas in the model. Based on this model, a case study is carried out on China's national power system. The optimal development pathway of various power sources, interregional grids, load side resources and energy storages till 2050 is worked out, which may be referable for China's power sector transition.

articleTitle: Early Fault Detection of Wind Turbine Gearbox Based on Adam-trained LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The gearbox is an important device in the wind power generation process. An early fault detection of the gearbox can identify the current status and discover the abnormal operation in advance, thereby providing enough time to take risk mitigation measures. This paper proposes an early fault detection strategy of the gearbox oil temperature in the wind turbine gearbox based on the adaptive momentum (Adam) optimized long short-term memory (LSTM) network. First, feature variables closely related to the gearbox oil temperature are selected to construct the model inputs; Then the data under normal operating conditions are used to develop the LSTM model trained with the Adam algorithm. Residual errors are processed by a sliding window and T-distribution to determine the alarm threshold and achieve the fault detection. The proposed method is verified with field data of a wind farm in Inner Mongolia, and the results show that the method can detect oil high temperature fault nearly one hour in advance, which can provide sufficient time to make a maintenance.

articleTitle: A Study for Stable Operation of Battery Loaded DC Bus Based on Autonomous Cooperative Control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: We study about autonomous cooperative control of DC buses with distributed batteries, power generation units and power loading units. The distributed batteries are used to maintain the electric inertia force of the DC bus. On this basis, we use MATLAB/Simulink to build an analytical model of DC buses based on autonomous distributed cooperative control and analyze the stability and tolerance of operation of the system dynamics.

articleTitle: Effects on Thermal Aging and UV-A Aging on Dielectric Performance of High Temperature Vulcanized Silicone Rubber
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High temperature vulcanized silicone rubber (HTV-SIR) was aged at 200 °C and under UV-A radiation. The dielectric parameters increased more after thermal aging than that after UV-A aging in 0.4-1.8 THz. Results of Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy showed that the side chains of HTV-SIR cracked after thermal aging. The content of Si-O increased slightly, indicating the cross-linking degree increased. After UV-A aging, the side chains and main chains of HTV-SIR were broken, and the cross-linking degree decreased. Besides, the cross-section morphology showed that the number of nanoparticles in HTV-SIR increased after UV-A aging. Moreover, DSC results showed that the “thawing” endothermic of HTV-SIR increased from −45 to −40°C after thermal aging, but that of UV-A aging samples decreased. After thermal aging, the dielectric parameters in terahertz frequency domain increased with the increase of molecular gap, the increase of density and electron polarization due to the invasion of oxygen, and the fracture of molecular bond. After UV-A aging, the molecular chain became shorter, the molecular gap became smaller and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> precipitated, which made the increase of polarization less than that of thermal aging, so the improvement of dielectric parameters was less than that of thermal aging.

articleTitle: An Investigation into the Effect of Bearing Grease Degradation on the High-frequency $dv/dt$ Bearing Current in an Inverter-fed Motor System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Bearing is one of the key components in an inverter-fed motor system, whose lubrication performance is important for the safety and reliability of system. In this paper, from the perspective of bearing grease condition monitoring, the high-frequency (HF) <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$dv/dt$</tex> bearing current generated by the inverter PWM switching is studied. First, the generation mechanisms and circulating paths of bearing current are analyzed, where the PWM switching <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$dv/dt$</tex> bearing current is sensitive to the condition of bearing. Then, the common-mode equivalent circuit of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$dv/dt$</tex> bearing current is derived. Finally, simulation and experimental studies are carried out to investigate the impact of bearing grease degradation on the HF bearing current. Research results show that the deterioration of bearing grease will cause significant change in the amplitude of the HF bearing current, which could be utilized as a feature for bearing health condition monitoring.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Strategy for EV Cluster Based on Vehicle to Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the current user car randomness in the participation of electric vehicles in the dispatching interactive plan and the user's participation in the V2G dispatching plan, under the condition of optimal electricity prices, an electric vehicle index evaluation system is established to achieve reasonable and orderly dispatching of electric vehicle clusters. By analyzing the impact of the various information of the electric vehicle declared by the user on the dispatching plan of the agent, the dispatching capacity of the electric vehicle, the credit of the user and the participation of the user are used as the evaluation index, and the system evaluation index model of the electric vehicle cluster is established. The optimized combination weighting method of accelerated genetic algorithm determines the weight of each index, so as to obtain the dispatch sequence of each electric vehicle in the cluster, and further determines the schedulable capacity of each agent in each period according to the requirements of the power system dispatch plan. Numerical example simulation shows that the proposed strategy can effectively dispatch electric vehicles to participate in the dispatch plan by comprehensively considering the influence of multiple indicators.

articleTitle: Research on Appearance Defect Detection of Power Equipment Based on Improved Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Detecting appearance defect is an important part of patrol inspection in power plants. Because of the changeable angle, mixed background and blurred target of the pictures, traditional Faster-Region based Convolutional Neural Network (Faster-RCNN) has shortcomings such as low accuracy and long training time. This paper improves Faster-RCNN in the aspect of network structure. On the one hand, fuse multi-layer convolution feature maps to improve its resolution. On the other hand, add weights to RPN (regional proposed networks) of different scales to obtain more accurate proposed regions. The test results of experimental dataset show that compared with Fast-RCNN, traditional Faster-RCNN and YOLO(V3) algorithms, the proposed Faster-RCNN can maintain high recognition accuracy and speed under images with different resolutions and angles in power inspection, has a certain practical value.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation Method for Microgrid System Capacity with Electrical Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal allocation method for microgrid (MG) system with electrical vehicles (EVs) aiming at minimum cost. The proposed MG system consists of a residential MG and an industrial MG, each includes wind turbines, photovoltaic (PV) arrays and EVs. The EVs not only can meet the requirements of commuting, but also can serve the grid as a mobile storage, which can store the energy from grid during low price period and sell power to grid at high price stage. An improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm is proposed to optimal allocate the capacity of wind turbines, PVs and EVs, reducing the MG cost and EVs expense. Finally, a simulation model is built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Calculation of Ground Potential Rise of Electric Vehicle Charging Station Struck by Lightning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The charging station is a place where electric vehicles are charged, and its construction and maintenance costs are very high, which makes the safety of the charging station particularly important. Lightening protection of charging station is an important safety measure. This paper takes a medium-sized charging station as the object to study and solve the change of ground potential of electric vehicle charging station when it is struck by lightening. The CDEGS software is used to model the charging station to simulate the rise of the ground grid potential under different soil resistivity, lightning location and grounding grid structure, and to analyze the influence of various factors. Finally, some feasible measures are put forward according to the actual situation of the site.

articleTitle: HVAC Load Forecasting in Office Buildings Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate short-term load forecasting can be used to optimize the control and operation of the heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems for energy conservation. Deep learning is becoming increasingly popular in load forecasting due to its excellent capacity to handle non-linear problems. In this study, a load forecasting model using long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network based on wavelet analysis is developed. This algorithm combines the ability of LSTM to capture time series characteristics and the ability of wavelet analysis to optimize data samples. The performance of the proposed method is compared with LSTM and back propagation neural network. The implementation of the proposed method in an office building shows that the model can realize the load forecast accurately with root mean squared errors of less than 124.7kW and the coefficient of variance of the root mean square errors (CVRMSE) of less than 24.4%. The CVRMSE of the proposed model is improved by 2.5% and 1.8% in summer and 2.3% and 0.3% in winter respectively, compared with back propagation neural network and traditional LSTM neural network.

articleTitle: Single Bus Data-driven Power Estimation Based on Modified Linear Power Flow Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The power flow model is usually used to estimate power from the central calculation for the whole power system. In recent years, data-driven approach is an emerging technique to determine power flow without knowing circuit parameters. However, with the development of renewable energy, more complex power grids are placing an increasing burden on central computing. Therefore, this paper proposes a method to estimate power from a single bus only which provides a quick reference to the power of a single bus. This method is based on modified linear power flow model, the core is to solve the challenge of power estimation using only one single bus data rather than whole power system data by analyzing the electrical relationship. The proposed modified linear power flow model includes both the nonlinear physical power flow model and the linear regression model. Simulation results on the IEEE Standard bus 30 show that this method has higher accuracy than other linear power flow models in single bus power calculation.

articleTitle: Assessment of Offshore Wind Characteristics and Wind Energy Potential: A Case Study for South Coastal Region of China
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Offshore wind energy, as one of the best potential renewable energy sources, has been extensively developed worldwide. However, due to strong regional and seasonal differences, it is necessary to first evaluate offshore wind energy resources in details. In this study, based on an original set of wind recording data obtained from wind measurement tower in south coastal region of China, a comprehensive evaluation for offshore wind characteristics and wind potential in this region is presented. Weibull distribution is utilized to fit offshore wind speed data. Furthermore, variations of mean wind speed, distribution parameters and wind power density are studied through annual, seasonal, monthly and hourly time scales. Results of this study can be used as a certain reference value for power system research (such as probabilistic power flow, reliability evaluation) with large-scale offshore wind power integration.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of the Battery Energy Storage System for Wind Power Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Incorporating battery energy storage system (BESS) into a wind farm can mitigate wind power fluctuations as well as grid-side voltage variations, and the controllability of the wind farm can be improved accordingly. In this paper, a coordinated control strategy for the charge/discharge time (CDT) and the active and reactive power outputs of the BESS is proposed for a combined wind-storage system. First of all, a multi-mode reactive power control scheme is proposed to regulate the grid-side voltage, the reactive power output, and the power factor, considering the power converter system sizing limit. Then a coordinated control strategy for the BESS based on a variable filter time is proposed to satisfy both the active and reactive power control requirements, considering an optimal CDT for BESS efficiency improvement. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by actual data from a wind farm in eastern China.

articleTitle: Meteorological Boundary Analysis of Overhead Transmission Lines Carrying Capacity in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the monthly average maximum temperature of the hottest month in Zhejiang in the past 10 years, this paper concludes that the average maximum temperature of the hottest month in Zhejiang for many years is 36.2 °C, and 30% of the weather stations have a high average maximum temperature for the hottest month. At 35 °C. At present, Zhejiang Power Grid adopts 40 °C ambient temperature as the current-carrying capacity verification boundary condition. It is an operation strategy formulated to ensure the safety of the equipment under extreme conditions. It is reasonable, but the safety margin is slightly larger. Through the analysis of real meteorological data, we have grasped the spatial and temporal distribution of environmental temperature in the province, and based on this, revised the summer meteorological boundary conditions for the verification of the current carrying capacity of the overhead transmission lines of the Zhejiang main grid to “ambient temperature 36.5 °C, wind speed 0.5 m/s, sunshine 1000 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, irradiation coefficient 0.9, absorption coefficient 0.9”, which can increase the transmission capacity of the main grid line by 6%∼10%.

Author Keywords: average maximum temperature of the hottest month

articleTitle: Generalized State Space Modelling and Simulation Analysis of Interleaved Totem Pole PFC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Switching process of power electronic converter causes serious nonlinear problems, which can be analyzed by switching model, sampling data model, moving average model, small signal model as well as behavior model. The small signal model includes state space average model, energy balance average model and generalized state space average (GSSA) model. Through this mathematical modelling, the dynamic characteristics of power electronic converter can be characterized and simplified, and the approximate linearized system can be obtained. In this paper, in order to completely understand the operation principle of totem pole PFC, the second order approximate Fourier series is employed for GSSA modelling and simulation analysis by means of MATLAB/Simulink, and compared with switching model. It is found that the second order approximate Fourier series can more accurately characterize the dynamic characteristics of power electronic converter, including totem pole PFC.

articleTitle: A Novel Hammerstein Wind Power Forecasting Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel Hammerstein wind power forecasting model. For the wind power system with strong nonlinear characteristics, it combines the advantages of Hammerstein model and fuzzy neural network. Moreover, in the part of the proposed model parameter learning, a weight adjustment method based on Lyapunov's global convergence is proposed. The performance of the novel Hammerstein wind power forecasting model is assessed by contrast experiment, including the auxiliary model recursive least squares (AMRLS) Hammerstein wind power forecasting model and a multiple input single output fuzzy neural network wind forecasting model. Results show that the model is superior in prediction accuracy. So, the new model is beneficial to various applications of integrated energy and renewable energy, especially power scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Washing Cycle Optimization Model of Gas Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Compressor is one of key components of gas turbine. Its performance directly affects the benefit of the whole gas turbine generator set. From the perspective of safety and economy, principles that should be followed in the formulation of compressor washing cycle are proposed, and corresponding optimization model is concluded. The optimal water washing cycle of a gas turbine is calculated, and the mathematical relationship between compressor efficiency and combined cycle heat consumption rate is established through thermodynamic simulation, and the optimal water washing cycle and corresponding cost are obtained through the established optimization model. Finally, the effects of combined cycle load rate, gas price, compressor performance deterioration rate on the optimal washing cycle were quantitatively analyzed through mathematical calculations. The results show that above factors have great influence on the washing cost, and compressor performance deteriorates rate has the greatest influence on the optimal washing cycle.

articleTitle: Design of Grid Frequency Modulation Control System for Energy Storage Combined with Thermal Power
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increase in the proportion of new energy power generation in China, the pressure on the grid frequency adjustment that thermal power units need to bear is gradually increasing. Battery energy storage system is a good solution to participate in grid frequency modulation. Energy storage system combined with thermal power coordination system has the advantages of fast regulation speed, high regulation precision, short response time, bidirectional regulation, etc. This paper expounds the components of battery energy storage system, the working principle of battery energy storage system participating in power grid frequency regulation, the advantages of battery energy storage system assisting frequency regulation, and the control strategy of battery energy storage system participating in power grid, It provides a reference for the system design of energy storage thermal power joint frequency regulation project in the future.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Design of Electromagnetic Double-salient Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Double Salient Electromagnetic Motor (DSEM), credited with the advantages of simple structure, high power density, high reliability, flexible control and so on, is suitable for speed regulation occasions. However, the salient pole and slot structure contribute to high torque ripple and serious nonlinear magnetic field distribution. This paper presents the optimal design of the DSEM to obtain a low torque ripple and high electromagnetic torque. To reduce the torque ripple and enhance electromagnetic torque, design parameters such as air gap, rotor pole width, stator yoke thickness and height of rotor pole are selected as optimal variables. NSGA-II, as an optimization design tool is used on the design approach which performed on the DSEM. By means of the finite-element method, the electromagnetic performances of the DSEM are investigated, mainly including flux linkage, no-load electromotive force and electromagnetic torque. The simulation results verify the verifies of the multi-objective optimization design method of the double salient motor based on genetic algorithm, which enriches the way of rapid design and optimization of this kind of double salient motor.

articleTitle: Graph Spatio-Temporal Attention Network-based Electricity Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electricity demand forecasting is essential for improving the efficiency of power systems. Nevertheless, multi-step electricity demand forecasting is highly challenging due to the high volatility and uncertainty involved. In this paper, we investigate the spatio-temporal characteristics of electricity load and propose a Graph Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (GSTAN) to forecast multi-step electricity consumption of different users. We use the self-attention mechanism in temporal and spatial dimensions simultaneously, so that GSTAN can not only capture the temporal correlations but also the spatial correlations. Specifically, GSTAN adopts an encoder-decoder architecture, consisting of multiple spatio-temporal attention blocks to model the impact of the spatio-temporal correlations. First, we construct a spatial relationship graph based on the similarity of users' patterns to model spatial correlations. Second, we encode the spatio-temporal characteristics of users by using the decoder. Then the features generated by the encoder are transformed into the decoder by the transform attention layer, and the prediction sequence is finally output by the decoder. Experimental results on the realworld power consumption dataset demonstrate that our model performs better than state-of-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Field Study on Running Situation of an Industrial Integrated Energy System with Both Heat and Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Thanks to the natural feature of on-demand energy supply and cascade utilization, the integrated energy system can perfectly match the demand of the industrial enterprises with large and stable energy consumption. In this study, an existing integrated energy system installed in a medical device production enterprise located in Shanghai, China, is investigated and analyzed. According to the analysis results, during the statistical period, the integrated energy system based on gas-fired cogeneration system can provide about 30% of the total power consumption and 79% of the total thermal consumption. Relating to the system performance, during most of the operating periods, the power generation efficiency is over 40% and the heat recovery efficiency is more than 25%. Thus, the overall efficiency of the integrated energy system is about 65%, which illustrates a great potential for future improvement.

articleTitle: Research about Energy Optimization Management of Large-scale Charging Piles for Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The construction of virtual power plants with large-scale charging piles is essential to promote the development of the electric vehicle industry. In particular, the integration of renewable energy and energy storage into the electric vehicle charging infrastructure will help achieve the dual-carbon goal. Therefore, for virtual power plants, this paper considers the photovoltaic power generation consumption rate and energy storage state of charge; and analyzes its system structure and energy characteristics, and proposes a greedy-particle swarm optimization algorithm to achieve large-scale charging piles multi-scenario energy optimization management; The calculation example analysis shows that this method can effectively realize the reasonable energy distribution of the virtual power plant, improve the overall power consumption characteristics of the park, and reduce the peak power consumption of the grid.

articleTitle: Improved Quasi-Z Source Inverter for Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To further improve the performance of inverter in renewable energy power generation system, an improved Quasi-Z source inverter topology with double inputs and redundancy is designed in this paper. Through the analysis of the working principle of the inverter and the embodiment form of the redundancy ability, the operation performance parameters such as the boost ability and the device stress are deduced. The proposed inverter inherits all the advantages of SL-QZSI, but also has higher boost ability. Meanwhile, the inverter has certain redundancy in structure, the dual-input structure can save the converter cost and ensure the inverter to continue to run after power failure. The correctness of the theoretical analysis and the feasibility of the inverter are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Exploration of User Participation in Carbon Transaction Benefits in Electricity-Carbon Linkage
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of clean energy installed capacity, the problem of clean energy consumption is becoming increasingly prominent. Power users are also faced with low-carbon transformation in the process of power consumption. This paper establishes a user carbon trading model considering the optimal social benefits under the environment of electricity carbon linkage. According to the carbon emission reduction needs of power customers, the power customers are divided according to the electricity behavior and basic information, and the benefit model of large users and distributed users participating in carbon trading is established. In this paper, through the improvement of the existing direct power purchase trading mode, the feasible mode of large users and distributed users participating in carbon trading is added, and the benefits of carbon trading are calculated. In the simulation of the example, the high-power centralized charging station of electric vehicle is used to simulate the large users, and the low-power AC community charging pile is used to simulate the distributed users, The energy efficiency of carbon trading is calculated under the condition of electric energy substitution.

articleTitle: Power Equipment Segmentation of 3D Point Clouds Based on Geodesic Distance with K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the process of substation 3D modeling, it is necessary to cluster and segment the point cloud in order to extract effective points for 3D model reconstruction of power equipment. To solve wrong segmentation problem, this manuscript proposes an improved adaptive k-means clustering. Specifically, firstly, based on the position distribution of the point clouds, the points that are farther away are selected as the initial clustering centers. Then, to improve computational efficiency, the point closest to the original mean in the data set is selected as the centroid of the next iteration, making the segmentation results more representative. Finally, the geodesic distance are used instead of the Euclidean distance to measure the similarity between data points. Experimental results show that the method can be effective against segmentation of power devices.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Control Strategy of Point of Common Coupling of Microgrid with PV and Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of new energy, the microgrid formed by it has been widely used. In the grid-connected operation state, the change of the transmission power between the microgrid and the distribution grid will cause voltage fluctuation at the point of common coupling, and even voltage beyond the limitation in severe cases. Aiming at the problem of point of common coupling voltage fluctuation, this paper proposes a voltage control strategy based on the coordinated adjustment of active and reactive power to control the voltage. On this basis, a method for generating the compensation current of the grid-connected inverter is given to realize the microgrid sending as much active power as possible to the grid. Finally, a related simulation model is built on the MATLAB/Simulink to verify the correctness and reliability of the control strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: ADRC & MPC Based Control Strategy of Bidirectional Buck-Boost Converter in Distributed Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Distributed energy storage systems are gradually being applied on a large scale. In order to cope with the change in output and power flow of renewable energy, which can further improve anti-interference ability and robustness of bidirectional DC-DC converter, an optimal control strategy for bidirectional buck-boost converter is proposed. Among them, the current inner loop adopts a model predictive control method, which improves response speed and does not require parameter tuning. The voltage outer loop adopts a reduced-order control strategy based on active disturbance rejection control, which reduces the order of control object in high frequency band and reduces the complexity of controller. Simulation results verify that the method has characteristics of fast response, basically no overshoot in the adjustment process and small fluctuation range.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Inverter in High-performance Medium-frequency Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, research on control strategy of the inverter in high-performance medium-frequency power system is carried out and three-state quasi PWM current hysteresis control technique is proposed. The correctness and excellent performance of the control technique is verified by a prototype built in the lab.

articleTitle: Study on the Evolution Mechanism of Integrated Energy Systems in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the complementary of multi-energy, integrated energy systems can improve the energy efficiency and achieve emission reduction. This paper focuses on studying the evolution mechanism of integrated energy systems in park level and city level. We propose a four-stage evolution process to describe the mechanism of integrated energy systems. These four stages describe the evolution process from traditional energy systems to integrated energy systems, and final realize the source-network-load-storage collaborative interaction in large areas. We also propose the ‘top-bottom’ approach to existing functional areas and the ‘bottom-top’ approach to new planning areas for the construction of integrated energy systems. At last, we take Kashiwa-no-ha in Japan and Red Bean industrial park in China as two examples to show the effectiveness of the ‘top-bottom’ and ‘bottom-top’ implementation approaches in details.

articleTitle: Linear Extended State Observer Based Current Sensorless Control for DAB Converters to Improve Bus Voltage Transient Response
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the operation of DC microgrid, the switching of resistive load will cause disturbance-type fluctuations of DC bus voltage. When DAB converters are used to stabilize the DC bus voltage, the transient response of traditional PI control is relatively slow. The load current feedforward technology can effectively suppress the disturbance caused by resistive load switching and improve the bus voltage transient response, but it relies on expensive high-bandwidth isolated current sensors. Therefore, this paper proposes a current sensorless control method based on linear extended state observer, which regards the resistive load switching as a kind of external disturbance to estimate and perform the feedforward compensation. The method used has a better voltage transient response than PI control without using a current sensor.

articleTitle: Offshore Wind Power Prediction Based on Variational Mode Decomposition and Long Short Term Memory Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A method of offshore wind power prediction based on VMD and LSTM is proposed to improve the accuracy of offshore wind power prediction. For reducing the volatility of offshore wind power data to extract the salient features of the power signal, a variational modal decomposition algorithm optimized by the seagull algorithm is used to decompose the power series into several eigenmodal components and a residual component that may contain uncertainties affecting the power prediction; the decomposed several eigenmodal components are built into a prediction model based on the long and short-term memory network, and the residual component is built into a prediction model based on the extreme learning machine. The final offshore wind power is obtained by superimposing and integrating the prediction results of each component. It is shown that the combined model can predict both the slow fluctuation of offshore wind power and the drastic change of power in the climbing section compared with the single model and BP neural network.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Improved VSG in Distributed Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator control technology has become a hot spot of microgrid technology. However, when the virtual synchronous generator is disturbed, it is easy to produce oscillation and other problems. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved control strategy of virtual synchronous generator. It can make the frequency of the system produce smaller offset when the power grid fails, and restrain the power angle overshoot oscillation, so as to obtain better transient power angle response and make the system more stable. Finally, simulation experiments are carried out with Matlab / SIMLINK to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Characteristics of Dynamic Changes in Junction Temperature of Power Semiconductor Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As an important foundation of power electronic technology, power semiconductor devices are widely used in important fields such as new energy power generation, rail locomotive traction, electric vehicle driving, and aerospace. Whether power semiconductor devices can operate stably and reliably is a prerequisite to ensure the normal operation of these devices. In view of the fact that junction temperature fluctuation is an important factor affecting the reliability of power semiconductor devices, domestic and foreign scholars have proposed many junction temperature extraction methods based on thermally sensitive electrical parameters and thermal resistance network methods. However, these methods ignore the point at which the highest junction temperature of the device is generated. This paper takes boost circuit as an example to analyze the characteristics of power semiconductor device loss changing with time in PWM cycle, and further analyzes the junction temperature and loss during the turn-off period, and obtains the conclusion that the junction temperature is the highest at the end of the turn-off. Finally, simulation and experimental verification are carried out.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting of Power User Based on EWA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Precisely forecasting the load of power users is of great significance for power sales companies to reasonably declare power demand curves in spot transactions and to promote retail market reform under the electricity spot market model. Based on the actual power load data design model of a power sales company in Shandong, the exponential weighted average algorithm is used to predict the short-term load of the next 1-7 days through the analysis of the load data of the power users in the previous 60 days. For the user's 24-hour load time-sharing forecast, the average absolute percentage error of the load forecast value and the actual value is used to analyze the accuracy of the algorithm forecast. The experimental results show that the prediction error is within a relatively small range, which verifies the accuracy and effectiveness of the model, and provides a powerful aid for the retail power company's spot transaction decision-making.

articleTitle: Application of Adaptive Population Optimization Artificial Fish School Algorithm to the Identification of Induction Motor Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper introduces the selection operator, crossover operator and mutation operator of genetic algorithm into artificial fish school algorithm, and perform different operations on some artificial fish individuals respectively. The paper realizes the organic fusion of the two algorithms, and designs the step-length field of vision adjustment mechanism, and propose an optimized adaptive artificial fish school algorithm to the identification of induction motor parameters. The novel algorithm combines the advantages of the above two algorithms to improve the efficiency and accuracy of induction motor parameter identification. The algorithm was applied in the process of identifying load parameters of induction motors in an actual power system in a province in southeast China, and the results show that the algorithm has unique advantages in accelerating identification speed, improving identification accuracy and parameter stability.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Fault Type Identification based on Transfer Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the transferability of transmission line fault identification models, this paper divides transmission lines into source lines and target lines based on transfer learning theory, and proposes a method for identifying transmission line fault types based on deep-transfer learning. First, time series data during transmission line faults is generated by combining different fault conditions, and by preprocessing the data, obtained input data samples for the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Second, the initial convolutional neural network is pre-trained using the source data to obtain a pre-trained model of the source line fault type identification. Next, the maximum mean difference method is used to perform a similarity test on the source line and the target line to screen out the source pre-trained model to be migrated. Finally, the target data is used to fine-tune the transfer training to obtain the final target fault identification model. The simulation results show that using the target data of 5% of the source data to fine-tune the transfer training of the pre-trained model, the accuracy of the target model for the target line fault identification is more than 99%.

articleTitle: Development Outlook of Integrated Energy System in China
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As economical, efficient, green and intelligent new-generation energy systems, integrated energy system (IES) achieve greater energy efficiency through the coupling and complementation of multiple energy sources. IES aim to achieve clean and low-carbon development while meeting the myriad energy needs of users (e.g. electricity, gas, cooling, heating, hydrogen). IES represent the future development direction of energy systems. In this paper, development motivations, basic characteristics, evolution trends and the functions and value of IES in China are analyzed.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Abnormal Data Cleaning Based on Variance Change Point and Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of abnormal data cleaning in photovoltaic(PV) power generation systems, this paper considers the data variation characteristics in PV power data and its strong correlation with the irradiance data. The paper proposes an abnormal data cleaning method based on variance change points and correlation analysis. First, the abnormal data in the PV power time series is classified into single-point outliers and continuous outliers. Then the median absolute deviation(MAD) is used to detect the variance change point of the PV power data and the abnormal values are determined through correlation analysis. Further the linear regression model of PV power and irradiance is used to repair the abnormal values. Finally, the abnormal data cleaning method is tested on the PV power data from a real power station. The results show that this method can effectively clean the abnormal PV power data.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Heavy Duty Gas Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The modeling of heavy duty gas turbine is studied, and the whole model of GE 9FA type gas turbine and its control system is established. In the Matlab/Simulink platform, using the modular modeling idea, according to the actual operation of the gas turbine equipment will be divided into gas turbine compressor, combustion chamber and turbine and shaft module, and establishes the simulation model of gas turbine based on the physical principle and component characteristics. In the modeling process, the cooling air extraction problem is taken into account in the modeling of the compressor. The compressor is divided into three sections to model and improve the accuracy of the model calculation. Finally, the simulation experiment under variable conditions is carried out to verify the accuracy of the simulation model and the effectiveness of the control system.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Electric Vehicle Battery Centralized Charging Station Based on EV Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of different brands of electric vehicles and the road conditions in different time, and the users driving habits of electric taxis and electric private vehicles, the EV load demand of battery distribution stations in the planning area is analyzed as the planning basis of battery centralized charging station. Aiming at the minimum annual comprehensive cost, a locating and sizing planning model of battery centralized charging station is established, which takes into account the costs of energy storage, construction, operation-maintenance and battery transportation. The calculation results show that the load forecasting method of battery distribution station and the planning method of battery centralized charging station are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Allocation of STATCOM based on Harmony Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) has been widely used for improving related performance of power system. However, it depends on its reasonable location and capacity to achieve this purpose. Therefore, this paper establishes an optimization model, which takes active power loss, total voltage deviation and transmission efficiency as objective functions. To solve the complex optimization problem, the harmony search algorithm is used to optimize its allocation. The optimized results with and without STATCOM in the system are compared using the standard harmony search algorithm. To avoid falling into local optimal solution, the improved difference harmony search algorithm is used. The results show that the improved harmony search algorithm is better than the standard harmony search algorithm in this problem. This work can provide reference for multi-objective optimization allocation of FACTS equipment in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Planning of Integrated Energy System Based on Information Gap Decision Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrated energy systems can greatly improve the efficiency of energy use, but the main problem for their planning is the uncertainty of the load in the long cycle. Therefore, this paper establishes an integrated energy system extended planning model incorporating multiple energy sources of gas, heat, and electricity, while long-term uncertainties are taken into account. Given the low accuracy of long-term forecasts and the small amount of uncertainty information, information gap decision theory is used to handle the uncertainty of electric load growth for coordinated planning. Finally, the validity of the proposed planning model is verified by taking an actual park as an example. Uncertainty can be managed effectively by regulating the avoidance factor, giving planners a quantitative tool and the superiority of integrated energy system planning over standalone planning is compared.

articleTitle: DC Power Distribution System and Its Protection Configuration
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to absorb renewable energy and electric vehicles, the typical design and protection scheme of AC/DC power distribution system are studied. Firstly, the advantages of DC distribution are analyzed from the point of view of power grid and users. Secondly, the energy router is configured as the system energy supply center and conversion hub, and the typical topology structure is designed. Finally, in order to solve the problems of fault location, isolation and self-healing, the fault current precise control and selective cutting technology based on source and load characteristics are adopted, and the multi-voltage level DC distribution network frame is constructed for verification.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement of Wind Power Peak-Shaving Auxiliary Service Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid increase of installed capacity of new energy power generation and the complex interest relationship of power auxiliary services, the contradiction between heating and power generation in thermal power plants is becoming prominent gradually. In order to address this problem, this paper focuses on the contradiction between the peak-shaving market and power spot market, and proposes a contradiction coordination mechanism between which compensates part of the wind-abandonment accommodation income to the peak-shaving units to ensure that unit's participation in peak shaving market will not be less profitable than non-participation in peak shaving market. Therefore, the enthusiasm of the units participating in the peak-shaving market will be improved. The effectiveness and correctness of the compensation mechanism proposed are verified through simulation and analysis.

articleTitle: Short Term Wind Power Forecasting Method Based on WDRI-RF Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The ever-increasing number of wind power generation devices has increased the scale of wind power grid connection, which in turn caused fluctuations in the grid. The problem is largely solved by wind power forecasting algorithms. Wind Direction Relevance Improvement-Random Forest (WDRI-RF) is proposed to solve the problem that low relevance factors in traditional wind power forecasting are not highly utilized by the model. The problem of low relevance between wind direction factor and wind power is solved by the Wind Direction Relevance Improvement Algorithm. On the one hand, the Random Forest model is used to complete the multiple types of data generated by the above algorithm. On the other hand, it is used to solve the matching problem of data and model. The results of an example show that the Relevance of wind direction factors is significantly improved. In addition, compared with the traditional model, WDRI-RF is proposed in this paper can improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Operation Control Strategy of Improved Master-slave Control for Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With consideration of improving the stability of the microgrid in different operating modes, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy with improved droop control are used as the master control unit, and the other distributed power sources use PQ control as the slave unit to build an improved master-slave control microgrid system model. The main parameters and operation characteristics of the microgrid system are analyzed in depth by designing off-grid switching, sudden load increase and main control micropower failure conditions. This method is more efficient than the existing methods because it can meet the needs of the system under different operating conditions, realize the automatic power adjustment and the system frequency voltage recovery, and has good adaptability and stability.

articleTitle: Simulation of Photovoltaic Inverter Based on New Z-source Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the voltage gain of traditional Z-source inverter, obtain lower capacitor voltage stress and solve the problem of starting current impact, a topology of power supply embedded switched inductor Z-source inverter is proposed. The position of DC power supply in the improved switched inductor Z-source inverter is readjusted, which greatly reduces the starting current impact of the circuit At the same time, the voltage stress of the capacitor is reduced, which reduces the cost and volume of the capacitor. At the same time, the energy storage process and working principle of the new topology are analyzed, and the system is verified by MATLAB / Simulink simulation software.

articleTitle: Temperature Interpolation Method of Distributed Photovoltaic Power Station Group Based on Multisource Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the coverage and accuracy of the temperature data of distributed photovoltaic (PV) station group, this paper proposes a temperature interpolation method of distributed PV power station group based on multi-source data fusion. Firstly, the applicability and accuracy of four spatial interpolation methods were studied by using high-precision temperature data from meteorological stations. The results showed that the Co-Kriging (CK) method has the highest interpolation accuracy, which was used to construct a base temperature distribution map. Secondly, the base distribution map was utilized to perform weighted average correction on the temperature data of low-precision PV power stations. Finally, the CK method was used to construct a more accurate temperature distribution map based on the temperature data of meteorological stations and the corrected temperature data of PV power stations. Taking Jiangsu province as the research area, the experimental results showed that the interpolation accuracy of the proposed method is significantly higher than that of the base distribution map.

articleTitle: Research on Output Power Control Strategy of Parallel Microgrid Based on Improved Virtual Impedance
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In inverter parallel systems, droop control is usually used to achieve reasonable load distribution. Since the equivalent output impedance of each inverter is very different, to solve the problem that it is difficult to achieve accurate energy distribution in traditional droop control, an improved control strategy based on virtual impedance is proposed. This strategy can automatically change according to line changes. Adjust the impedance value. In addition, the inverter output voltage is introduced into the power loop, and by setting a reasonable reference voltage, the voltage droop caused by the introduction of virtual impedance can be effectively compensated. Finally, by establishing a simulation model on the simulation platform, the effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Short-term PV Power Forecasting Based on BP Network Optimized by Logistic Improved ASO
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: PV power forecasting is crucial for power systems containing grid-connected PV. In this paper, a BP neural network optimized by Logistic improved Atomic Search Optimization (ASO) is proposed. Firstly, the Euclidean distance between the prediction date and the historical data is calculated to select the similar samples of the prediction data; secondly, the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network are optimized using the ASO. To further improve the accuracy of PV power prediction, a logistic mapping is used to initialize the atomic population positions, which are then used to optimize the BP neural network. The simulation results of real data show that this method is helpful to improve the short-term prediction accuracy of PV.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization Control Strategy for Inconsistency between ACE-based AGC and Primary Frequency Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the normalization of cross-regional power transmission and the high proportion of new energy sources, the operation status of the power grid is more replicated, and frequency stability control becomes more difficult. During the winter heating period, when automatic generation control regulation resources are reduced, the secondary frequency regulation strategy based on area control error is limited, and the unit primary frequency regulation and AGC cannot coordinate in control of the grid frequency. This paper analyzes the phenomenon that the first and second frequency modulation cannot be coordinated, and proposes solutions from the aspects of power grid assessment indicators and unit optimization control strategies, in order to improve the frequency control ability of the power grid under large deviation fluctuations.

articleTitle: Discrete Wavelet Transform based Transient Voltage Vulnerable Node Assessment for Renewable Energy Integrated Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the transformation of the essential characteristic, the power system voltage issue in China shifts sharply from the static optimization to transient stability assessment and control problems with regard to predefined faults. That is attributable to the large-scale renewable energy integrated into power systems, together with long distance inter-area transmission and consumption. Amongst these problems, the fundamental process is to select the vulnerable nodes for sake of post-fault transient voltage. The well-known practical assessment index for transient voltage utilizes the long-period integral value of the post-fault transient voltage dip and recovery curves, which is originally designed for the traditional power system, In this paper, a novel multi-resolution analysis (MRA) method is proposed for renewable energy involved power system transient voltage disturbed curves decomposing, using the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) analysis. Furthermore, a new post-fault transient voltage vulnerable node screening method is proposed based on these decomposition coefficients. A 50% photovoltaic (PV) source integrated power system (36-bus model) is adopted for the proposed method validation.

articleTitle: Dual-Flatness-Based-Control Strategy of Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter can realize the three-phase AC-AC transformation. Its outstanding advantages are easy to modularize, high reliability and low harmonic content, which can be used in high-voltage and large-capacity driven system. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional PI control, such as slow stability, easy overshoot and poor dynamic performance, this paper proposes a new nonlinear Flatness-Based-Control strategy based on Differential Flatness theory, which has the advantages of fast response, no overshoot, no static error in tracking and high dynamic performance. It can greatly improve the control effect of M3C input-side and output-side current. And under the operating conditions of input-side frequency changes, the Flatness-Based-Control strategy can still maintain the extremely low impact of the system, and the overall control effect is better. At last, the correctness and superiority of this method are verified by experiments under different working conditions.

articleTitle: High-Frequency Vibration Noise Reduction with Carrier Phase-shift for Dual-Branch Three-Phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Two-level voltage source inverters(VSIs) modulated by pulse width modulation(PWM) generates multiples of carrier harmonics, which excites high-frequency noise from the motor. And twice carrier frequency harmonics from dual-branch three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM) occupies large proportion. Based on special dual-branch three-phase PMSM, the twice carrier frequency vibration and acoustic noise can be eliminated theoretically with carrier phase-shift <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.5\pi$</tex>. Compared traditional interleaving topologies, the proposed method takes advantage of the specialty of the dual-branch three-phase PMSM and thus utilizes fewer VSIs. Then, noise elimination principle has been elaborated. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method has been confirmed by detailed experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Sag Properties of Medium-Low Voltage DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Recently, the quick development of DC distribution system (DCDS) has attracted increasing attention, and it has good technical advantages to accommodate DC renewable energies and DC power loads. However, the study of the power quality issue of DCDS is still at an initial stage, and little work addresses the voltage sag properties of a medium-low voltage DCDS. In this paper, typical DC short-circuit faults and DC load change are considered to investigate the voltage sag performances of the medium-low voltage DCDS. Related theoretical analysis of the DC voltage dip is implemented, and using MATLAB/Simulink, a detailed digital simulation model of a 20 kV class DCDS is established to check the voltage sag characteristics. From the simulation findings, the DC pole-to-pole fault and the pole-to-ground fault will cause visible voltage dips, and especially when the faults happen at the medium-voltage bus, the voltage levels of the entire DCDS will face serious falls. Regarding the sudden change of the DC load, it is concluded that the main dynamic influence appears at the low-voltage bus side, and the medium-voltage stabilization is favorably obtained.

articleTitle: Optimal Redundancy Configuration of Hybrid MMC Considering Maintenance Cost of Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has been widely used in the field of HVDC transmission. In practical application, the hybrid MMC topology with half-bridge submodule(HBSM) and full-bridge submodule(FBSM) gradually shows its advantages. The configuration ratio of the two redundant sub-modules(SMs) in the hybrid MMC affects the reliability and economy of the system.
