Therefore, this paper proposes the hybrid MMC redundancy optimization strategy based on maintenance strategy. Firstly, the hybrid MMC topology is studied and the system reliability model is established; secondly, combined with the MMC maintenance and replacement strategy, a minimum cost model based on age replacement policy is established; finally, through the case, the minimum maintenance cost corresponding to the different proportion of redundant SMs and the sensitivity of the optimal maintenance cycle to the redundancy ratio parameters are obtained. The results show that under the premise of high reliability, the economic benefit of redundant configuration can be maximized by the above model under the optimal maintenance cycle.

articleTitle: Research on Provincial Power System Cost Based on Carbon Constraint
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the establishment of the Goal of “Double Carbon”, Carbon constraint has become a strong constraint on the transformation and development of China's energy system. The power industry, with a high proportion of carbon emissions and relatively mature decarbonization technology, is the pioneer industry to promote the realization of low-carbon transformation. The current research focuses mostly on the technical analysis or system cost accounting of the carbon peak realization path at the national level. There is a lack of research on the carbon peak path and the system power cost of provincial power system. This paper proposes the calculation method of provincial power cost based on carbon constraint, analyzes the realization path of carbon target from the economic perspective, and provides references for the path selection and policy formulation of system transformation.

articleTitle: Research on Equipotential Construction of Multi Station Integrated Data Center
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: “Multi station integration” is the development direction of the current power grid. Multiple functions such as substation, energy storage power station and data center station will be integrated into the substation to form a fusion station. It will be the hub and sharing platform of the future power grid. This paper introduces the new data center, energy storage PCS and communication integration construction scheme of a 35 kV Substation in Shanghai, and establishes the grounding network model based on the substation and data center. In order to improve the laying of equipotential network and ensure the safe operation of data center equipment, the ground potential rise and conductor potential difference of data center equipotential network under lightning stroke are studied. At the same time, the frequency distribution introduced by lightning current is analyzed, which is used to optimize the equipment filtering and isolation measures and ensure the normal operation of the equipment. Based on CDEGS software, this paper uses FFTSES and HIFRQ module to build simulation environment and establish simulation model. Finally, according to the actual situation, some feasible measures are put forward.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Intelligent Substation Cluster Measurement and Control Device Based on Virtualization Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The measurement and control device of intelligent substation generally adopts a single set of independent configuration scheme. When the device is abnormal, the measurement and control function of the whole interval will be completely missing, and there is a big hidden danger in operation safety. Through the research of modular technology, virtual device technology, multi-core processor heterogeneous technology, virtual terminal mapping technology, the cluster measurement and control device is completed. In case of physical measurement and control failure, the virtual measurement and control unit in the cluster measurement and control device can completely replace its function, completely solve the problem of no backup for a single set of measurement and control, and improve the operation reliability and stability of the automation system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Electric Vehicle Charging Station in Distribution Network Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With electric vehicle applied generally, it will produce many influences for distribution network, which should be evaluated in planning. According to requirements of distribution network, the evaluation indicators should focus on economy and reliability. Distributed generations are developing on a large scale, making great challenge to distribution network. In this paper, the functions of electric vehicle charging station and distributed generations are expressed based on working theory. As for planning schemes, reasonable and objective evaluation indicators and evaluation method are established to choose the best one. According to Topsis with anti-entropy method, the influence of electric vehicle charging station objectively calculated by schemes' data. Based on case analysis, the increase on the number of charging stations is beneficial for charging electric vehicles, but when the number reaches a certain value, the benefits of the distribution network will be affected. Last, the whole work is concluded and some suggestions are made on future development.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Power Flow Considering Static Characteristics of Power System with Large-Scale Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Offshore wind power is the frontier field of renewable energy development. The realization of large-scale offshore wind power (LSOWP) integration and high-efficiency consumption is conducive to improving wind power utilization efficiency and investment benefits in power industry. Firstly, Nataf transformation is utilized to generate samples of Pearson correlated offshore wind speed which obey two-parameter Weibull distribution. Besides, the power of conventional generators and loads are presented with their static characteristics. Then, an unified extended power flow model including system frequency is established. Finally, the proposed method has been tested on modified IEEE 39-bus system. Monte Carlo method is utilized to analyze the impact arisen from LSOWP integration on system operation status under multi-scenarios. And this paper mainly focuses on the distribution of steady-state frequency and branch MW flows.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation System of Energy Integrated Service Station
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Energy Integrated Service Station takes the substation as the energy and information hub node, forming a new facility form covering functional units such as cold, heat, electricity, and storage. In this paper, a comprehensive effectiveness evaluation system for Energy Integrated Service Station is established from three dimensions of benefit indicators, technical indicators and response indicators. The improved entropy weight method is used to weight the indicators, and an industrial park that located in southern area of China is used as a case for comprehensive evaluation. The results showed that the overall score of the project reached 72.79, which is a satisfying level. The comprehensive performance met expectations, and has demonstrative significance. While there is still more to be progressed. The advantages of this project lie in its positive benefits both for social and environment, high quality of power supply, great safety and low loss rate of network. The disadvantages are showed as low energy storage capacity and small size proportion of electrical vehicle. In the future, the park could consider increasing the capacity of energy storage power stations and the proportion of new energy consumption with further solutions. If possible, increasing the proportion of electric vehicles V2G even could be taken into consider. Through case analysis, the validity and rationality of the evaluation system is proved.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of permanent magnet direct-drive wind turbine converter based on lifting wavelet and random forest
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The wind power converter is very prone to failure in the permanent magnet direct-drive wind power system. For the healthy operation of permanent magnet direct-drive wind power system, a wind power converter fault diagnosis method based on improved wavelet and random forest is proposed. In Simulink platform, a model of permanent magnet direct-drive wind power system is built to simulate the normal and fault states of wind power converter to obtain converter fault signals. The lifting scheme is used to construct wavelet to obtain lifting wavelet, and the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the lifting wavelet to construct the optimal lifting wavelet. Then the relative wavelet energy, waveform index, margin index and peak index are calculated by the detail coefficients of the lifting wavelet decomposition. The converter fault feature vector is obtained, and finally the feature vector is input to the random forest for converter fault diagnosis. It is shown that the random forest model has good classification performance for wind power converter fault diagnosis in comparative analysis with extreme learning machine and BP neural network.

Author Keywords: Fault diagnosis of wind power converter

articleTitle: A Travelling Wave based Single-Ended Fault Location Using Multi-resolution Morphological Gradient
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate identification of fault reflected waves is a big problem of single-ended travelling wave based fault location methods. Regarding wave propagation characteristics, this paper proposes a single-ended fault location approach using multiresolution morphological gradient. Fault branch is determined according to the similarity between the time-frequency energy spectrum of the fault signal and each branch. Then wave propagation information along the line is mapped into energy discontinuity points. The multi-resolution morphological gradient is used to extract the break points in order to identify the fault location. Simulation results demonstrate the feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Rolling Dispatch for Integrated Energy System with a Hybrid Time Scale Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Traditional dispatch strategies pay little attention to the thermal dynamic characteristics of the key equipment in the integrated energy system (IES) when dispatching on a short time scale, and usually dispatch with a constant time scale, which may lead to incomplete implementation of scheduling instructions and a large amount of calculation. In this paper, a rolling dispatch model of IES considering thermal dynamic characteristics of micro-turbine is formulated with model predictive control (MPC), and a hybrid time scale framework (HTS) based on the varying characteristics of the net load is proposed and embedded into the prediction horizon to determine the time scale. The simulation results show that the proposed dynamic rolling dispatch strategy based on HTS has better performance in reducing thermal power deviation and operation cost compared with the static strategy, and is superior to the constant time scale strategy in improving computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control Strategy of MMC Solid State Transformer under Unbalanced Network Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solid state transformer (SST) has attracted wide attention due to its advantages of active and reactive power control, harmonic cancelation, and power factor correction. The input stage of SST based on modular multilevel converter (MMC) topology can be applied to the transmission systems in the high voltage range. Under the positive and negative sequences system, this paper proposes an unbalanced-grid-fault ride-through nonlinear control method based on the input stage and output stage of MMC-SST. The control strategy of input stage aims at minimizing the fluctuation of DC voltage on the input side and reducing the negative input stage's sequence current. The control strategy of output stage focuses on controlling the active power oscillation of output stage. To further reduce the impact of unbalanced grid fault, a PI-based phase-shift control of the isolation stage during the fault is proposed. To verify the proposed control strategy, a three-stage MMC-SST model during the fault is built in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the control strategy proposed in this paper has the advantages of eliminating transient power quality problems in both grids.

articleTitle: Research on the Different Interaction Modes between Hydrogen Electrolysers and the Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid decreasing production cost of green energy and the increasing urgency to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions, hydrogen is receiving unprecedented momentum as a key energy transition pillar. The number of related policies and projects is expanding rapidly. China is highly dependent on energy-intensive and high-emission industries. Thus, clean hydrogen has become an irreplaceable tool to realize deep decarbonization in some hard-to-abate sectors. Hydrogen energy will have close interaction with the power grid in various forms, among which hydrogen electrolysers are considered to be the dominant way in the near future. In this study, different interaction modes between hydrogen electrolysers and the power grid are analyzed, based on which, the production costs of hydrogen are calculated and compared. Concerning existing issues, relevant suggestions to accelerate the development of clean hydrogen are put forward.

articleTitle: Super Capacitor Energy Storage System's Charging Design Based on Composite Control Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Devices such as DVR and HPQC require supercapacitor energy storage units. Traditional supercapacitor energy storage units use constant current and constant power modes for charging, and there is a problem that the DC bus voltage cannot be stabilized. This article proposes a simple high-voltage supercapacitor charging circuit and its control scheme. The scheme uses a circuit that combines an isolation transformer, a three-phase uncontrolled rectifier bridge and a Buck converter, and uses a composite control mode that combines DC bus voltage feedforward and Buck circuit voltage and current loop. The simulation results show that the compound control mode can suppress the output current jump and reduce the DC bus voltage jump.

articleTitle: An Operation Scheduling Model for Carbon Neutrality in Industrial Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Improvements in energy structure are driving renewable energy to replace the fossil energy. Energy-consuming industries play a crucial role in the development of energy transformation. This paper presents an industrial integrated energy system that works to neutralize carbon. Firstly, the energy production subsystems using wind, solar, biomass, and biogas as raw material has been studied to achieve the carbon cycle. Furthermore, an operation scheduling model considering carbon emissions in the chemical and metallurgical industries has been proposed, which optimizes the integration and distribution of electric energy, heating energy, and hydrogen. Finally, the proposed model is validated by simulations.

articleTitle: Research on the Trusted Access Control Technology in 5G Power User Behavior Perception Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, the demand for smart power grids has increased, and large numbers of smart terminals have been deployed in various production and operation links of power grid to monitor the status of power equipment and users in real time. Technologies such as 5G MEC (Multi-Access Edge Computing) are gradually being introduced into power scenarios to improve the high-quality operation and maintenance level of power grids and ensure refined service capabilities. MEC technology places the computing power of massive data at the edge of the 5G network, which can effectively reduce network transmission pressure and reduce the delay of power grid decision-making. At the same time, internal node attacks have also become a security issue that cannot be ignored in 5G power applications. This article first introduces the progress of MEC technology and analyzes the current application status of MEC in power grid; Secondly, for the 5G power user behavior perception scenario, this article studies an access control technology based on trust value, which can effectively improve the ability of 5G MEC to resist internal and external threats and attacks, and guarantee the security of using 5G technology in power scenarios.

articleTitle: Gas Turbine Fault Diagnosis Based on IPSO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of gas turbine fault diagnosis, a fault diagnosis method based on supporting vector machine and improved particle swarm algorithm is proposed: fault diagnosis model of gas turbine based on support vector machine. For the problem that support vector machine is greatly affected by its parameters, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm based on beetle antennae search(bas) is used to optimize its parameters. The simulation results show that compared with the unoptimized SVM model and PSO-SVM model, the IPSO-SVM model can identify faults more stably and accurately, and provide a practical reference for fault diagnosis of gas turbines.

articleTitle: Parameter Design Method of Virtual Synchronous Generator in Microgrid Base on Loop Bandwith
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For the microgrid composed of distributed power sources controlled by virtual synchronous generators, considering the fluctuations in output power and load, especially during off-grid operation, due to the loss of the grid's frequency support, the control parameters have a significant impact on the frequency stability of the microgrid. This article first establishes the mathematical model of the distributed power generation system based on the virtual synchronous generator, including its active power, voltage, and current loop. Study the influence of control parameters such as virtual inertia and damping coefficient on the frequency stability of the microgrid when the load changes suddenly. On this basis, according to the open-loop and closed-loop transfer functions of virtual synchronous generator control, the design methods of control parameters base on loop bandwith are studied, and the basis and selection method of parameter design are proposed. Finally, by building a microgrid model in the Matlab/Simulink system, the performance of the designed control system is simulated and analyzed, and the effectiveness of the adopted control parameter design method is VERIFIED.

Author Keywords: voltage and current double closed loop

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Flow of Integrated Energy System Based on Interior Point Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the operation optimization of the traditional integrated energy system, the optimal energy flow technology of integrated energy system was examined. Besides, consideration was given to the equation constraints on the system node power and flow, the inequality constraints on node voltage, air pressure and temperature, as well as line power and pipeline flow. The optimal energy flow of integrated energy system was obtained by introducing nonlinear network constraints, establishing nonlinear optimization solution models, and adopting the prediction-correction primal dual interior point method. With a southern university town as example, a certain energy flow section was selected to verify the rationality of the model and the applicability of the solution algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Low Voltage Topology Recognition Based on Relevance of Feature Information
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The lack of real-time and accurate line topology relationship on the side of low-voltage substation area, which causes the low efficiency and long cycle of problem checking about safety fault point and line abnormal point. In order to improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of the low-voltage station area, it is necessary to realize the dynamic management of low-voltage station area topology recognition. This paper analyzes and extracts the characteristic information correlation between the downlink carrier module of the intelligent terminal and the carrier module of the intelligent electricity meter, the correlation between the incoming and outgoing line characteristic information of the intelligent branch monitoring unit and combines the offset of power frequency voltage crossing zero to realize modification of dynamic topology recognition in low-voltage station area. Based on the characteristic information of the incoming and outgoing lines, the intelligent terminal in the station area analyzes the household transformer relationship, phase sequence relationship and low-voltage topology relationship, which updates the low-voltage topology diagram in real time by combining with edge calculation. It provides effective intelligent monitoring means for the fault diagnosis of low-voltage side lines, reduces manual inspection and operation and maintenance cycle, and converts “passive” operation and maintenance into “active” operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Distribution System Based on Grey Correlation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As one of the most important parts of electricity system, distribution system plays the role of connecting customers and power system. This paper first explains the basic concept of the power supply reliability of electricity system, analyzes the features of the study on the reliability of electricity system, and explains the indicators affecting the power supply system of distribution system. Then, we analyze the reasons for power outage of distribution system, including scheduled power outage and failure power outage, thus identifies the factors affecting the power supply reliability of distribution system. Finally, using grey correlation method, it works out the grey correlation coefficient between power supply reliability and each influencing factor, and in turn obtains the key factors affecting the reliability of distribution system as per the sequencing of grey correlation coefficient, thus provides scientific and useful references for power utilities to develop reliability improvement strategy.

Author Keywords: analysis on the reasons for outage

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index System of AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid distribution network based on energy router is adapted for the high penetration rate access of large-scale distributed power sources and flexible loads. In order to meet the equipment selection during the construction phase and the state maintenance during the operation phase, an evaluating index system is established for AC/DC hybrid distribution network system and core equipment. Firstly, the detailed rules of lean evaluation and data collection are analyzed. Secondly, the evaluation indexes of power supply reliability, system harmonic level and reactive power supplement ability are proposed from the system level. Finally, the evaluation indexes of fault ride through capability, energy consumption level, control capability and redundancy are proposed from the equipment level. Based on the typical multi-port DC loop network, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the index.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on Optimized Back Propagation Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of society and the progress of science and technology, the market of photovoltaic power generation is gradually turning to grid-connected power generation system. However, the output power of photovoltaic power generation is vulnerable to the interference of the external environment, and its volatility and intermittent shortcomings will impact the main power grid. Therefore, it is of great significance for the prediction research of photovoltaic power generation. In this paper, the photovoltaic of smart microgrid project of shanghai electric power university is taken as the research object, a back propagation neural network (BP) model based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) and momentum method is proposed, and the weight and bias of BP neural network are optimized by PSO algorithm and momentum method. In the early stage, the data were firstly normalized, and then the important features were selected through the gray correlation degree analysis. Finally, the photovoltaic power prediction experiment was conducted. The results show that the algorithm model in this paper has better prediction performance for photovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: Research on Power Balance Control Strategy of Three-phase CHB Photovoltaic Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Affected by some factors such as the partial shading or self-damage, the transmission power between H-bridge modules of a three-phase cascaded H-bridge (CHB) photovoltaic (PV) inverter is imbalanced, even the output power of one or more H-bridge modules is reduced to 0, which makes the module a dummy unit. As a result, a power imbalance between phases and bridges occurs in the three-phase CHB PV inverter, which causes an unbalanced grid current between three phases and even affects the stable operation of the system. Therefore, this paper proposes a control strategy to keep the stable operation of the three-phase CHB PV inverter, which uses the zero-sequence injection method and hybrid modulation strategy to solve the interphase and interbridge power imbalance, respectively. By utilizing the proposed strategy, the system can operate stably and output the three-phase balanced grid current even when one or more dummy units exist. The simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink to verify the excellent performance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Energy Storage System to Improve Flexible and Stable Operation of Microgrid in Grid-connected and Islanding Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the wind and solar storage microgrid system including 2 MW wind turbines, 1 MW photovoltaic power generation system and 500 kWh energy storage battery system, and gives a control strategy for the energy management system to follow the load demand response to control the output of the energy storage battery system under grid-connected and islanded operation of the microgrid. The response characteristics of the microgrid subsystem under grid-connected operation and islanding operation are simulated and analyzed in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The results show that the control strategy proposed in this paper can maintain the power balance of the microgrid and realize the flexible and safe operation of the wind and solar storage microgrid.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based on PSO-DBN
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Considering the importance of the transient stability to improve the safe and stable operation of power grid, this paper proposes a transient stability prediction method based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Deep Belief Network (DBN). Firstly, the particle swarm algorithm is used to determine the number of nodes in each hidden layer of the DBN and establish the initial DBN network. Secondly, use PSD-BPA to generate a large number sample data, including power angle, voltage, transmission line power flow and transient stability after fault. The above data are used as training and testing set to establish the prediction model. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed model has higher prediction accuracy compared with the traditional DBN method.

articleTitle: Realization of Rogowski Coil for Partial Discharge Measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: According to the accident data, insulation failure is the main cause of electrical equipment failure in the power system. Since the initial characteristic of insulation failure is partial discharge (PD), it is of great importance to detect whether the electrical equipment has partial discharge. Rogowski coil is a simple and safe measuring instrument. Due to its superior performance such as large measurement bandwidth, Rogowski coil is often used for detection and measurement of partial discharge. Since the frequency of partial discharge signals is mostly several megahertz (MHz), this paper identifies the influence of the size parameters of the Rogowski coil on its measurement accuracy and measurement bandwidth to find the best geometric size, and finally designs a Rogowski coil with a measurement bandwidth of 10MHz.

articleTitle: A Unified Security Monitoring Architecture and Management Method for Power Distribution IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Facing the increasingly severe network security situation in the construction of Distribution Internet of Things, a unified security monitoring system for power Distribution Internet of Things is built. It includes a security risk assessment model for Distribution Internet of Things, a threat tracing method for security events, and a security situation awareness method based on multi-source information fusion, which can achieve traceability of security events and the predictability of security situation. The research and implementation of this project can strengthen the data security of the core business of Distribution Internet of Things, and ensure the stable operation of Distribution Internet of Things business.

articleTitle: Research on Power 5G Business Security Architecture and Protection Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: We analyzed the security requirements corresponding to three main application scenarios in the power business network in this paper, studies the security protection technology of the power business system under the 5G network, and builds an overall power security protection architecture based on the 5G network based on the security protection requirements. In this paper, the key technologies involved in the overall security protection architecture, including security partitioning, unified authentication, and interface security, are studied and discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Adaptability Analysis of Directional Overcurrent Protection in the Distribution Network with Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The access of large-scale distributed photovoltaics (PVs) to the distribution network turns it into a multi-source distribution network. Under this condition, the original current protection fails to meet the protection requirements and it is necessary to configure directional overcurrent protection (DOP) at the end of the line. Due to the weak overcurrent capability of distributed PVs, the setting value of DOP current elements is very low, and the DOP is prone to mal-operation when a fault occurs on adjacent lines, such as during tide changing or line faults of highvoltage distribution network. This paper analyzes the action of DOP during tide changing or when a fault occurs in the high voltage distribution network. Test results show that using DOP as the main protection of the distribution network with PVs is easy to cause mal-operation of protection devices.

articleTitle: Design of Two-stage Active Equalization System for Liquid Metal Battery Module
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The liquid metal battery (LMB), a novel energy storage battery, has many advantages such as high current density, large capacity and low cost. However, due to the inconsistence of LMBs, available capacity of LMB module decreases with usage cycle increasing. To solve the problem, a two-stage active equalization system is proposed for large-scale LMB module in this paper. Advanced flyback circuit and double half bridge circuit are respectively utilized for intra-pack and inter-pack equalization. The equalization system is tested on a module with 24 cells in series. Test results show that, after six charge/discharge cycles, capacity degradation of LMB module is 0.4 Ah while 7 Ah without equalization. The proposed system effectively reduces the capacity degradation of the LMB module and improves its service life.

articleTitle: An Integrated Thyristor Submodule Based Modular Multilevel Converter with DC Fault Interruption Capability
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) based dc grid has attracted much attention. The protection for dc fault is a critical issue in MMC based dc grid. In this paper, an integrated thyristor submodule (ITSM) for dc fault current interruption is proposed with the advantages of reduced semiconductor costs and less conduction losses. The protection scheme for ITSM based MMC under the dc fault is presented and the working principle of fault interrupting in each period is analyzed. A two-terminal dc grid with proposed ITSM based MMC is simulated with PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme. The simulation results show that the dc fault current can be interrupted within a fundamental period.

articleTitle: Demand Response Capability Assessment of Regenerative Electric Heating Load under the Goal of “Double Carbon”
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Improving demand response capability of power load is an important way to build a new power system with high penetration of renewable energy. Based on the measured data of regenerative electric heating load in a province of China, this paper uses big data analytic method to reclassify the regenerative electric heating load. By using the hybrid decision trees method, the five types of demand response models have been built, and the demand response capability under different incentive conditions has been analyzed. The results show that different types of regenerative electric heating load have different demand response capability, and the same regenerative electric heating load has different demand response capability at different heating periods. The demand response capability of regenerative electric heating load could be effectively improved by reasonable market-oriented incentive, which can effectively improve the wind power consumption capability and reduce the peak valley difference of power load.

articleTitle: Effects of Differential Diffusion on Flame Structure of Non-premixed Ammonia/Methane Combustion
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large eddy simulation (LES) employing a flamelet/progress variable (FPV) model based on detailed chemical kinetics were conducted to investigate effects of differential diffusion in non-premixed ammonia/methane/air combustion. From the comparisons between the cases using differential diffusion (non-unity Lewis number assumption) and unity Lewis number assumption, the numerical results show that the flame height shortens in the absence of differential diffusion. The flame structure is also influenced by differential diffusion in a significant manner. Further, experiments have also been performed to verify the accuracy of the simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Characteristic Variables of Asynchronous Motor Powered by Frequency Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing demand for the reliability and durability of electric power transmission system, the fault detection and diagnosis of electric motors is not only a scientific problem, but also an economic problem. This paper analyzes the failure mechanism of asynchronous motor stator turn short circuit, rotor broken bar, rotor eccentricity, bearing damage, and establishes the asynchronous motor fault model. The stator three-phase current of asynchronous motor when several faults occur is obtained by simulation. The three-phase stator three-phase current is transformed to the three-phase synchronous rotating <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$DQ$</tex> axis. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$DQ$</tex> component of the current is mainly DC, and the length of the stator current synthesis vector is also DC. The fault is reflected in the pulsation of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$DQ$</tex> current and the vector length. According to the pulsation change, the motor fault can be judged. Since the motor is usually powered by the inverter, the three-phase current on the motor stator has a lot of harmonic content. After the motor fails, the three-phase AC current has both the harmonics generated by the inverter power supply and the harmonics generated after the fault. It is difficult to distinguish these harmonics. The method proposed in this paper overcomes this shortcoming.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Distributed Data Acquisition System for Small Waste Incineration Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of small waste incineration power plants, a distributed data acquisition system based on SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture) is proposed, which decomposes various business function units in the form of services, so that different business function units of the system are loosely coupled and easy to expand. Adopting a protocol analysis method based on the event inquiry response mechanism, the data acquisition subsystem is developed to realize the data acquisition and transmission based on the Modbus communication protocol. The system data service, human-computer interaction subsystem and database are developed to realize the data visualization, completed the design and development of the entire system.

articleTitle: External Liquid Cooling Method for Lithium-ion Battery Modules under Ultra-fast Charging
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are booming all over the world for a low carbon emission and greener environment. The fast charging is an urgent demand for consumers, however, the dramatic temperature rising during high current charging has a high risk of trigging thermal runaway and other safety issues. Herein, this study proposes an external liquid cooling method for lithium-ion battery, which the circulating cooling equipment outside EVs is integrated with high-power charging infrastructure, aiming to achieve fast charging without the risk of thermal runaway. A comprehensive experiment study is carried out on a battery module with up to 4C fast charging and then the simulation model with high accuracy is built for 5C analysis. The external cooling system with fast charging can significantly suppress temperature rising, resulting maximum temperature decreasing from 58°C to 49°C during 4C by experiments. Moreover, temperature distribution of module under various charging rates, cooling plates layout, coolant temperature and flow rate are systematically researched from various experiments. Finally, a safe charging range under 5C fast charging is proposed based on simulation which provides a 20% increase compared with natural cooling.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suppression of the DC Side Oscillation for MMC Based VSC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the fast control and switching behaviours of the power electronics-based converters, there are potential interactions between VSC-HVDC systems and the AC grid as well as other power electronics equipment. These oscillation phenomena have been observed in the practical HVDC project while few DC side oscillation was reported. In this paper, the DC side oscillation in VSC-HVDC system is analysed and a suppression strategy implemented in valve control for MMC is proposed consdering the limited signals acquisition. The proposed suppression strategy is validated by offline simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC. The records of the DC current oscillation in the DPT/FAT for the practical project by using actual control and protection equipment with real-time simulator is presented and the suppression strategy is also verified. The offline EMT simulation results and the DPT/FAT results show that the proposed strategy can suppress the DC side oscillation effectively and it has been used in the practical HVDC project.

articleTitle: A Grayscale Distribution-Based Algorithm with Window for Infrared and Visible Image Registration of Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Automatic registration between infrared and visible images is a challenging work in inspection of power equipment because of the inconsistent spectral characteristics and complex backgrounds. The Infrared and visible image registration under complex backgrounds is a challenging work. Firstly, infrared and visible lights have inconsistent spectral characteristics. Secondly, the area of complex background has no obvious edge contour, which increases the difficulties of extracting the consistent edges. Existing edge extraction algorithms produce a large number of inconsistent points in the background area while extracting edges, which increases the number of local extremes of the normalized mutual information (NMI) in registration. To solve this problem, a grayscale distribution-based algorithm with window (GDW) is proposed to extract strong common edge features from infrared and visible images and minimizes the impact of complex backgrounds. The accuracy of image registration can be increased effectively by using the edge images extracted by GDW.

articleTitle: A multi-agent Diagnostic and Prognostic Framework for Optimized Operation and Maintenance Management in NPPs
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The paper presents a simulated-based integrated method for multiple faults diagnosis within the framework of PHM to nuclear applications. A case study is illustrated based on the simulation of the loss of water supply accident of the primary circuit system and the main pump shaft jam in the PCTRAN environment. The principal component analysis is applied to facilitate the data processing for tracking down the root causes of the simulated faults. The fault diagnosis module is then integrated into a multi-agent diagnostic and prognostic framework to extend the applications to prognostics. The underlying human errors can also be traced back through procedural task analysis in auditing within the multi-agent diagnostic and prognostic framework. The simulation results show that the principal component analysis is capable of root cause analysis and multiple faults identification. The comprehensive multi-factor influence of machine failures and human errors can be taken into account to improve the safety level of operation and maintenance of nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: Application Research of Modeling and Control for Model Prediction Algorithm on 600MW Supercritical Once-through Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For a supercritical 600MW thermal power unit, the control object is fairly complex with large nonlinear and hysteresis characteristics. Therefore, the main parameters in control process fluctuate greatly, and the control effect fails to meet the regulatory requirements, resulting in a decline in the economy and safety performance of the unit. In response to this problem, this paper proposes a control strategy that combines the traditional unit feedforward algorithm with model prediction algorithm, and applies it to simulation and field verification. Results show that the proposed control strategy significantly improves the control effect, thereby improving the operation stability of the unit, which improves the economic efficiency of the power plant in turn.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Boiler-Turbine Unit Based on Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of strong coupling, nonlinearity and time-varying parameters in the control process of the coordinated control system of thermal power units, a boiler-turbine unit coordinated system control strategy based on active disturbance rejection technology is proposed. The internal and external disturbances of the system are regarded as total disturbances, the state and disturbance information of the system are estimated in time. By designing a suitable nonlinear control law for state feedback, the anti-interference ability of the system and the adaptive ability to the change of unit operating conditions are improved. At the same time, on the problem of the complex parameter tuning of the auto disturbance rejection controller, a tuning method based on the improved firefly algorithm is proposed, which avoids the shortcomings of the traditional firefly algorithm that are premature in the later stage and easy to fall into the local optimal value. The simulation results show that the scheme satisfies the control requirements of the boiler-turbine unit coordination system, and effectively improves the stability and robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Power System Virtual Seats Key Technology Research and Application
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Virtual agent technology plays a significant role in improving the quality of power customer service in the power industry. Through the virtual agent technology, combined with speech recognition technology, knowledge mapping research and multi round human-computer dialogue technology, the ability of the power industry to cope with the increase of the number of power users, the increase of power consumption and the diversification of services is promoted. This paper first summarizes the key technologies of virtual agent, then discusses the application scenarios of virtual agent in power system, and finally prospects its development.

articleTitle: An Approach for Steam Pipe Network Pressure Prediction Based on CNN and BiLSTM with Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The steam pipe network is a complex nonlinear network structure system with a large time delay, and the accurate prediction of its pipeline pressure is the prerequisite for energy dispatch and guarantee. Considering the complicated changes in pipeline pressure and many influencing factors, this paper proposes a steam pipe network pressure prediction model based on the CNN and BiLSTM with attention mechanism. This method can strengthen the connection between various users, reduce the loss of historical information, and achieve the higher-precision steam pipe network pressure prediction. Compared with other models, the MAPE of this method is reduced to 0.55%, and the RMSE is only 0.006 MPa. This method can improve the management level of the steam pipe network and is helpful to the construction of energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Design of a Double Break Current Injection DC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of DC power system in recent years, more stringent requirements have been put forward for the rapid reliability of DC circuit breakers. At present, series and parallel breakers are commonly used in medium-voltage DC circuit breakers to improve the breaking capacity, but there are some problems such as poor uniformity of breakers, large size of circuit breakers and high cost. In this paper, a double-break DC circuit breaker structure based on reactance coupler is proposed. In the process of current breaking, two vacuum switches in series operate simultaneously, and the capacitive discharge and reactance coupler are used to realize rapid current commutation, which improves the voltage bearing capacity of the circuit breaker. Connecting IGCT in the commutator branch can shorten the break time and make reclosing easier. The working principle of the circuit breaker is analyzed, and the rationality of the proposed scheme is verified by simulation calculation.

articleTitle: Method for Selecting Optimal Access Point of Offshore Wind Farm Integrated by VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Because of the rapid growth of offshore wind farm (OWF) capacity, voltage-source-converter-based high-voltage direct-current (VSC-HVDC) transmission scheme is becoming a competitive transmission scheme. This paper presents a method for selecting the optimal access point of offshore wind farm integrated with VSC-HVDC. The method takes into account capability of wind power accommodation, voltage support from onshore VSCs, voltage fluctuation caused by the change of wind power, vulnerability of power system transmission networks, and construction costs. This multi-objective decision-making problem is suggested to be solved based on the theory of information entropy and fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) method. The method is applied in Shandong Province where is developing offshore wind power rapidly to select an optimal access point by the use of PSS/E. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for selecting the access point of the OWF.

articleTitle: Commutation Failure and Mitigation Strategy with Lightning Shielding on AC Line near the Converter Stations of UHVDC Line
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Compared with the typical Ultra HVDC (UHVDC) system, the inverters of the UHVDC system with a hierarchical connection mode (UHVDC-HCM), connect to 500 kV and 1000 kV voltage levels respectively under HCM. The thyristor is voltage-sensitive load. If the 500 kV or 1000 kV line near the converter station (CS) suffers lightning shielding (LS) failure, it will be vulnerable to cause the UHVDC-HCM system to commutation failure. In this paper, the model of the UHVDC-HCM system is developed in PSCAD/EMTDC and the principle of commutation failure with LS failure is analyzed. Then, a control strategy to suppress commutation failure is proposed. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed control strategy effectively suppresses the commutation failure of UHVDC-HCM with LS and improves the recovery performance of post-fault.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Power Smoothing Based on Time Window Tracking Differentiator
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The fluctuation of the photovoltaic(PV) output power will affect the stability of the distribution network and cause difficulty of grid dispatching. Smoothing methods such as low pass filter method and moving average method cannot guarantee the obtained curve meets the fluctuation requirements accurately. What's more, these methods will lead to the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) acting frequently and the output of BESS getting large. It means higher requirements on the energy storage capacity. Based on Tracking Differentiator(TD), a Time Window Tracking Differentiator (TWTD) has been proposed in this paper to obtain the smoothing target curve of PV output power. Additionally, the state and total disturbance are observed by linear extended state observer(LESO), and the reference signal can be tracked quickly and accurately through the linear state error feedback. Finally, a rather smoothing curve can be obtained. Taking into account the capacity limit of BESS, a nonlinear energy storage constraint is proposed to adjust the energy storage output according to the State of Charge (SOC) of BESS. In this paper, the source of experimental data is the output of a PV power generation and energy storage system in East China. The simulation is based on Matlab/Simulink platform. The experimental results show that not only the algorithm can effectively suppress the fluctuation of the Point of Common Coupling (PCC) but it can reduce the times of BESS actions and save energy.

articleTitle: A Method for Power Frequency Voltage Tolerance Test of Insulated Diaphragm Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For the current method of power frequency piezoelectric test, it takes a lot of time to replace the insulation diaphragm and disconnect the test lead. A method of power frequency voltage withstanding test for insulation diaphragm surface is presented. In the traditional test method, when the number of insulation diaphragms is large, moving, wiring, disconnecting, pad plate, change plate will cause manual waste and a lot of time waste. Secondly, the traditional voltage resistance test method of insulated diaphragm is to test the contact between the handheld electrode operating pole and the point surface of the insulated diaphragm. First, there is a personal risk of electric shock. Second, the accuracy of manual operation is low. Third, the handheld operation is time-consuming and laborious. Handling, wiring, disconnection, pad plate, change plate will cause manual waste and a lot of time waste. Through experimental analysis, the power frequency voltage withstanding test device of insulation diaphragm improves the efficiency and accuracy of testing, and also ensures the safety of workers and equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Sensor Fault Diagnosis of Gas Turbine Control System Based on Data-driven
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The sensor is responsible for monitoring the running state of gas turbine in gas turbine control system, so it is of great significance to carry out fault diagnosis of the sensor in gas turbine control system. This paper presents a sensor fault diagnosis method for gas turbine control system based on data-driven. The method first simulates several common faults of the sensor, and uses wavelet packet transform (WPT) to extract fault features, and then use moth-flame optimization (MFO) algorithm to optimize the initial weights and biases of BP neural network (BPNN), establishes the MFO-BPNN fault diagnosis model, and finally inputs the fault characteristics into the diagnosis model to realize the fault diagnosis of the gas turbine control system.

articleTitle: Optimal Charging of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on Model Predictive Control Considering Lithium Plating and Cell Temperature
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Fast charging is crucial for applications of lithium-ion batteries in energy power systems. In this paper, a novel optimal charging strategy based on the model predictive control considering lithium plating and cell temperature is proposed. This method maximizes the charging speed while maintaining battery performance. It addresses constraints on the input current, the inner anode potential, and the temperature to prevent lithium plating and thermal safety issues. A thermal-coupled electrode equivalent circuit model is developed to observe the battery internal states with limited computation. A state observer based on the extended Kalman filter and a particle swarm optimizer is adopted in the MPC framework. The capability of this charging strategy is demonstrated via simulation and the result reveals that the battery can be charged to 86.6% of the full capacity in 17 minutes with accurate control of the anode potential and temperature. Compared with other charging protocols, the proposed method presents significant superiority. Besides, the optimal charging strategy is practical for onboard applications.

articleTitle: Efficient Reactive Power Control Using Reinforcement Learning under Inaccurate Power Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper utilizes distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) based optimization technique to arrive at the efficient reactive power control (ERPC) in electric power systems by considering the inaccurate power network. Every agent will incorporate with the adjacent agent only if it is electrically combined for data sharing utilizing global information sharing by using the consensus-based algorithm. A Q-learning-based distributed RL-based algorithm is used and incorporated with the consensus algorithm for the global reward search to limit the power losses and operational constraints. It is demonstrated to be applicable for online learning, and a model-free methodology has been considered and provides the optimal solution. It has been observed that supervised learning can speed up the learning process and reduce undesired results.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Domestic and Foreign Urban Energy Internet Demonstration Practice
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the world, many countries have explored the development of smart city in many aspects. From the perspective of energy, urban Energy Internet is an important part of smart city, which is the core to ensure the reliable and efficient operation of smart city. This paper selects four cities as the typical urban Energy Internet demonstrations to study the construction status from the perspectives of background, overall design, and analysis of construction effects. The four cities are Kashiwa-no-ha in Japan, Amsterdam in Netherlands, Jiaxing and Suzhou in China. We propose three differences (concept and goal, development mode, funding mode) in urban Energy Internet at home and abroad. Based on the differences, we put forward five development measures for the future demonstration of urban Energy Internet in China.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Multi-energy Markets Considering Integrated Energy Supplier Bidding
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to reflect the market value of integrated energy system and encourage its investment and development, it is a trend for integrated energy suppliers (IES) to participate in market competition. Aiming at the joint game problem of IESs with coal-fired generators (CG), gas-turbines power generators (GT), gas boilers (GB) and natural gas wells (GW) participating in electricity wholesale market, natural gas market and heat market at the same time, a Cournot game equilibrium model considering the multi-market strategy interaction among three markets is introduced. The impacts of different competition modes of IESs on market competition results are analyzed by numerical examples. It is shown that IESs participating in market competition with the goal of maximizing the total profit in the three markets, which is beneficial to improve their own profits, reduces the market prices and increase social welfare. In addition, the IESs with higher conversion efficiency of the GTs can increase both their profits and social welfare through energy conversion.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of an Integrated Energy System Considering Dynamic Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Conventional optimal configuration of integrated energy systems (IES) is based on the static model but ignores the dynamic process of the equipment. It is difficult to ensure that the actual output of system meets the energy demand in the dynamic process. This paper formulates a configuration optimization method which considers the dynamic characteristic of main devices, based on the dynamic model of the equipment. Comparison of simulation results between the proposed method and the conventional method demonstrates that the capacity change of the device with faster response is more obvious. The capacity scheme in this paper can ensure the stability of energy supply in the dynamic process.

articleTitle: Hybrid Data-Physics Based Digital Twin Modeling Framework for the Power System of Bobsleigh and Tobogganing Venue for Beijing Winter Olympics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to realize power prediction, deduction and decision analysis of venues for Beijing Winter Olympics under various conditions, this paper studies the digital twin modeling framework for the power system of bobsleigh and tobogganing venue, considering the great influence weather conditions had on ammonia ice-making system and the indoor heating system load, we build a weather forecasting model based on support vector machine (SVM), propose a load prediction method of digital twin for venue power system, and prediction example is analyzed. It is proved that the proposed digital twin model obtains high prediction accuracy, and the application of this model can provide necessary decision basis and technical support for operators to make scientific decisions.

articleTitle: Planning of New Distribution Network Considering Green Power Certificate Trading and Carbon Emissions Trading
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to adapt to the development of green power certificate trading (GPCT) and carbon emissions trading (CET) market, reduce the carbon emissions of distribution network (DN) and increase the investment income, this paper proposes a new distribution network (NDN) planning and simulation operation bilevel model with new energy (NE) as the main body, considering GPCT and CET mechanism. First, the upper level plans the capacity and location of wind turbine (WT), photovoltaic (PV), hydraulic turbine (HT), micro turbine (MT), and energy storage (ES). Then the lower simulation operation takes into account the operation costs of WT, PV, HT, MT, ES, load flow and carbon emissions. The planning objective is to minimize the total cost of investment, operation and carbon emissions in the planning period. Finally, a case study of the improved IEEE33 node NDN planning in Southwest China is given. The results of NDN planning and TDN planning are compared and analyzed, the results of the example verify the rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Cooperative Operation Strategy for Home Management Systems with Smart Appliances
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart appliances, home management system (HMS) becomes an essential system for the end users to interact with the distribution system operator (DSO). HMS can manage the smart household appliances owned by of the residents reasonably through the intelligent human-computer interface according to their personal preferences, so as to reduce the electricity bills and satisfy the diversified demand. In this paper, a two-stage optimization framework is proposed to realize the collaborative operation between the DSO and end users. The first stage aims to assess the flexibility offered by the end users and the second stage is designed to minimize the operation cost of the distribution network while protecting the interests and privacy of the end users. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach is verified through numerical studies on a 24-bus distribution system.

articleTitle: Multi-Scenario Voltage Optimization using Load Profiling
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The load profiling method and the coordinated dispatching of active-reactive power are combined for voltage optimization in this paper. Load profiling aims to find out the typical pattern of the customs and has been widely used in the demand-side response, where only the active power is considered and it is usually a one-dimensional time series. With both active and reactive power considered, the load pattern then includes multiple angles of information in its scopes. To reveal such knowledge into the system operation, a machine learning based classification method combining the supervised and unsupervised learning can identify the typical load pattern on each node from big data by classifying them into a small number of groups. These typical patterns can therefore form the boundary condition for the voltage optimization, which can be sampled using the Monte Carlo simulation to form multiple scenarios. Then, a more accurate operation model of coordinated dispatching of active-reactive power is introduced in the voltage optimization considering the renewable energy source, the energy storage system and the controllable load. One step further, such a multi-scenario operation method can be used to facilitate power system planning, such as the voltage evaluation and the reactive power compensation, as this study briefly outlooks.

articleTitle: Research on Text Classification Method of Distribution Network Terminal Debugging Job Based on Hierarchical Comprehensive Context
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Since a lot of historical operation description texts in the distribution network terminal automation system, and there is a lack of classification efficiency and accuracy between manual classification and traditional text classification methods. In order to realize the effective classification of job text information, a neural network classification model based on hierarchical comprehensive context is constructed by using the features of debugging job text of distribution network terminal. By combining LSTM network with temporal convolution network and combining residual and attention mechanism, context information is extracted and integrated with original input. Hierarchical extraction of content and deep semantic features and long-term history fuzzy information recording are realized. The experiment on the text data set of distribution network terminal debugging operation shows that this method has better optimization effect than CNN and TCN model under the selected evaluation indexes. The model can extract the defect content and sequence information more comprehensively, realize the accurate automatic classification of debugging text, effectively improve the intelligent level of distribution network terminal debugging, and promote the application of text processing technology in power grid.

articleTitle: Rapid Frequency Response Backup Planning and Decision Making with Risk Differentiation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To cope with the new situation of frequency stability in power systems, reserved capacities for fast frequency response are set, which can establish a reserved scheme for the events threatening system frequency security. Focusing on the system's transient processes after the accident, as well as quantifying the scope of risk concern, which, can avoid underestimating the risk of accident deterioration based on the power shortage in the total fault set. The equipment statuses are simulated based on the stochastic production simulation approach. Furthermore, on the basis of the traditional cost-benefit analyses method, the frequency dynamic simulation analysis is used as a means to capture the seconds-level dynamic changes; the attention degree to different levels of accidents is realized by considering the risk preference. The analyses of case studies show that the superiority of the proposed reserved capacity planning scheme of fast frequency response considering risk preference. It can reflect the operators' attention degree to different events in the decision-making processes, and effectively avoid the risk homogenization of traditional scheme based on the total fault set. At the same time, the more the scope of event attention tends to be rare, the higher reserved capacity demand for fast frequency response.

articleTitle: A Frequency Adaptive Repetitive Control for Active Power Filter with SiC-MOSFET Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Active power filters (APFs) with repetitive control (RC) could compensate for the harmonics. However, there are some problems in IGBT-380V-APFs with RC, such as the adaptability of grid frequency varying because of the non-integer value of RC parameters. SiC-MOSFETs that could reach high switching frequency provide a new way to increase the compensation accuracy and the frequency adaptability for 380V/APFs. In this paper, a novel frequency adaptive fast repetitive control (FAF-RC) for APF with SiC-MOSFET inverter to achieve optimal performance in variable frequency girds through changing RC order N was proposed. Taking the advantage of the high switching and sampling frequency of SiC-APF, the control method proposed with low computational complexity could compensate the harmonics more accurately with less software debugging. The control method with 50kHz switching and sampling frequency is described, designed, and verified experimentally in a two-level APF prototype made up of SiC-MOSFETs. The results obtained that 380V/75A-SiC-APFs with the control method proposed and volume of 37L (that 66% of IGBT-APFs) have a high compensation accuracy (THD<5%) with the grid frequency variations.

articleTitle: Short-term PV Power Forecasting Based on Time-Phased and Error Correction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The uncertainty of PV output power brings a series of scheduling operation problems, and accurate prediction of PV output power is an effective means to reduce the influence of uncertainty. A short-term PV power prediction method based on time-phased and error correction is proposed. The representative meteorological factors selected by GRA are used to classify the days to be predicted, and the improved sparrow search algorithm (CMSSA) is used to optimize the Elman model, and Elman, CMSSA-Elman, and CMSSA-Elman error correction models are established to select different prediction models for power prediction for different weather types. The results show that the method proposed in this paper has obvious improvement in the accuracy of PV system output power prediction for different weather conditions and has some practical value.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis Based on Virtual Power Plant's Optimal Bidding Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid construction of spot market for electricity in China, there is a general trend that renewable energy participates in the electricity market. In order to analyze the economics of virtual power plant (VPP), this paper proposes an optimal bidding model based on the time-of-use power prices. Considering the prediction error distribution of wind power and solar power, which can be named as uncontrollable power sources (UPS), the method that three kinds of controllable power sources like energy storage, gas turbine and small hydropower station assume to reduce generation deviation of UPS is proposed and introduced to the optimization model. Based on the solution of the built linear programming model, the operating strategy and the economic analysis of VPPs combined with different power sources are investigated. The experimental results indicate that the economics of VPPs with different power sources are quite diverse.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning Method of Distributed Photovoltaic Access Distribution Network Based on Power Data
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to analyze the capacity of distributed photovoltaic access to rural 10kV overhead lines and reasonably determine the credible capacity of distributed photovoltaic access distribution transformers, based on the analysis of typical access modes and voltage deviation analysis, for radial overhead power grids, the nodes voltage deviation, the rated capacity of the line and the distribution transformer are constraints, and based on the topological relationship of the radial network, the correlation matrix of nodes and branches is constructed, and the method of solving the node voltage is optimized by applying matrix. Construct a distributed photovoltaic consumption capacity analysis model based on feeder distribution, and solve the model by particle swarm optimization algorithm for solving nonlinear programming problems. Finally, for typical calculation examples, the distributed photovoltaic capacity of each node is calculated. The results show that the model and method can assist the calculation of distributed photovoltaic consumption capacity based on feeder distribution, and provide planning guidance and construction reference for distributed photovoltaic access via overhead lines.

articleTitle: Distribution System Resilience Enhancement with Battery Swapping Stations of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Boosting a more resilient distribution system (DS) is becoming increasingly critical for severe damages and relevant impacts caused by extreme events. Enough batteries in battery swapping stations (BSSs) can be fully utilized to restore as many out-of-service loads as possible in the short time and to enhance DS resilience. In this paper, an optimization model is proposed for the post-disaster load restoration of DS with BSSs. The objective of this study is to minimize the total costs by coordinating BSSs with network reconfiguration. Especially, to exploit the benefits of BSSs to enable more loads pickup, the number of available batteries and available energy in BSSs are devised, which considers the effects of the varying EVs battery swapping demand. This service restoration model is formulated as a mixed-integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP) and solved via off-the-shelf solver. The proposed model is tested on a modified 33-bus system and the results demonstrate the feasibility of BSSs for DS resilience enhancement.

articleTitle: Economic Benefit Analysis of Residents' Smart Energy Use under the Background of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the main type of residents' energy consumption, electricity can better improve energy efficiency and facilitate the construction of “energy Internet” by providing smart energy use services to residents. Currently, developing smart energy use service for residents is plagued by problems such as unclear business model and ambiguous profit model. This paper built a cost-benefit model of smart energy use service for residents by power grid companies, and analyzed the cost and benefit of smart energy use service for residents by power grid companies through examples. The results showed that: (1) The key to developing smart energy use service for residents lies in the number of terminals accessing the smart energy platform; (2) Developing smart energy use service for resident users can bring benefits to multiple parties; (3) From the perspective of increasing profit, the power grid companies need to reduce costs and expanding the degree of aggregation of “virtual power plants”.

articleTitle: Variable-speed Pumped Hydro Storage Technology: Overview, Solutions and Case Studies
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the most mature and economical large-scale energy storage technology, pumped hydro storage is one of the important technical means to improve the flexibility of the grid and the penetration level of renewable energies. Compared to traditional constant-speed pumped hydro storage units, variable-speed pumped hydro storage units have obvious advantages in active power regulation and reactive power compensation under the pump operational mode, which thus better match the output fluctuations of renewable energies and absorb them. This paper evaluates the system configuration and operating characteristics of two technical solutions for variable-speed pumped hydro storage: Doubly-Fed Induction Machine (DFIM) and Converter-Fed Synchronous Machine (CFSM). A technical overview and comparison are described between constant-speed and two variable-speed solutions, DFIM and CFSM. Two case studies of CFSM application in Switzerland and Austria are also introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Power Command Allocation Strategy for Hybrid Energy Storage Participating in Secondary Frequency Modulation Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid energy storage system considering the internal power and capacity of the battery is proposed to assist the power grid to participate in the secondary frequency regulation power command allocation strategy.
