This strategy is proposed to solve the problem of frequency characteristics in the process of secondary frequency regulation assisted by energy storage system. In a hybrid energy storage system with lithium iron phosphate battery and lead carbon battery, firstly, establish a cost-benefit model between hybrid energy storage and units in the life-cycle model; then, use the lowpass filters to divide the internal signals of the hybrid energy storage system in the power allocation process. Establish a regional frequency modulation dynamic model, considering the power allocation instructions in the hybrid energy storage system, and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the filtering time constant. Taking the biggest benefit of frequency modulation as the objective function, and simulation verification in the cost-benefit model shows that the distribution strategy applied to the hybrid energy storage system can not only effectively improve the frequency modulation performance of the frequency modulation system, but also can increase the economic benefits of frequency modulation effectively.

articleTitle: Design on Business Strategy under Value Creation System of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The innovative development of Energy Internet is constantly changing and reshaping the development pattern of manufacturing and other related industries, bringing many emerging values to economic and social development. The value creation system in the field of energy Internet includes three parts: the value proposition derived from traditional value to emerging value, the value activities with emerging business as the main body, and the value realization with business model as the main focus, which makes it different from the value creation methods of traditional energy and electricity. And the business model is one of the key links of the energy Internet, is an important way and way to realize value. Based on the value theory and combined with the logic of energy Internet value creation and its business model, this paper deconstructs and analyzes the value creation system of energy Internet and puts forward the business model strategy under the value creation system. Three emerging values of energy transformation services, energy digital products, and energy platform ecology are identified and their corresponding three emerging business activities are identified. Thus, three business models under the value creation system of energy Internet are proposed: service-led, technology-driven, and platform ecology. This paper further adopts the existing business model design methodology, constructs a simplified business model strategy analysis and design method, proposes three business strategies of product, capital and operation. This paper innovatively constructs the energy Internet value creation system architecture, puts forward the business model strategy analysis framework, identifies the emerging value, emerging business and new business model, and provides direction and guidance for the energy Internet value creation and the emergence of business model.

articleTitle: Mini Review on Evaluation Methods of Battery Storage Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Battery storage power station has been widely used because of its high efficiency, wide operating temperature range and environmental friendliness. It's an important solution for the large-scale integration of renewable energy power. But failure of the battery can endanger facilities, personnel and the environment. Therefore, demand for accurate evaluation methods of battery storage power station is urgent. This paper reviewed the evaluation methods in force for battery storage power station. Physical-methods, data-driven methods and hybrid methods were introduced and discussed. Big data method and digital twin for evaluation were also conceived and discussed. Literatures related were summarized and analyzed in hope that providing a new perspective and inspiration for developing evaluation technology of battery storage power station.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Capability of Distribution Network Connected with Three-terminal Back-to-back Voltage Source Converter based MVDC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power load in the urban area has been rapid growth recently. However, some prominent problems occur when we use the traditional AC distribution network to transmit power to a high-density load area, such as insufficient power supply capacity, poor power quality, low reliability, large power losses, etc. Considering the requirements of the Zhengzhou Central Hospital distribution network, the three-terminal Back-to-back (BTB) Voltage Source Converter based Middle Voltage DC (VSC-MVDC) Transmission is adopted, and the comparison of the distribution network before and after the upgrade is made in this paper. Firstly, the three-terminal BTB VSC-MVDC interconnection device is added to build a DC hybrid distribution network. Thereafter, two models, which are the distribution network before and after the upgrade respectively, are established in PSD-BPA. Finally, the power quality, voltage stability and power supply reliability of the two kinds of distribution networks are simulated and compared. The results show that, after upgrade, a better power quality, a higher voltage stability and reliability of power supply are obtained.

articleTitle: High-Voltage Overhead Line Threading Board and Its Pulley State Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the current overhead line threading process, the status monitoring of the threading board and the pulley are generally performed by arranging construction personnel on the towers of the line section to observe. Usually, when an abnormal state occurs during the threading process, the construction personnel then contact the ground personnel and the pay-off operator on the side of the tensioner. This process will delay a lot of time, and failure to notify in time will cause even greater accidents, which will seriously affect construction efficiency. Based on the current construction status of overhead lines, this paper proposes a set of video pose monitoring systems for intelligent pulleys and threading boards. The system can obtain the video data of the pulley and the posture information of the threading board, and then transmit these data to the ground workstation in a point-to-point manner. The practice has proved that the system has high real-time performance, reliability, clear video images, long transmission distance, and easy installation. It can meet the on-site construction conditions and greatly improve on-site construction efficiency while ensuring the safety of on-site construction.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Control System for Micro Analog Synchronous Condenser Based on Synchronous Phasor Data
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A monitoring and control system of micro analog synchronous condenser based on synchronous phasor data includes: Micro analog synchronous motor, photoelectric encoder, light synchronous phasor measuring machine, microprocessor, power amplifier, dual channel controllable excitation power supply, network communication unit, liquid crystal display unit, relay unit, relay protection circuit and server master station. The microprocessor receives the synchronous phasor data in real time, and according to the control command of the server master station, it selectively executes the fixed power factor adjustment thread or the fixed reactive power adjustment thread. The calculation results in turn go through the digital analog converter, the power amplifier and the dual channel adjustable excitation power supply to complete the quantitative control of the output reactive power of the micro analog synchronous motor. The beneficial effects of the invention are: integrating the functions of real-time electrical information monitoring, input operation, cut-off operation and output reactive power (power factor) adjustment of the micro analog synchronous condenser, realizing the micro physical simulation of the real synchronous condenser of the power system.

articleTitle: Capacity Allocation Optimization Method for Integrated Energy Systems Based on Multi-energy Flow Balancing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of strong nonlinearity of the equipment model, this paper proposes a configuration optimization method based on energy flow balance. First, establish a non-linear fitting model of the equipment according to the system structure requirements, and then filter out the feasible capacity configuration range according to the constraint conditions, and use the finite enumeration method to perform uniform traversal. Under each configuration scheme, the equal micro-increment method is adopted, and the scheduling optimization calculation is performed based on the energy flow balance. Finally, the optimized configuration results are established. Taking an office building in a park as an example, the configuration calculation is performed using the method proposed in this paper and commercial solver. The results show that this method can better ensure the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: A New Control Strategy of MMC-Based Active Power Filter Under Non-Ideal Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to overcome the drawbacks of active power filters composed of cascaded H-bridge converter or other existing multi-level converters, the researches on the application of modular multilevel converter to shunt active power filters has gradually increased, but few articles study this topology from the control strategy applicable to various non-ideal conditions. This paper proposes a Lyapunov-Function-based control strategy for MMC-Based shunt active power filter (MMC-SAPF) with independent positive- and negative-sequence components, which can also be applied to the non-ideal conditions and flexibly select the compensation signal according to the capacity of the active power filter. First of all, the positive and negative order Lyapunov-Function-based control model under non-ideal conditions is established according to the topology of MMC-SAPF. Besides, the overall control scheme is also based on circulation current suppressing controllers, submodule capacitor voltage controllers, and a harmonics detection section, which can improve the comprehensive performance of this system. Finally, the Matlab/Simulink is used to verify the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed Lyapunov control strategy in non-ideal conditions based on the modular multilevel converter active filter.

articleTitle: Data Mid-platform Service System Design Method for Distributed New Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The data mid-platform service system of distributed new energy provides reliable and efficient data services for the grid integration of the distributed new energy business applications. In this paper, the data mid-platform service system design method is proposed for distributed new energy. Firstly, the scheduling and control function for distributed new energy is analyzed, which is the function basis of the data mid-platform service system. Then the data governance that can realize the sharing of data resources in various organizations and departments is designed in detail. Finally, the data mid-platform service system including the common data service components and the business data service components is proposed for distributed new energy, while detailed composition and structure are also elaborated.

articleTitle: Power Grid Security Risk Assessment Method Based on Weighted Voting Ensemble Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the scale of the power grid continues to increase, the risks of the power grid are increasing, which puts forward higher requirements for the accuracy and speed of the power grid security risk assessment. The traditional methods of power grid security risk assessment have large errors and long assessment time, so it is difficult to realize the online assessment of power grid security risk. With the development of artificial intelligence technology, the machine learning algorithm is applied to power grid security risk assessment. Power grid security risk assessment method based on machine learning algorithm has the fast assessment speed but poor assessment accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes a new power grid security risk assessment method based on weighted voting, which can greatly improve the assessment accuracy of machine learning algorithms while ensuring the assessment speed of the machine learning algorithm. The basic idea of the method is to use a variety of machine learning algorithms to evaluate the security risk of the power grid. The weight of the evaluation results of each machine learning algorithm is determined by simulating the referendum, and all kinds of algorithms are considered comprehensively, to improve the accuracy of the evaluation. Finally, to verify the feasibility of the proposed method, a regional power grid in China is taken as an example to verify. The results show that the proposed method can greatly improve the speed and accuracy of power grid security risk assessment, and has certain practical significance.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Coordinated Control Strategy for Hybrid Cascaded Systems With Large-scale Renewable Power Hierarchical Access
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the proportion of renewable energy generation, the sending power grid strength of the UHVDC transmission system becomes weaker, and the voltage stability problems may exist. In order to improve the voltage stability of the weak AC system, based on the hybrid cascaded UHVDC system with large-scale renewable power hierarchical access, the paper proposes a steady-state reactive power coordinated control strategy for the MMC (Modular Multilevel Converter) station and the wind farm to participate in the voltage regulation of the sending-end grid. The operating characteristics of the cascaded system, the reactive power support capacity of weak AC system and the factors that affect the reactive power support capacity of MMC under different operating conditions are analyzed respectively. In order to solve the problem that MMC is weak in reactive power support for weak AC system at full or near full load, an improved control strategy to expand the reactive power limit of MMC is proposed, and the related parameters of the improved control strategy are designed. Simulation examples show that the proposed control strategy can effectively support the voltage of weak AC system and improve the voltage stability of AC system.

articleTitle: Economic Performance of 100% Renewable Energy System for Residential Community in China
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The 100% renewable energy system (100% RES) meets the cooling, heating and electrical demands of users without consuming fuel energy. It is becoming increasing popular recently. Its performance is affected by many factors such as the local renewable energy resources, weather and users' loads. This paper studies the economic performance of 100% RES in typical regions of China. The optimization method for residential 100% RES is proposed and the performance of the 100% RES in different regions of China is analyzed. Totally 30 typical cities located in different regions are chosen in this paper according to the distribution characteristics of renewable energy and climates to establish residential 100% RES. The total annual cost is taken as the optimization objective and Genetic Algorithm (GA) is taken as optimization method to obtain the optimal design of the 100% renewable energy system in each area. The characteristics and performance of the 100% RES are compared and the impact of the energy market and load characteristic is analyzed. The result shows that the residential 100% RES is feasible in China and the payback period of system is less than 12 years in most cities. The load density, the cost of PV/T and biogas have great impact on the economic performance of the 100% RES while the cost of wind turbine has little effect on the economic performance of the system.

articleTitle: Power System Node Voltage Control Method Based on Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The stable operation of the power system is the basis of the development of the national economy. Once a large-scale blackout occurs in the power system, such as voltage collapse, it will cause significant economic losses and bad social impact. Uoltage collapse is usually a chain process, which is first manifested by the continuous decrease of grid voltage and the continuous deterioration of system operating conditions. If effective voltage adjustment measures are not taken in time, extensive chain tripping may occur and eventually lead to the disintegration and collapse of the whole power system. Therefore, taking voltage control measures quickly and effectively plays an important role in preventing voltage collapse. In order to solve the above problems, based on the in-depth analysis of Newton-Raphson power flow calculation method, the sensitivity model of node voltage to each control variable is established. In order to realize the fast and effective regulation of node voltage and reduce the operating pressure of dispatchers, a linear optimization model of node voltage based on sensitivity is further established in this paper. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm is verified by the IEEE-14 node system. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper can not only give the sensitivity coefficient of node voltage to each reactive power compensation node, provide decision support for dispatchers, but also automatically give the optimal reactive power compensation regulation capacity, which could effectively reduce the operating pressure of dispatchers and ensure that the grid voltage runs in a safe and reasonable range.

articleTitle: Day-ahead and Intraday Optimal Dispatch Schedule for MGT-IES Considering the Dynamic Characteristics of Main Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The traditional dispatch for micro gas turbine-based integrated energy system (MGT-IES) is mainly conducted based on the static characteristics of the main equipment, which cannot guarantee that the actual output of the system meets its demand. In this paper, the closed-loop dynamic model is introduced to describe the dynamic characteristics of main equipment in MGT-IES and transformed into constraints for dispatch. Furthermore, the day-ahead and intraday scheduling framework based on model predictive control (MPC) method is established to minimize the daily operation and maintenance cost and solved as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) problem. A case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed day-ahead and intraday dispatch model considering the dynamic characteristics of the main equipment with better matching between demand and actual supply.

Author Keywords: Micro gas turbine-based integrated energy system (MGT-IES)

articleTitle: A Neutral Point Overvoltage Suppression Method Based on Backstepping Control with DC Suppression
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The treatment of the neutral point is essential for the distribution networks. The resonant grounding system (RGS) is prone to generate the neutral point overvoltage caused by the low reactance of the arc suppression coil (ASC), which harms the operation of equipment and personal safety. The traditional passive neutral point overvoltage suppression strategies have poor adaptability, which do not meet the demands of increasing complexity of the distribution network lines. Therefore, we present a neutral point overvoltage suppression method based on backstepping control (BSC) with DC suppression. The BSC that prevents perturbation of system parameters achieves the neutral point overvoltage suppression. A DC suppression loop is constructed to realize the injection current DC suppression of the cascaded H-bridge (CHB) inverter, which is directly connected to the neutral point of the distribution networks. Simulation results verifies the effectiveness of neutral point overvoltage suppression based on BSC and the feasibility of DC suppression of injection current.

articleTitle: Global Maximum Power Point Tracking Algorithm Based on Model Calculation for Photovoltaic Array
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Partial shading is an unavoidable problem that results in multiple peaks in output characteristics of photovoltaic array, which brings a challenge to the maximum power tracking method. Most of the existing methods need to sample the full or part of the voltage range to obtain the global maximum power point, resulting in slow tracking speed and power loss during sampling. Therefore, this paper proposes a global maximum power point tracking strategy based on model calculation from the perspective of directly determining the optimal output voltage. Based on the analysis of the output characteristics of photovoltaic array under partial shading conditions, this paper establishes a new mathematical model to calculate the voltage and power at each power peak point. When the environmental conditions change, the voltage at the global maximum power point can be directly obtained according to the established mathematical relationship, so that the global maximum power point can be quickly reached by directly controlling the output voltage. To verify the performance of the proposed method, simulations have been carried out in Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Simulation and Case Comparison of Fast Frequency Response of Wind Farm Station
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Considering the frequency control strategy from the station level is the optimal scheme to solve the primary frequency regulation of wind farm. In order to verify and compare the effectiveness and practicability of the existing wind farm station level frequency modulation control methods, this paper established the simulation model of permanent magnet synchronous generators wind turbine and wind farm. The simulation results showed that the performance of wind farm participating in the primary frequency modulation of power grid through hierarchical coordination control method is better than the other two control methods: the response lag time is less than 1s, the response time is less than 3s, and the regulation time is shorter within 4s. Finally, this paper built a wind farm station frequency fast response control system, and applied the existing three station-level frequency modulation control methods to the system. The practicability and effectiveness of the three control methods were verified and compared in the field of a 50MW wind farm. This provides theoretical guidance and experimental basis for the subsequent upgrade and transformation of fast frequency response control devices.

articleTitle: Electricity Price Package Design Strategy Considering User's Independent Choice Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the gradual opening of the electricity-selling market, electricity-sellers need to formulate electricity price packages to meet the differentiated electricity needs of users and guide users to actively participate in grid peak shaving. In order to solve the user satisfaction problem of different electricity consumption habits and maximize the profit of electricity sales, this paper proposes a new type of electricity price package formulation strategy based on the characteristics of users' independent choice behavior and tending to be better. The K-means algorithm is used to cluster analysis of power user load characteristic curves, and various typical user load characteristic curves are generated to characterize the power consumption habits of different power users; a utility model is constructed to quantify the satisfaction of users' choices; The user selection probability model is used to maximize the utility to determine the probability of users with different electricity consumption habits choosing packages. The cost and risk model of the retail e-commerce company was formulated, and the self-selection behavior of users and the cost and risk of the e-commerce retailer were constrained, and the profit maximization of the e-commerce retailer was the optimization goal.

articleTitle: Long Term Optimal Scheduling of Large Scale Renewable Energy Integration System Considering Multiple Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The multiple uncertainties of wind, photovoltaic and hydropower are very challenge to the long-term optimal scheduling of large-scale renewable energy grid-connected systems. In order to address this problem, a long-term optimal operation theory method based on quantile nonlinear regression theory and fuzzy chance theory is proposed. Aiming at the unpredictability of wind and photovoltaic output, a nonlinear quantile regression model between the long term forecast value and the actual value of wind and output is established, and the risk caused by directly applying the deterministic results to the power system dispatching is avoided. In addition, in view of the problem of errors caused by insufficient historical data for natural inflows, the reservoir storage capacity at the beginning of the dispatch cycle is regarded as a trapezoidal fuzzy quantity to describe the uncertainty in hydropower operation. And through equivalent conversion, the fuzzy chance constraint is transformed into a deterministic model for solving. Finally, the proposed approach is tested in a large-scale renewable energy integration case with 3 cascade hydropower stations, 1 wind farm and 1 photovoltaic power station and a few thermal power units. The numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method can cope with multiple uncertainties of various renewable energy sources in long term scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on the Stability Strategy of Weak Grid of Photovoltaic Grid Connected Inverter based on MPC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a model predictive control (MPC) algorithm for the stability control of Photovoltaic grid-connected inverters in weak grid. In the case of weak grid, the stability of inverter is greatly reduced because the grid impedance can not be ignored, and the effect is greatly reduced. Therefore, this paper will study the stability mechanism of three-phase grid connected inverter in weak grid, establish a wide band model, and compare and analyze the stability of traditional PI control and model predictive control under PLL interference in weak grid. The simulation model of three-phase grid connected inverter is built by using MATLAB / Simulink. The simulation and experimental results show that the difference between the output voltage and the given voltage of the proposed algorithm is significantly smaller than that of the traditional PI control algorithm in the case of weak grid, which improves the output voltage quality of the inverter and greatly improves the stability of the output voltage.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Energy Storage Evaluation Method Under Multiple Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With a large amount of clean energy connected to the power grid, energy storage plays an increasingly important role in the power system. There are various types of energy storage, and different types of energy storage have different characteristics and thus suitable for different application scenarios. There are many factors to be considered in the evaluation of energy storage. The traditional evaluation method relies too much on experience and is highly subjective. In this paper, a quantitative energy storage evaluation method suitable for different scenarios is proposed, and the evaluation index of energy storage is established from four major indexes: economic index, technical performance index, environmental impact index and grid related index. Z-score standardization method was adopted to standardize the score value, and the weight was selected by judgment matrix method. Finally, the score of energy storage in the current scene was obtained. The validity of the method is verified by a numerical example, which provides some reference for the selection of energy storage types in the future power system.

articleTitle: Research on Spray Cooling of Power Battery Emergency Thermal Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the central component of electric vehicles, the thermal safety of power batteries has received much attention. An emergency thermal management system is proposed for power batteries, in which refrigerant is injected onto the surface of overheated batteries directly. The effects of spray time, interval time and number of cycles are analyzed. Results show that: the manifold has a strong cooling capacity, and the reduced temperature of battery can be 65 °C in seconds; the cooling capacity of system increases with the increase of spray time, but too long spray time will reduce the utilization efficiency of refrigerant; extending the interval time and reducing the cycle number of pulse injection can effectively improve the utilization efficiency of refrigerant while ensuring the cooling capacity of the system.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Cycles

articleTitle: Real-Time Simulation Modeling for ±535kV High Voltage DC Breaker Applied in Flexible DC Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The flexible DC grid has great advantages in the integration of new energy into the power system. As a key equipment of the DC grid, high voltage DCB (Direct Current Breaker) could isolate transmission lines or converter stations quickly when fault occurred, is an important guarantee for reliable and safe power supply of the DC power grid. There are three different type DCBs used in Zhangbei flexible DC grid project, are hybrid, negative voltage coupling, and mechanical respectively. In this article, it is first introduced the topological and action sequence of the three type ± 535kV DCBs. Then theoretically analyzed three RTDS(Real-time Digital Simulator) based modeling method for the above three type DCBs, they are large step modeling, small step modeling, and GPES (General Power Electronic Solver) modeling, and established models for 3 type ± 535kV DCBs based on these three different modeling methods. Finally, the breaking characteristics of the DCB model are simulated and studied. The result shows the small step equivalent model could reflect ± 535kV DCB breaking characteristics with the high accuracy. Based on this result, by simulating DC line ground fault, the breaking characteristics of the DC circuit breaker model under 25kA fault current were simulated and verified.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Systems Security Assessment Based on Belief Rule Base Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an evidence-based reasoning algorithm and BRB safety assessment method by analyzing the characteristics of endogenous and exogenous factors of safety impact. Firstly, expert knowledge is used to construct a model based on integrated energy system safety assessment, and different safety assessment indicators are selected according to the different factors, then ER algorithm is used to fuse the safety indicators and factors in integrated energy system safety assessment to obtain internal safety and external safety values, and then BRB is used to build the model and covariance matrix adaptive strategy (CMA-ES) algorithm is used to optimize the initial parameters of the model to obtain the final model. The risk management of integrated energy system depends on the results of risk assessment to determine the subsequent risk control and approval activities, so that the system can accurately “position” the strategy, practice and tool of risk management.

articleTitle: Study on the Voltage Sequence of Urban DC Distribution Network for Integrated Power Supply and Renewable Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: DC distribution network has a fabulous future due to the advantages of high reliability, strong power supply capacity, long power supply distance, and obvious economic advantages. However, there are few research on the study of DC distribution network voltage sequences, considering the accommodation of traditional AC distribution network. Therefore, this paper proposed a reasonable DC distribution network voltage sequence based on the study of AC distribution accommodation and renewable energy access. Firstly, a method for constructing a DC distribution voltage sequence was proposed based on a typical scenario of a harmonious urban DC distribution network. Secondly, the DC low-voltage sequences were determined according to the survey and development. Moreover, a comprehensive evaluation model for the medium voltage level was established, accounting for the economy, power supply capacity, reliability, and adaptability. Finally, the rationality of the proposed voltage level sequence ± 0.048kV/0.19kV /0.38kV /0.75kV /1.5kV /10kV was validated by a reasonable constraint.

articleTitle: Research on Unit Commitment Optimization Based on Discrete Differential Evolution and Quadratic Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Unit commitment is a typical complex multi-constraint and non-linear optimization problem in power system dispatch. With the expansion of the scale of the power system, the thermal power unit combination has problems such as low accuracy and difficulty in solving. In response to these problems, this paper proposes an algorithm that combines discrete differential evolution and quadratic programming to solve hierarchically. First, the upper-level problem uses Discrete Differential Evolution (DDE) to solve the start-stop state of the unit. In the process of solving, replace the randomly generated initial value with the startup evaluation value, and repair the unit status based on the principle of “non-stop, only startup, and priority startup of large-capacity units”. In order to further optimize the performance of the discrete differential evolution algorithm and prevent particles from falling into the local area, an adaptive strategy is adopted to update the mutation factor and other parameters. In addition, a new mutation strategy is adopted in the discrete differential evolution to balance the early development ability and the later exploration ability. Then the lower-level problem uses Quadratic Programming (QP) to carry out economic dispatch for the units that meet the constraint conditions such as the start and stop time of the unit. Finally, a system of 10 to 100 computers is used for simulation analysis. The experimental results show that the algorithm has fast convergence speed, high solution accuracy, and good robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Optimization of “Optical Storage Charging and Swap” Power Station Based on Robust Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at problems such as poor user experience of electric vehicles, high charging costs, and excessive supply pressure on the distribution network, this paper establishes a robust optimization model that takes into account the random characteristics of uncertain variables, power station operating costs, and environmental protection. The model is based on a set of uncertainties constrained by classification probability and opportunity to achieve an accurate description of the operation of the power station. At the same time, through the reasonable setting of the load reserve coefficient and the number of uncertain variables, the robust system is not subject to external changes and continues to maintain a stable state. Finally, the dual theory is used to decouple the robust model, and the relaxation algorithm is used to solve iteratively. Taking an optical storage charging and swapping station as an example, the correctness of the proposed model and method is verified.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Smart Energy Optimization Control Strategies for Household Users
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the promotion of the energy transition and the continuous improvement of people's living standards, the surge in residential electricity consumption has caused the seasonal peak load to become increasingly prominent. Promoting residents' load to participate in the regulation of the power grid is of great significance to alleviating the seasonal power supply shortage and improving the quality and efficiency of the power grid. Based on the current status of the energy optimization service market and the business development of State Grid, the architecture of the smart energy optimization control strategies design suitable for household users' participation is summarized. The system considers the demand response and auxiliary services of the power market, the best energy efficiency in the power supply district management, and the lowest residential energy cost. It is closer to the actual application, can achieve effective resource allocation and energy saving optimization.

articleTitle: Modular Solution of Steady-State Values for Small-signal Model of MMC-MTDC System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) based multi-terminal direct current (MTDC) system has attracted much attentions. MMC-MTDC may contain many MMCs and has large amount of state variables. In order to establish the small-signal model for stability analysis of MMC-MTDC, the steady-state values of state variables of the whole MTDC must be obtained. The current method is to solve all nonlinear equations at one time. However, the large amount of state variables and diverse control strategies of MTDC lead to much programming work and difficulty in solving too many nonlinear equations of the whole MTDC at one time. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a modular algorithm based on alternating iteration to obtain the steady-state values of the whole MTDC. Based on modularity idea, the algorithm takes single MMC in MTDC as the basic unit for solving the steady-state values of state variables. Each iteration only invokes the fsovle functions in Matlab for several typical control modes of MMC. The algorithm reduces the order of the equation group and computation burden, and meanwhile it makes it easy to modify state variables in single fsolve function. Finally, MMC-MTDC system under different control strategies is constructed in Simulink to validate the accuracy and correctness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Assessment of Reactive Power Reserve for DC Continuous Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Real-time assessment of the risk of continuous commutation failure of the thyristor-based phase-controlled commutation direct current transmission system (LCC-HVDC) and timely preventive control measures are of great significance to ensure the safe and stable operation of the large power grid. This paper proposes a method for evaluating effective dynamic reactive power reserve of generators to deal with DC continuous commutation failure. The maximum reactive power increment of the generator corresponding to the secondary drop of the converter bus voltage is defined as the effective dynamic reactive power reserve. The effective dynamic reactive power reserve at the critical point is called the maximum effective dynamic reactive power reserve. When the system dynamic reactive power reserve is less than the reserve capacity threshold, a two-stage preventive control measure searching method is adopted. First, increase the terminal voltage of the generator and the static reactive power compensation. If the requirements are still not met, the start-up unit measures will be adopted. An example of an actual power grid verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Theoretical Research and Development Prospect of Urban Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Urban Energy Internet is the concrete practice of Energy Internet on the city side, and it is also the core to ensure the reliable and efficient operation of Smart City. In the world, many cities have taken the lead in exploring the development model of Urban Energy Internet. This paper starts with the concept of the Urban Energy Internet, proposes that the Urban Energy Internet is a “three-dimensional integrated” smart energy system. We clarify the main characteristics of the Urban Energy Internet and analyze the relationship between the Urban Energy Internet and the Smart City. At last, we look forward to the future development of the Urban Energy Internet. All these researches are of great significance to built the modern energy system and the Smart City.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Integrated Grounding Grid of Substation and Energy Storage Station
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Using substation site resources and allocating certain energy storage can effectively realize peak shaving and valley filling. In this paper, the integration construction scheme of new energy storage stations in a 35kV substation in Shanghai and the grounding grid model of substation and energy storage stations are proposed. The safety of integrated grounding grid is related to grounding resistance, contact voltage and step voltage. The safety parameters are calculated according to the original data and design specifications, and the safety limits are obtained. Based on CDEGS software, the model of integrated grounding network is constructed, and the safety evaluation of integrated grounding system is carried out. In order to meet the safety requirements, the integrated grounding network is optimized by adding conductors in the ring network and changing the compression ratio, which finally meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Establishing The Photovoltaic Output Model With PIC-LS-SVM Based on Curve Characteristic Index Dimensionality Reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to cope with the challenges brought by large-scale photovoltaic grid connection to grid dispatching, a PIC-LS-SVM model is proposed to calculate photovoltaic output. Firstly, this paper select the characteristic indicators of the photovoltaic power generation output curve, and use the PIC clustering algorithm to cluster the original data into different training sets. Secondly, it perform correlation and principal component analysis on the meteorological data in each training set, extract comprehensive meteorological factors, and determine the category of the test data according to the characteristics of the comprehensive meteorological factors. Finally, the LS-SVM algorithm is used to calculate the PV output value of the test data. The PIC-LS-SVM algorithm can obtain good results in the calculation of photovoltaic output value, and the application of the algorithm to the establishment of photovoltaic output model is feasible.

articleTitle: Decentralized Optimization of Transmission and Distribution System with Wind-Photovoltaic-Hydro Coordination
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The large fluctuation of wind and photovoltaic (PV) power generation leads to the problem of insufficient stability and reliability when it is connected to the power grid. It is an important method to use the complementary characteristics of wind, PV and hydro power generation to stabilize the fluctuation of its total output. This paper studies the coordinated optimal operation of wind, PV and hydro resources, and proposes a co-optimization model of wind, PV and hydro resources under the coordination of transmission and distribution network. In order to protect the privacy of transmission network and distribution network, and reduce the computational burden of dispatching center, a decentralized solution strategy based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is introduced to solve the proposed model. In addition, to ensure the convergence of the decentralized algorithm, the second-order cone relaxation method is used to transform the power flow model of distribution network into a convex optimization model. The results show that the wind, PV and hydro coordinated optimization and the cooperation between transmission network and distribution network can effectively reduce the overall power fluctuation and promote the renewable energy consumption. The accuracy and convergence of the proposed decentralized algorithm are also verified.

Author Keywords: coordination of transmission and distribution network

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Station Modeling and coordinated Controller Closed-Loop Test Based on RTDS
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the background of building a new generation of power system with new energy as the main body, integrated energy stations have become one of the development trends of future power systems. As the key equipment of the integrated energy station, the coordination controller plays an important role in controlling and commanding. In order to support the construction of the integrated energy station, this paper conducts research on the modeling technology of the electrical part of the integrated energy station and the testing technology of the coordinated controller. Firstly, the main elements and networking forms of the electrical part of the integrated energy station are introduced. Secondly, based on RTDS, a comprehensive energy station electrical model containing multiple elements was built, and an information interaction scheme between RTDS and the coordination controller was designed to form a closed-loop test system between RTDS and the coordination controller. Finally, on the basis of this closed-loop system, simulation tests were carried out on the one-key start and stop, primary frequency modulation and backup power supply functions of the coordinated controller. The simulation results verify the functions of the coordinated controller, and the research results in this paper can provide references for the construction of integrated energy stations.

articleTitle: Research on Pretreatment Technology of Thermal Power Unit Operating Parameters Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the gradual deepening of the degree of digital transformation of power plants, the scale of data generated in the production link of power plants is increasing day by day. The traditional data processing mode has been difficult to meet the processing requirements of massive data. How to efficiently process the huge scale of data is one of the important problems faced by power enterprises. This paper first introduces the application of big data in the power industry. Then, according to the characteristics of big data, a large-scale data preprocessing method based on Spark data processing engine is proposed. Finally, the validity of data processing and the speed advantage of distributed computing platform in data processing are verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Volume Calculation for Power Equipment Point Cloud Based on Concave Hull Slice Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Calculation of volume has great influence on the measurement of power equipment. However, it is difficult to measure the volume of complex equipment in the electric power industry. To solve this problem, an improved volume calculation method based on adaptive concave slice method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the point cloud slices are obtained by adaptive slicing along the coordinate axis. Then, the k-nearest neighbor method is used to search the outer boundary contour of the slice to obtain the concave polygon, which calculates the area of the polygon and the volume of the slice. Finally, the overall volume of the point cloud is obtained by summing up the volume of all slices. The experimental results show that the method is effective for the calculation of complex power equipment.

articleTitle: Soft Lookup False Data Matching Method for Estimating Suspect SCADA Data -NR Grid Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power System operator's real time decisions depend on available Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) measurement systems. Under external disturbances like failure in Fiber Optic (FO) cables, measurement transducers etc., an operator may get inaccurate data displayed. To ensure reliable operation of the power grid under such cases (including unknown network topology), this paper proposes an interpretable data-driven model Soft Lookup False data Matching (SLFM) through Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) for estimating missing/suspected SCADA data values. Numerical experiments conducted on one of the utilities of the Northern Region of the Indian Grid with real-time data of SCADA and Meter of PoC (Point of Connection) feeders for four different cases and compared the results with LSTM (Long Short Term Memory) Autoencoder model. The experimental results demonstrated the better performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Assessment of No-Load Closing of Transmission Lines Based on Improved Line Model and Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The switching operation in the process of power grid restoration will cause over-voltage problems and affect the restoration process of power system. This paper presents an analysis method by establishing a dual-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pi$</tex> equivalent model of the transmission line and solving the specific analytical expression of switching overvoltage. Furthermore, the key factors affecting overvoltage are analyzed, and the method to determine the most serious overvoltage value based on ant colony algorithm is given. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the test of a 330kV five node transmission network model on PSCAD platform. The simulation results show that this method can greatly shorten the assessment time, realize the online assessment of electromagnetic transient risk, and ensure the fast and efficient recovery of power grid and load.

articleTitle: Realization of Security and Stability Adaptive Emergency Control Device Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, with the requirements of lean power grid operation and control, the typical off-line strategy is formulated based on conservative principles. The actual grid structure with its changeable power flow mode faces risks of over-control, under-control and even strategy mismatch. Urgent improvement is required to achieve optimization between control security and economic efficiency. Therefore, this paper proposes a realization method of strategy adaptive SSC (security and stability control) device based on PLC (Programmable Logic Controller). Firstly, the structure and composition of the new device are introduced, including PLC strategy processor, frontend data processor, device sampling and output. Secondly, the implementation method of adaptive module is constructed by utilizing PLC logic analysis method from three aspects: ordinary strategy module, offline strategy table module and complex customization strategy. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the method are illustrated through the pilot application of the adaptive emergency control system of Guizhou Power Grid of China and its related application scenarios of each module.

articleTitle: An Island Partitioning Method of Distribution Network Considering the V2G Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, an island partitioning method of distribution network considering the V2G (vehicle to grid) effect is proposed. The main purpose of the model is to maximize the load recovery. The model considers not only the role of conventional distributed generations, but also the V2G effect of virtual EV (electric vehicle) cluster and exchange station. In the aspect of solution, in order to improve the global optimization ability of genetic algorithm, this paper uses the characteristics of randomness and stability tendency of cloud model to improve the traditional genetic algorithm. This method takes the role of tie switches into consideration, expands the scope of feasible region, and makes the island partitioning scheme more flexible. The PG&E 69 bus system with multiple DGs (distributed generations), virtual EV cluster and exchange station is used to verify the proposed method, and a reasonable island partitioning scheme is obtained, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Protection Scheme of an Integrated Photovoltaic and Type 3 Wind Turbines System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy sources into power grids has been driven by the rapid growth of renewable technologies and economic benefits. Among various renewable generation sources, photovoltaic (PV) and wind energy have grown faster than others. Normally most installations use the same type of renewables integrated into a collector bus. In this paper a system with different renewables, PVs and Type 3 wind turbine generators (WTG) integrated into the same collector bus is proposed for the greater usage of the renewable energy sources, especially in a resource rich area. Averaged voltage source converter model is adopted to implement PV and Type 3 WTG systems. The real power characteristic of the PV site with daily insolation and temperature variation in steady-state is investigated with the simulation in RTDS/RSCAD and data post-processed in MATLAB. An overcurrent protection scheme using symmetrical components is applied on the collector feeder of the integrated PVs and Type 3 WTGs system. Good performance is shown with the simulation results of the system response to unbalanced and balanced faults. The protection scheme is also verified with the fault responses when different wind speeds are among WTGs, and the same protection performance is achieved.

articleTitle: A visualization Method about the Dataset of Energy Disaggregation for exploratory Research
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In machine learning studies, we default to an equal probability distribution for each category, which means that if we look at the whole dataset, the number of occurrences of each category in any given period of time is similar, or at least at the same quantitative level. As one of the classification problems, the research of energy disaggregation related to the problem of class imbalance in the dataset is still vacant. In this paper, we try to explore the unbalanced situation of categories in large datasets of the energy disaggregation research, and on the basis of removing the restriction of the number of input variables in the application of Karnaugh Map, we put forward a visualization scheme, which can enable researchers to effectively interpret the equilibrium situation of various categories in the datasets, to choose the appropriate datasets or optimize datasets according to the requirements.

articleTitle: Finite State Based Model Predictive Control Method for MMC-UPQC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper reports finite state based model predictive control method for unified power quality conditioner based on modular multilevel converter. This control reverses and optimizes bridge arm sub-modules conducting number through the output as well as change trend, which can narrow control set to greatly and reduce the computation. Since unified power quality conditioner based on modular multilevel converter needs to control both voltage and current quality, multi-step control is adopted in proposed control at the same time to achieve better control effect. After analysis and calculation, finite state based model predictive control method proposed has a small amount of calculation and excellent dynamic and static characteristics compared with other predictive control. Voltage and current can be restored by this control method in the case of voltage imbalance, transient, harmonic wave, etc.

Author Keywords: finite state based model predictive control method

articleTitle: Potential Evaluation of Large-Scale Electric Vehicle Demand Response Resources Based on K-means+LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The potential evaluation of large-scale electric vehicle demand response resources is an important prerequisite for Regional Integrated Energy Systems to carry out supply-demand interaction and optimal scheduling. However, most of the existing work does not use real charging data to analyze the demand response potential of electric vehicles. Thus, this paper proposes a large-scale electric vehicle demand response resource potential evaluation method based on the K-means+LSTM network. First, use the real data of a large-scale charging pile in an area to analyze the typical electricity consumption patterns of large-scale electric vehicle users through a cluster analysis; secondly, analyze the time period during which the complete charging events of each electric vehicle user are concentrated through a second clustering. Determine the aggregate capacity of electric vehicles that can participate in demand response every hour, finally establish an LSTM neural network model, train and test the proposed prediction model with the clustered data set, and use an area as an example to predict the scale of different time periods in the future the total potential value of electric vehicles that can participate in demand response. It is verified by examples that the model can be used as one of the reference -basis for determining the load reduction of each user, and it also provides key technical support for the subsequent formulation of an orderly charging and discharging optimization control strategy for electric vehicles and optimizing the coordinated operation of the Regional Integrated Energy System.

Author Keywords: long and short-term memory neural network

articleTitle: Simulation of Servo Control System for a Heavy Gas Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to study the control system of gas turbine, the simple mathematical model and control model of gas turbine servo system are established. Taking GE 9E gas turbine as the research object, the related simulation tests of TNH, power, IGV system and each fuel control loop system are carried out. The simulation results show that the servo control system model established in this paper can accurately reflect each control loop and IGV in the gas turbine operating conditions, and in line with the actual operation law of gas turbine, has a good research and reference value.

articleTitle: Research on Junction Temperature Exaction of Power Electronic Devices Based on Voltage Rise Period Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the abrupts/maximum junction temperature of the power device is mainly concerned, which generally occurs in the turn-off process, that is, the parameters in the turn-off process are usually used as temperature-sensitive electrical parameters (TSEPs) to detect the junction temperature, including the voltage rising process and the current falling process. The influence of junction temperature on the process of voltage rise and current fall is demonstrated through the SABER simulation experiment and H-bridge inverter circuit. Besides, the mechanism of junction temperature dependence in these two stages is also paid attention to. The analysis results show that the influence of junction temperature on the voltage rise process is more significant than that of the current fall process during the turn-off process. The actual experimental results show that the voltage rise period parameters (voltage rise time/voltage rise loss) can be used as TSEPs for high precision junction temperature detection.

articleTitle: Prediction and Control Method for Energy-saving Operation of Air-source heat pump hot water System in Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of heat energy waste in the air-source heat pump hot water system of a university in Shanghai, a hot water consumption prediction and heating control method based on stochastic forest regression and seasonal time series prediction was established. Under the premise of “supply heat on demand”, the daily water supplement amount of cold water and the control decision of starting and stopping the heat pump unit are obtained. The predictive results are used to optimize the control strategy to achieve refined heating control and reduce heat loss.

articleTitle: Network Channel Protection Technology for Grid 5G Business
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper introduces the network slicing technology adopted by 5G to meet diverse vertical grid industry applications. Introduced the core content network channel isolation technology of network channel security, including the isolation realization of network slicing in the access network, bearer network and core network. Combining the application scenarios of network slicing in the power industry, we have analyzed the isolation realization of network slicing applied to the power industry and network slicing of other industries and the isolation realization of network slicing corresponding to different businesses in the power industry. Finally, we provide an implementation case of network channel isolation for power grid business.

articleTitle: The Influence of Commutation Failure Predictive Control on Voltage Stability and Optimization Measures
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For DC fed into the receiving end grid, avoiding commutation failure and maintaining voltage stability are two important issues. In order to reduce the risk of commutation failure, the actual DC control system is usually equipped with a commutation failure prediction control function module. In the disturbance process, predictive control reduces the firing angle α of the inverter to increase the commutation margin. This control will change the reactive power characteristics of the inverter station and even affect the voltage stability of the receiving power grid. However, re-search on this impact and countermeasures is rarely reported. Based on the actual engineering DC control system, this paper establishes an UHVDC simulation model; reveals the commutation failure predictive control and predictive parameters, which affect the nonlinear reactive power trajectory and voltage stability of the inverter station; on this basis, proposes optimize measures to improve the prediction parameters of the large disturbance reactive power demand characteristics of the inverter station. The time-domain simulation results of large disturbances in the UHVDC receiving end power grid verify the effectiveness predictive control parameter optimization to improve the voltage stability of the receiving end power grid.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Economic Predictive Controller for Optimal Dynamic Energy Efficiency in MGT-CCHP
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To improve the dynamic energy efficiency of a micro gas turbine combined cooling, heating and power (MGT-CCHP) unit in the process of adjustments under the changes of cooling, heating and electrical load, a multi-objective economic predictive control (MO-EMPC) method is proposed and applied for MGT-CCHP in this paper. Firstly, multiple optimization objectives of the new MGT-CCHP controller are constructed based on maximum exergy efficiency and load demands. Then, the MO-EMPC problem is constructed and solved by transformed into a utopia-tracking problem. Finally, the performance of the new MGT-CCHP controller was examined by simulations, which indicates that the dynamic energy efficiency of the MGT-CCHP unit is improved while all load demands are met.

articleTitle: Research on Integration Construction and Safety of Grounding System in Three-in-One Station
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The integration of substation, energy storage station and data center grounding system is the key point in the construction of three-in-one station. Firstly, the change of ground potential rise (GPR) before and after the integration of the three-in-one station grounding system under lightning stroke and short circuit is studied. Secondly, the influence of instantaneous impulse current and lightning overvoltage on the secondary equipment in the fusion station and the tolerance and protection measures of the secondary equipment are analyzed. At last, the actual values and limits of the safety parameters of the three-in-one integrated grounding system are calculated by simulation based on CDEGS software, and relevant measures to improve the safety are put forward. The research shows that the integration construction of three stations grounding system can reduce GPR difference and improve the safety of three-in-one stations.

articleTitle: Analysis and Treatment of Stator Coil Contamination Accident of Large Condenser
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As an important reactive power compensation device for UHV DC systems, large condensers played a vital role in the safety and stable operation of the power grid. It is common for DC receivers to use dual internal water cooling models, and the water quality requirements for large condenser are also quite strict. During the operation of a domestic adjustment condenser, the flow rate of the stator coil was significantly reduced, and the pressure difference between the inlet and outlet water showed an increasing trend. The way of positive and negative washing during operation and maintenance made the problem significantly improved and solved the problem of stator coil contamination.

articleTitle: Integrated optimal Dispatching of Power and Electricity Considering Wind and Photovoltaic Forecast Deviation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The randomness of renewable energy output increases the pressure of power system to ensure the balanced operation of electricity. In order to overcome the problem of insufficient flexibility supply caused by the integration of wind and photovoltaic energy, and to consider the uncertainty of various renewable energy output and load forecasting information, an integrated optimal dispatching of power and electricity considering wind and photovoltaic forecast deviation is constructed. Firstly, aiming at minimizing the adjustment cost of monthly electricity deviation in the system, a monthly electricity deviation correction model considering the randomness of wind and solar is established. Then, according to the revised monthly generation plan, the monthly contract electricity quantity of each power plant is decomposed into days to further optimize the day ahead generation plan of each unit. Additionally, in order to decrease the output adjustment cost of the system, and to minimize the abandoned wind, photovoltaic and hydropower, a day ahead optimal scheduling model is investigated to optimize the unit output considering various coupling operation constraints of various energy forms. Finally, the simulation analysis of the proposed model is carried out with a specific example. The results show that the proposed model can adapt to the uncertainty of renewable energy output and provide a satisfied power and electricity balance scheme of the system.

articleTitle: The Serial Connection of Secondary Winding of TA under the Three-phase Three-wire System Characteristic Analysis and Remote Automatic Judgment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the three-phase three-wire system, the serial connection of secondary winding of the current transformer (TA) is a hidden miswiring and easily confused with other wrong connection types, so it is difficult to troubleshoot. This paper analyzes the occurrence mechanism of the serial connection of secondary winding of TA under the three-phase three-wire system, and researches the phasor relationship of measurement elements such as voltage, current, phase angle, etc. under the serial connection with the reverse polarity and with the same polarity respectively, as well as the influence on metering results in the two situations. The electric judgment conditions of the serial connection of secondary winding of TA are proposed, which include the characteristics of current angle and the consistency of current amplitude. Based on the actual acquisition capability of the data source, the algorithm of the software judgment is designed, which achieves the remote automatic judgment of the serial connection of secondary windings of TA under the three-phase three-wire system. The rationality and effectiveness of the algorithm model are proved by actual applications.

Author Keywords: current transformer (TA) the serial connection of secondary winding

articleTitle: Planning Method Based on Improved Jaya Algorithm for Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrated energy systems can realize the mutual coupling of various energy sources, and coordinate the management of different energy sources such as cooling, heating, and power in the system. A planning method based on an improved Jaya algorithm is proposed for a multi-energy interactive integrated energy system. Firstly, a planning model of an integrated energy system is constructed that takes into account the costs of the initial investment in the system construction, system operation, system maintenance, and system carbon emissions. Secondly, to solve the model, an improved Jaya algorithm is proposed to obtain higher solving accuracy and anti-precocity ability. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: MPPT Control Strategy with Variable Step Size Based on Power Prediction Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The existing MPPT control method faces the problem of not being able to balance the tracking speed and steady-state accuracy, and is prone to multiple misjudgments when the irradiance changes. This paper proposes a variable-step MPPT controls strategy based on power prediction technology, which analyzes the operating state based on the voltage and current sampled from each cycle of the controller and predicts the voltage and current at the maximum power point (MPP) in advance when the irradiance changes, so as calculate the optimal output duty cycle. This allows the system to quickly reach the guessing maximum power point (GMPP). This method not only takes into account the tracking speed and steady-state accuracy of the MPPT controller, but also solves the problem of easy misjudgment when the solar irradiance changes.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Control Based Active Anti-condensation Technology for Offshore Wind Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the humidity of the ocean environment is relatively high, it will affect the working performance of the wind power converter, it is essential to enhance the anti-condensation effect of the converter. Therefore, in this paper, we will study the active anti-condensation technology of offshore wind power converter based on thermal control in terms of converter topology selection, loss and thermal model, active anti-condensation technology, selection of connection scheme and converter technology improvement in order to reduce the impact of offshore humidity environment on converter efficiency and keep it in good working condition.

articleTitle: Research Front and Trend Analysis of Hydrogen Based Integrated Energy System by CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The research field of hydrogen energy generation, storage and utilization in integrated energy systems has drawn much attention in the past decade. To discover the research front and trend of this hydrogen centered research field, this paper firstly collected relevant publication records from the database of Web of Science, and then analyze and summarize the active research institutes, main disciplines, important publications and most concerned research themes of this research field based on a scholarly literature analysis and visualization software named CiteSpace. The analysis results indicate the vigorous development of the hydrogen centered research field according to annual publications number of this field, and the two most concerned research themes are performance analysis and hydrogen production.

articleTitle: Parameter Design and Control of MMC for A Novel MVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: MMC (Modular Multilevel Converter) has been applied widely in MVDC (Medium Voltage Direct Current) system. A novel MVDC transmission system is proposed in this paper. In addition, the capacitance of sub module and the inductance of branch for MMC are designed. Moreover, the control strategy of MMC is proposed, and the Square Wave Modulation is adopted. Finally, a related experiments are carried out.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Distribution Network Expansion Considering Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, we developed an optimal planning model of distribution network expansion considering integrated demand response. In this model, both shift load and cut load were considered, together with the nonlinear response cost function. We used dist-flow model and piecewise linearization to convert non-linear mathematical relationships into linear expressions. Then a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model is established, which can be solved directly by Gurobi or CPLEX. Finally, case studies showed that integrated demand response can effectively reduce the total cost of the system, delay power grid investment, and promote construction of renewable energy and its consumption. In addition, the formulation of different cost functions and response scales will also have different effects on power grid planning. In actual planning, adequate research and evaluation should be conducted on responsive resources.

articleTitle: Regional Demand Response Load Regulation Based on River Water Source Heat Pump System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing depletion of fossil energy, people have turned their attention to renewable energy. River water source heat pump technology can make full use of a variety of renewable energy sources, and the operation is efficient and environmentally friendly. It uses river water in summer with an average monthly water temperature of 28∼31°C, and winter monthly average water temperature of 7∼10 °C. It can adjust the temperature of buildings or air-conditioning, which makes the air-conditioning load. Adjust and control auxiliary grid peak shaving, improve grid load characteristics, and promote safe, stable and economic operation of the grid. Based on the basic model of the river water source heat pump, the article builds a demand response architecture based on the river water source heat pump based on the characteristics of demand response; then, based on the demand response control model, analyzes the historical compliance rate of users to make load control instructions to achieve the purpose of load reduction. Simulation and analysis of calculation examples show that the model can improve the purpose of power grid load regulation and achieve better peak shaving and valley filling effects.

articleTitle: Research on Active Islanding Detection Method Based on Frequency Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Effective detection of unplanned islands in microgrids is one of the key problems to be solved urgently. This paper proposes an active islanding detection method based on frequency disturbance.
