After the inverter in the microgrid is successfully connected to the grid, the added frequency disturbance does not affect the power quality of the power distribution system. Once the distribution network is out of power, the frequency of terminal voltage of the Point of Common Coupling(PCC) fluctuates instantly and quickly exceeds the limit value, indicating that the islanding detection is successful. After successful detection, the frequency modulation module is used to quickly match the power of the inverter in the microgrid with the load power, and quickly realize off-grid switching. A microgrid model was built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the proposed method was simulated and verified through a variety of complex working conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Classification Early Warning Mechanism of Coal Storage in Thermal Power Plant for Power Grid Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With China's economic growth and the deepening of supply-side structural reforms, some provinces and cities are still facing severe situations such as the rebound in power consumption demand, the lack of primary energy, the tight supply and demand situation of coal, the high price of coal for electricity, and the limited capacity for outsourcing power transmission. When grid dispatching faces the problems of power plant coal price rise and power supply and demand imbalance, it is difficult to maintain orderly and stable operation. It is urgent to use scientific theory and intelligent algorithms to establish a reasonable and efficient power coal monitoring and early warning system. Taking the actual situation of power grid dispatch in a certain area as an example, the thesis studies the comprehensive grading early warning mechanism of coal storage in thermal power plants based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. It is established a four-level read-orange-yellow-green early warning indicator system and a coal storage early warning indictor system suitable for different power plants under power grid dispatch. A practical case analysis shows that the research method of the thesis can visualized and effectively monitor the coal storage of thermal power plants under the jurisdiction of power grid dispatching and implement graded early warning, which has strong practicality. It also provides the necessary basis for the power grid to implement optimal dispatching for each power plant.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis on Energy Consumption of Typical Universities in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the concept of “carbon neutralization” in mind, as one kind of large energy consumers, the energy consumption and corresponding CO2 emissions are paid more and more attention. This study takes six typical universities in Shanghai as the research object and analyzes the annual, monthly and hourly electricity consumption. Six typical days have been selected for analysis, namely, winter, summer, the winter vacation, the summer vacation, the transition season and the weekend. The results show that the overall electrical load demand of the comprehensive universities and the universities with rich educational resources is large. During holidays and weekends, more uncertain factors will cause greater fluctuations in the demand for electrical load. In addition, High-level universities have more educational resources, not only the composition of students in school is complicated, but also the electricity consumption per capita is higher.

articleTitle: Web Server Based Interactive Teaching Platform for Power Pool Clearing in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the deepening of electricity market reform, the related market theory has become an important part of power training. As the main method of market transaction, pool trading is of great significance for more practitioners to understand its operation mechanism in depth. For better assistance, an interactive teaching platform based on web server is built with node.js in this paper. Compared with the single-way input of traditional pool-based teaching platform, the designed teaching platform can accept an unlimited number of bids and offers to realize the real-time interaction between users, which is more practical and operable, and can be applied to a variety of teaching scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Load Characteristics and Demand Response Control Model of River Water Source Heat Pump System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The energy utilization of river water source heat pump system adheres to the principle of “one energy, multipurpose and multi energy cooperation”, fully excavates the water resources of the park, comprehensively utilizes other clean energy, runs coordinately, and constructs a green, low-carbon, safe and efficient energy system. From the perspective of energy transfer, river water source heat pump system is a bridge connecting water source side and load side. The characteristics of water intake temperature and load distribution on the water source side have an important impact on the energy efficiency of the river water heat pump system. For example, the cooling load of residential buildings in summer is 78684kW, which can be reduced by combining water source heat pump with demand response. In this paper, the characteristics of water temperature change and load distribution on the demand side are analyzed. According to the load characteristics of different buildings, the demand response control model is established, and the user comfort is fully considered, which lays the foundation for the river water source heat pump system to participate in the demand response.

Author Keywords: river water source heat pump system

articleTitle: Research on LADRC Based Microgrid Quasi-synchronization Smooth Grid-Connection Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The prerequisite for ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the microgrid is to realize the smooth and fast switching of microgrid between grid-connection and islanding operation. Considering these factors, this paper proposes a kind of smooth grid-connection method of microgrid based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC). The voltage and current dual-loop control strategy is adopted. The voltage outer loop is designed as LADRC controller. Comparing with PI controller, it can significantly improve the tracking and disturbance rejection performance. The current inner loop is designed as traditional proportion controller, which can ensure the dynamic ability. Meanwhile, this paper also discusses non-phase-locked loop method of three-phase grid-connected inverter, which is trying to find a novel way on dq0 transformation of three-phase grid voltage. The simulation results show the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Discussion on Charge Discharge and Repair Technology of Lead Acid Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Lead acid battery has been widely used in many fields, such as electric vehicles, equipment, railway transportation, communication and so on. However, with the extensive use of lead-acid batteries, there are more and more scrapped lead-acid batteries, which not only caused a lot of social resources loss, but also caused great pressure to today's more and more serious environmental problems. This paper systematically introduces the internal structure of lead-acid battery, analyzes the reasons for its capacity decline, describes the battery charging, discharging, repair principle, and gives the repair system reference circuit.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Network for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous development of communication technology, compared with a single network, wire-wireless networks can reduce network congestion and delay, and improve network transmission performance. Traditional charging stations use a single wireless network to transmit the distribution of charging load and charging pile information, but the wireless network communication quality is not good. This paper uses NS-3 network simulator to model and simulate a PLC-ad hoc hybrid network. The simulation results show that the application of the wire-wireless network in the electric vehicle charging station scenario has good data transmission performance, which helps to regulate the vehicle stream and charging load distribution.

articleTitle: A Novel PD Detection Device for Overhead Distribution Lines Based on Ultrasound and UHF
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It has been proved that PD (partial discharge) detection is one of the most effective techniques for on-line condition monitoring and predictive maintenance of electrical equipment. In order to solve the current problems of inconvenience and inaccuracy in PD detection for overhead distribution lines, this paper develops a novel PD detection device based on the combination of ultrasound and UHF (ultra-high frequency). The sequence of arrival time and the corresponding sequence of amplitude for ultrasound and UHF are extracted effectively. At the same time, the distance between detection device and PD source is calculated accurately. In addition, the inversion formula is established to eliminate the influence of different detection distance on detection intensity. Ultrasonic conditioning circuit and UHF conditioning circuit are also designed in detail. Finally, laboratory test and field test are conducted to prove the effectiveness of the detection device developed in this paper.

articleTitle: Industrial Data Extraction Method Based on Correlation Matrix and Multidimensional Probability Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The operation data of power plant has the characteristics of multivariable and big data, which is widely used in the research of data-driven modeling. Effective data extraction is an important part of data-driven modeling, and the performance of data extraction algorithm directly affects the accuracy of modeling. In this paper, an effective data extraction method based on correlation matrix and vine structure is proposed. The rank correlation coefficient is used to measure the correlation between variables and construct the correlation matrix. According to the correlation matrix, important variables are selected and grouped. Vine structure is used to establish a multi-dimensional joint distribution model for each group of variables. The data with high probability are extracted by confidence interval as effective data. Finally, the extracted results of multiple combinations are combined to form an effective data set. The SCR data are used for example verification, and the results show that the proposed method can extract effective data and improve the correlation between variables significantly.

articleTitle: State Estimation of Integrated Energy System Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The integrated energy system (IES) can improve the efficiency of energy utilization, so it is widely concerned. In order to realize the accurate perception of IES, it is necessary to conduct state estimation (SE). In this paper, a deep neural network (DNN) based SE method is proposed for IES with a large number of historical data. In this method, the spatiotemporal relationship between the data of the IES is established by screening the data with high correlation degree, and then the DNN model is trained with these data. The DNN algorithm assisted by the data screening (DS-DNN) solves the problem that the SE of gas system and thermal system in the dynamic process of IES is difficult to obtain accurate result quickly. The accuracy of the proposed SE algorithm is verified by the example simulation analysis of the IES.

articleTitle: Research on Typical DC Fault Characteristics of ±1100 kV Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the actual project parameters of the Changji-Guquan ±1100 kV UHVDC transmission project and the PSCAD simulation software, calculations of overvoltage amplitude under 4 typical DC side fault conditions are made in this paper. Then, the waveform characteristics, the action current and absorbed energy of arresters are analyzed. The research results show that the operation modes and the protection time delay can influence the overvoltage characteristics and the action results of arresters by affecting the fault equivalent loop topology and the fault duration, respectively. In the actual project arrester configuration, the overvoltage level of all arresters, after taking into account the margin factor, is lower than the insulation withstand voltage of the electrical equipment immediately protected, which proves the rationality of the actual project arrester configuration.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Scheduling of Micro-grid with Energy Storage under Time-of-Use Price Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: During the operation of the microgrid, because the output power of some distributed power sources is fluctuating and intermittent, it will affect the reliability and stability of the power supply of the system. Therefore, it is particularly important to study the optimal dispatch of the microgrid. Proposed an optimal dispatch strategy considering energy storage status under time-of-use electricity price mechanism, took the lowest economic cost of system operation, the lowest environmental pollution and the highest power supply reliability as objectives. A combination weighting method that combines AHP and entropy method to achieve the unity of subjective and objective calculations is proposed to calculate the weight coefficients of each sub-objective. The multi-objective model is converted into a single-objective model and the improved cuckoo algorithm is used to solve the established model. Under the grid-connected operation mode, study the optimized output characteristics of controllable distributed micro-sources, energy storage and the interaction with the large power grid. The simulation results show that the optimal scheduling strategy considering the time-of-use electricity price and energy storage status reduces the total operating cost of the system and verifies the effectiveness of the improved cuckoo algorithm.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Wind Turbines Bearing based on Particle Filter and Sparse Auto-encoder
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the fault accuracy and efficiency of fan bearings, a bearing intelligent fault diagnosis method based on the combination of particle filter and sparse encoder is proposed. The vibration signal is preprocessed with particle filter, and then the fault features of the bearing are extracted separately to construct a feature matrix; in order to prevent the network structure from overfitting, the extracted fault features are input into the sparse autoencoder network added to Dropout for fault classification. Finally, the soft-max classifier is used for fault classification and recognition, and compared with the traditional intelligent fault diagnosis method. Experimental results show that, compared with other methods, this method can accurately identify faults.

articleTitle: Differential Privacy Algorithm for Integrated Energy System Based on Improved K-means
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper studies the privacy protection method of k-means clustering integrated energy system based on improved differential privacy protection. Firstly, it introduces the research status of integrated energy system and privacy protection, and the basic principles and methods of differential privacy protection. In order to solve the problem that the reliability and concealment of clustering results of k-means clustering method can not be taken into account, a new differential privacy k-means clustering method is proposed, and it is proved that it satisfies differential privacy protection. Finally, the experiment proves that the improved differential privacy protection k-means clustering integrated energy system privacy protection method can protect data privacy and improve the stability of clustering effect, which greatly improves the data privacy protection of integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Method and Device for Evaluating and Testing Generator Overhaul State without the Rotor Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: On the basis of sorting out the maintenance and test items required for generator overhaul, this paper proposes a test method based on segmented splicing plastic guide rails and customized carriers as test tools. After field verification, it has basically achieved airlessness. The purpose of the clearance baffle generator to complete the evaluation and test of the overhaul status without the rotor extraction, the effect is good, and it has the prospect of popularization and application in the entire power industry.

articleTitle: Analysis of Single-phase Grounding Fault in Low-resistance Grounding System Containing Inverter Interfaced Distributed Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the low-resistance grounding system with inverter interfaced distributed generator (IIDG), the IIDG widely uses the neutral point through the low-resistance grounding method. But the IIDG, which adopts the neutral point grounding through a low resistance, will affect the fault characteristics of the original low-resistance grounding system. This paper uses the symmetrical component method to establish a single-phase grounding fault model for the distribution network where the neutral points of the IIDG and the main network are grounded with low resistance. The fault current, the zero-sequence current, and the three-phase current of the line are analyzed when the upstream line of the grid connection point, the downstream line of the grid connection point, and the adjacent feeder fail. Finally, a simulation model was built using Matlab/Simulink to verify the correctness of the analysis. The conclusion provides a basis for the protection configuration of the distribution network in which the neutral points of the IIDG and the main network are grounded with low resistance.

articleTitle: Schedulable Resources Allocation and Dispatch Coordination Strategy for Contingency in Asynchronous Interconnected Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Asynchronous grids interconnected with High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission may suffer from bulk power imbalance in some most severe circumstances, with great uncertainties and threats introduced to both sending and receiving end system. Considering the different response rate and coupling among schedulable resources including primary reserve, HVDC emergency power support and reactive compensation, we propose a novel coordinated strategy involving resources optimized allocation and emergency dispatch. With the transient and steady constrains consideration, a bi-level coordinated optimization is developed to tackle the objective consist of operation and adjustment costs. A case study in modified two-area China Electric Power Research Institute (CEPRI) 44-bus system validated the efficiency of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Robust Sizing of Energy Storage for High Wind-Power Penetration System Considering Frequency Constrains
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The continuous increase of wind power penetration has been a big challenge to the power balance and frequency stability of the power system. To address this issue, a robust sizing model of energy storage that considering the system frequency response is proposed. This paper makes up for the lack of consideration of system frequency characteristics in the energy storage sizing stage. The obtained scheme can ensure that the frequency fluctuation of the system is within the allowable range under different scenarios of wind power output. Test results demonstrate that the proposed approach can effectively achieve active power balance and frequency safety under fluctuations of wind power output.

articleTitle: Visual Fusion Positioning Technology for Safety Management of Urban Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid increase of urban electricity demand in recent years, the scale and number of urban power plants are expanding, which poses new challenges to the safety and management of power plant staff, and real-time high-precision localization services can achieve fine-grained management of staff. We propose a vision fusion-based localization technique that combines the traditional visual odometry calculation method based on the feature point method with the optical flow method, and validates it by collecting data sets in a real power plant environment. The experimental results show that the proposed fusion-based visual odometry calculation method is superior to the traditional visual odometry calculation method in terms of comprehensive performance in terms of real-time performance and accuracy of position estimation, which verifies the practical application possibilities of the vision-based localization technology in urban power plants.

articleTitle: Study on a Method to Depict the Multi-Dimension Characterization of DC Voltage Sag
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In regards to the DC distribution system (DCDS), the investigation of its voltage sag problem is of significance. In this paper, a feasible methodology to depict the multi-dimension characterization of DC voltage sag is proposed. Firstly, the multi-dimension characteristic indexes are established, and related definitions are conducted to describe the DC voltage sag. Then, the B-spline dyadic wavelet method is selected as the wavelet basis function, and the expected objective is to realize the waveform segmentation and characterization extraction of DC voltage sag. In terms of the DC voltage sags by different events and the DC voltage waveform segmentation, a detailed depicting of the multi-dimension characterization can be achieved. Simulation analysis and numerical calculation of different kinds of DC voltage sags are implemented, and the findings enable to well validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed approach, which lays a foundation for the future systematic evaluation of different DC voltage sags.

articleTitle: Control Optimization and Application of Denitrification Ammonia Injection System Based on Advanced Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: After a power plant retrofitted with ultra-low emission units to meet environmental assessment standards, the traditional control strategy tends to cause serious overshooting of the denitrification ammonia injection control system, generating a large amount of ammonia escape, which adversely affects the safety and economy of the unit. Aiming at this problem, this paper optimises the ammonia injection control system by adopting advanced control algorithms such as model predictive control and adaptive intelligent control, combing with NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</inf> concentration measurements optimisation and the CMES meter purge control optimisation. After the implementation of the advanced control algorithm, the NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">X</inf> concentration overshoot of the unit was significantly reduced, and the control effect of denitrification ammonia injection was significantly improved with significant economic benefits.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Grid-connected Inverter Based on Active Power Reserve
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Now-a-days, photovoltaic (PV) power are getting more and more widespread with the increase in the energy demand and the concern for the environmental pollution around the world. With the continuous increase of PV grid-connected power, its frequency are mainly supported by the grid, but it provides almost no rotational inertia to the grid. The cascaded H-bridge (CHB) converter is a suitable candidate for the grid interconnection due to its modular characteristics, high-quality output waveforms and capability of connecting to medium-voltage grids without transformers. A control strategy with the function of supporting the grid frequency based on active power reserve is proposed in this paper for the three phase CHB PV grid-connected system, without the need for energy storage. A proportion of the total PV power is reserved by the selected reserved cells to provide the power buffer for grid frequency supporting. Meanwhile by using the proposed method of reserve power distribution among the PV strings, each H-bridge input power balance is maximized, and the balanced three phase current output is realized.

articleTitle: Parameters Design of LLC DC converter Based on Peak Gain Point Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The peak gain point of LLC DC converter is the starting point for the main switch to achieve zero-voltage switching, and the peak gain reflects its capability in voltage regulation. The peak gain point of PON mode has a higher gain than that of PN mode. However, there is no analytical solution for the gain characteristics in this mode, so it is difficult to locate the peak gain point, which brings a certain challenge to employ the advantage of peak gain and design parameters of resonant tank. This paper presents a simple, efficient, and high-precision design method. Firstly, the peak gain point of gain is accurately located, then the range of inductance ratio is limited according to the peak gain point distribution and the maximum gain requirement, and the optimal matching between inductance ratio and normalized power is determined according to the principle of minimum cycle power. Based on this, the parameters are designed to obtain accurate peak value gain and PLECS simulation results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Electric Power Related Application & Research for Advanced Machine Vision Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The power system scene is produced into pictures, videos and other data sets, so that students can have a more intuitive and more perceptual understanding of power equipment, substation, etc., this paper proposes a teaching method of power system from the perspective of machine vision, which is called “visual power”. This is a new teaching mode in the new era of the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence. It makes full use of the existing power system operation data, combines the data with the actual situation, makes a data set, uses artificial intelligence technology for analysis, and trains intelligent power and AI power talents. Through several years exploration and practice of teaching, teaching methods based on machine vision of the power system is programming for students' practical ability, to exercise the student's ability of engineering practice, and grasp the current direction of machine vision technology in electric power industry has played a good supporting role, at the same time, the auxiliary teaching of teachers, and enriched the contents of the experiment course, also played a great role in promoting. The practice shows that this experimental teaching method can achieve better practical teaching effect and has a certain application value.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Economic Dispatch for Active Distribution Network Considering Plug-in Electric Vehicles Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Plug-in electric vehicle (EV) charging loads have become viable candidates for increasing operational flexibility of distribution systems. A day-ahead economic dispatch strategy for active distribution network (ADN) considering a large number EVs aggregation process is proposed in this paper to make full use of the potential flexibility of demand side. The proposed strategy consists of three models that are EVs aggregation model by clustering method, economic dispatch model for ADN and disaggregation model for EV aggregators, respectively. Numerical simulation results illustrate that the proposed strategy can increase the benefits of ADN with high computation efficiency and offer a promising application value in power system economic dispatch.

articleTitle: Characteristic Study and Non-invasive Detection of DC Arc-Fault in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Since a DC microgrid can connect renewable energy systems into distribution grids, researchers are focused on the techniques that can support the wide application of DC microgrids. However, DC arc faults can cause malfunctions and fire hazards in a DC microgrid. To detect the arc faults in DC microgrids, it is important to define their characteristics and develop a reliable arc-fault detection technique. Though the arc-fault characteristics of a DC microgrid should be further studied to develop a suitable arc model. In this paper, an arc model has been developed by combining the volt-ampere characteristics and frequency-domain features of arc faults. The simulation results prove that the arc-fault current can be accurately simulated by the derived arc model. According to the characteristics of arc faults, a DC arc-fault detection technique based on non-invasive magnetic-field sensing by magnetic sensors and spectrum energy integration is developed for DC microgrids. The experimental results validate that the arc faults can be effectively detected by the proposed technique. Hence, the developed arc model can be utilized to investigate the interaction between arc faults and DC microgrids. The proposed arc-fault detection method can improve the reliability of DC microgrids.

articleTitle: Research on Air-Conditioning Load Control Method Based on IPSO-LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Air-conditioning load is the main part of daily electric load, so its control method research has the great significance for formulating reasonable electric energy construction plans and has the benefit of economy and society. This paper analyzed the air-conditioning load characteristics in multiple scenarios, expounded the control method and proposed a scheme of air-conditioning load participating in power grid regulation. Based on historical air-conditioning load data in a specific scenario, the improved particle swarm-least square support vector machine (IPSO-LSSVM) forecast model was used to perform short-term load forecasting in a calculation example. The air-conditioning load control plan was given based on the simulation result, which not only realized the interaction between the power grid and the load, but also alleviated the adverse effects of the air-conditioning load.

articleTitle: The Control Strategy of Charging Converter of Super Capacitor Energy Storage Type Trolleybus
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, the tram with super capacitor has gradually become a new trend of urban traffic. The purpose of this paper is to find a new strategy to improve the performance of super capacitor charging control in view of the interference caused by the poor contact between pantograph and rail in the process of super capacitor charging under the traditional PI double closed-loop control. This paper takes the super capacitor charging control system of energy storage type trolleybus as the research object. Based on the phenomenon of the system charging current increasing rapidly due to the poor contact between the pantograph and rail during the charging process of the tramcar, the problems such as the traditional PID control cannot effectively restrain the distortion of charging current caused by the poor contact between the pantograph and the rail are analyzed. Then a new charging control strategy is proposed, which adopts PI parameter setting of outer ring voltage loop and double closed loop control strategy of nonlinear differential tracker of internal current loop. Finally, by building the system control platform, the charging experiments of the two control algorithms are carried out under different actual conditions. The effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by comparing the results of the two control strategies. Simulation results show that under the traditional control strategy, when the reference value of charging current is 300A, the charging voltage suddenly increases, from the voltage distortion of about 350V to about 385V, which has a large fluctuation, a large fluctuation range and inaccurate system control. Under the new control strategy, the current waveform of the control system with nonlinear system strategy is relatively stable, and the fluctuation and impact of disturbance are smaller.

articleTitle: Safety Situation Prediction Method for Power Energy System Based on AFSA-ELM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low prediction accuracy and slow convergence speed of the existing power system network security situation prediction models. In this paper, a prediction method of artificial fish swarms algorithm-Extreme Learning Machine Algorithm (AFSA-ELM)is proposed. Firstly, the parameters of hidden layer nodes and corresponding nodes are randomly selected in the algorithm to achieve the purpose of unsupervised learning. Secondly, aiming at the problem that Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) is easy to fall into local optimum, a confidence interval strategy based on artificial fish swarms algorithm (AFSA) is proposed to limit the weight of input data and hidden layer, which can guide the result of falling into local optimum to global optimum. Through the experimental analysis, it is verified that the model has a good evaluation and prediction effect, and can predict the real-time network situation completely and accurately.

articleTitle: Real-time Simulation and Control of Refined Dynamic Model of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrated energy system which acts as the physical carrier of the Internet, can realize the cascade utilization of energy and the complementary coordinated operation. It can improve the utilization rate of the primary energy to ensure the security of energy supply. Meanwhile, it also effectively address the problem such as the energy crisis, environmental pollution and climate change. However, in the study of integrated energy system, thermal system modeling is mostly based on its physical properties, and the entire energy network is constituted according to the energy transfer equation. The model used to calculate the steady-state model doesn't put the dynamic effect of the model into consideration, which is quite different from that of the actual engineering. In view of the lack of detailed dynamic modeling methods in thermal systems at present, a refined dynamic model of integrated energy system is built based on the Thermolib toolkit in this paper. At the same time, in order to adapt to the temperature change of the load side of the heating system, the system adopts the quality regulation mode to realize the tracking regulation of water supply temperature. The model is run on RT-Lab simulation platform, and the accuracy of the control strategy is verified by real-time simulation.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method of the Portable Electricity Meter Devices Based on the Improved Optimization of Membership Functions
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The portable electricity meter devices can measure and monitor the electricity actually used by the user during the process of electricity meter replacement and ensure the normal power consumption of the user. A comprehensive evaluation method of portable electricity meter devices based on the improved optimization of membership functions is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a comprehensive evaluation index system of portable electricity meter devices is established from both the business and technical aspects. Secondly, in order to avoid the problems of singleness and subjectivity in the existing methods of membership function selection and index weight determination, an improved optimization construction method of membership functions is proposed to improve the reliability of the evaluation results. Then the weight vector of each index is determined by the method of order relation and mean square error, and the steps of the comprehensive evaluation algorithm of the portable electricity meter devices are given. The case example shows that the comprehensive evaluation method proposed in this paper can effectively evaluate the portable electricity meter devices with higher reliability.

articleTitle: Hybrid Control Strategy for Photovoltaic System with Stable Bus Voltage Regulation and Maximum Power Point Tracking Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Interleaved boost converter is widely used for photovoltaic system because of the merits of high voltage conversion gain, small current ripple, and so on. Many kinds of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms only concern the performance of tracking maximum power but ignore the fluctuation of bus voltage. However, large fluctuation of bus voltage possibly leads instability to the grid-connected voltage and results in difficulty of grid-connected control. In this work, a hybrid control algorithm is proposed for interleaved boost converter to meanwhile realize MPPT ability and stable bus regulation even under large disturbance. A simulation model is established by simulation software to verify the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid control algorithm, the simulation results shows that the proposed hybrid control algorithm can well regulate the bus voltage while the sunlight intensity varies in a wide range.

articleTitle: SVPWM-Based Dual Active Filter for Distribution System Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Massive use of non-linear devices such as rectifiers, variable speed drives and inverters has introduced harmonics in distribution systems. Such harmonic currents result in torque pulsation in motors, increased equipment heating and misfiring of variable speed drives. These problems have caused increasing research attention for power quality improvement. Most of such researches use Active Power Filter (APF) for harmonic current reduction. Active power filters use different control schemes such as Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) and Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM). This paper proposes a SVPWM based dual APF for the harmonic reduction in the distribution system. Results obtained from proposed SVPWM based dual APF are compared with SPWM and SVPWM based single APFs. The Comparison shows that proposed SVPWM based dual APF outperforms others with lower Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), lower switching loss, better power factor and DC bus voltage utilization.

articleTitle: Surface vibration and noise analysis of POD Propeller of Construction Scientific Research Ship
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to know the level of vibration and noise on the surface of POD propeller of construction scientific research ship. The energy average method and the sound pressure method are used to test the vibration and noise of the pod under various working conditions. The test results show that the pod meets the design requirements at most frequencies, and the vibration and noise of some frequency bands exceeds the standard risk. It can provide data support for prediction of cabin noise, underwater radiated noise and multi-beam self-noise of ships to ensure that the vibration and noise of the final ship meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Configuration of PV Storage Charging Station Considering Battery Life
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increase of electric vehicles, the traditional charging station transformers will not be able to meet the need of capacity. In this paper, the scheduling strategy of charging station which based on the consideration of time-of-use (TOU) electricity tariff and capacity expansion was formulated. The capacity optimization model was established with the goal of maximizing the annual net profit of PV storage charging station (PSCS), the constraints of power balance, capacity limitation and safe operation of energy storage battery. The rain flow counting method was used to measure the battery life in order to accurately calculate the battery replacement times in the model. The economic feasibility of using PV and energy storage to slow down the expansion was verified by the calculation and analysis of a charging station in Xi'an. The results show that LiFePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> batteries have obvious arbitrage effect when the price of LiFePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> batteries is lower than 1400 CNY / kWh. The achievements of this paper can not only improve the economic benefits of the PSCS, but also ensure the safe and stable operation of the PSCS.

articleTitle: A Two-population Information Interaction Fault Location Method Based on Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the difficulties of fault location caused by the low coverage of feeder terminal units (FTUs) in distribution networks, this paper proposes a two-population information interaction-based fault location method using incomplete information. Firstly, the virtual switching points (VSPs) are constructed, which divide the long segment into several short segments to reduce the scope of fault location, and the states of the VSPs are obtained by using the states of the loads under the long segment which do not cover FTUs. Secondly, the VSPs are used to supplement the fault information, and the fault location optimization model of distribution network is established. Finally, a two-population iterative algorithm based on the information interaction between genetic algorithm and binary particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem. The results of numerical examples show that the proposed method can accurately locate both single fault and double faults even if the FTU fault information is incomplete and partially wrong.

articleTitle: Economic Study of Cooling and Heating System at Distributed Multi-station Integrated Energy Station in Beijing Daxing International Airport Economic Zone
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the economic model of the multi-station integrated distributed energy station is studied. Taking a comprehensive logistics park in Beijing Daxing International Airport Economic Zone as an example, by comparing the economy of different heating system's technical routes, such as gas centralized heating system, ground source heat pump and chiller in the distributed energy station. The results show that the multi-station integrated energy station with a combination of ground source heat pump and chiller can meet the economic requirements and low carbon requirements. The analysis methods provided in this paper are helpful to the construction of an urban energy Internet system.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Inspection of Grid-connected Inverter in Large-scale New Energy Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the establishment of “carbon peak” and “carbon neutral” goals, new energy sources such as photovoltaics and wind power will usher in unprecedented development opportunities. However, large-scale new energy installations will cause the power grid to “weak”, which brings great challenges to power supply reliability. As the key node of the grid connection of new energy power plants, inverters are key equipment that determine the stability of new energy power plants and the supportability of the grid. Its stability under weak grid has become an issue that needs urgent attention. This paper first introduces the concept of SCR as an indicator of power grid strength, then derives the formula of SCR in a single-feed AC/DC system, and analyses the influence of SCR value on the inverter through the inverter output impedance model. Four different types and manufacturers of string inverters on the market are selected for stability testing and analysis in weak grid environment. The test results show that the adaptability to weak grid of different manufacturer's inverters vary widely. Poor inverters have difficulties in connecting to the grid in areas where the power grid is weak, and there is a risk of disconnection and power failure when the grid environment is gradually deteriorating. Finally, suggestions for improvement are given from the perspectives of equipment, power plant, and power grid respectively.

articleTitle: The Third Harmonic Analysis and Research of Generator Outlet in One Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When monitoring the power quality of a power plant, we found that the third harmonic of generator outlet is large. In this paper, the harmonic test results of normal operation process, start-up process and shutdown process of the generator are analyzed comprehensively, and three main reasons for the formation of the third harmonic at the outlet of the generator are listed, including: amplification of the zero-sequence harmonic voltage generated by the secondary side of PT on the primary side; When the generator is under no load, the no-load excitation potential generated by the no-load excitation current is a trapezoidal wave, and the magnetic induction intensity generated by the no-load excitation current contains three harmonic components. When the load of the generator increases, the armature reaction is generated. Due to the uneven air gap reluctance on the surface of the rotor magnetic pole, the magnetic induction intensity distributed along the air gap by the magnetic flux on the surface of the rotor will be non-sinusoidal, and the third harmonic will also be generated.

articleTitle: Study and Simulation of Grid-connected Photovoltaic System Based on Interleaved Boost Converter and H-bridge Inverter with Low Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Interleaved boost converter cascaded H-bridge converter is used for low or medium power distributed photovoltaic grid-connected system. Photovoltaic panel and grid-connected converter are analyzed and the simulation model is established to verify the function. Interleaved boost converter is used to stabilize the bus voltage and controlled by improved maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm. H-bridge converter is utilized to realize the connection to grid and controlled by double-loop strategy.

articleTitle: Direct Torque Control without Flux Observation for Centrifugal Harmonic Force Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The centrifugal harmonic force generator is the core executive component of the helicopter vibration active control system. Direct torque control (DTC) without flux observation is proposed for achieving the tracking of harmonic force amplitude, phase and frequency, and dynamic response of torque in centrifugal harmonic force generator system driven by brushless DC motor (BLDCM). The harmonic force equation and torque equation for DTC without flux observation are established. The control strategy is simulated and analyzed in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The experimental research is implemented on the dSPACE semi-physical simulation platform, and the line parameters are debuged by ControlDesk. The results show that the designed control strategy improves the tracking accuracy of the centrifugal harmonic force generator.

Author Keywords: direct torque control without flux observation

articleTitle: Algorithm for Integrated Wind Plant Energy Storage Configuration Based on Battery Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High wind power penetration can pose a major challenge to the stability of the local grid. Energy storage can make the wind farm output more stable and alleviate the impact on the grid. This paper fully considers the reliability and economy of energy storage configuration, and proposes a set of energy storage configuration scheme based on the characteristics of different types of batteries, combining the advantages of strong power regulation of Li-ion batteries and large capacity storage of VRB batteries, based on the corresponding technical indicators, combined with the objective function of minimizing the average cost of using energy storage, and solved by using immune algorithm to obtain a comprehensive configuration scheme of energy storage power and capacity. Finally, an example analysis is conducted using data from a wind farm in Shandong Province to evaluate the improvement of the wind farm output by the energy storage configuration under this scheme and verify the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: New Method of Active Arc Suppression and Phase Selection Based on Zero Sequence Current Regulation in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of arc suppression and phase selection of single-phase grounding fault in neutral point non-effectively grounded distribution network, an active arc suppression and phase selection method based on neutral point zero sequence current regulation is proposed in this paper. After single-phase ground fault occurs, a specific zero sequence current is injected into the neutral point by a controllable current source to eliminate the influence of three-phase to ground parameter asymmetry on phase selection, and then the fault phase is selected according to the phase comparison of zero sequence voltage displacement. Furthermore, the zero sequence current is regulated by a controllable current source connected to the neutral point to compensate the full current of the grounding fault and suppress the fault phase voltage to zero, to realize the safe arc suppression of the grounding fault. In PSCAD / EMTDC simulation environment, a single-phase to ground fault model of distribution network is built, and simulation results show that reliable arc suppression and correct phase selection can be achieved under different transition resistance, which verifies the feasibility of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: The Influence of Different Drive Modes on the Performance of Scroll Compressors
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the thermodynamics of the variable mass system and the control volume method, the change law of the temperature in the working chamber of the scroll compressor in the actual working process is constructed. In order to reduce the whole machine and exhaust temperature of the direct-connected oil-free scroll compressor unit, the compressor is the connection with the drive motor is changed to a wheeled connection. After the modification is completed, the test found that: as the exhaust pressure increases, the speed of the wheeled compressor continues to decrease, and the exhaust flow of the wheeled compressor both are higher than the direct-connected compressor, the current and power of the drive motor of the wheeled compressor are higher than that of the direct-connected compressor, while the power of the drive motor of the direct-connected compressor is higher than that of the wheeled compressor.

articleTitle: Configuration of Energy Storage System in Distribution Network Planning Considering Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under general trend of green energy development, distributed generations, a grid energy provider, are playing an increasingly important role in distribution network. Due to randomness and uncertainty, large scale of distributed generation will impact the stability and reliability of distribution network. In this paper, the research focus on configuration of energy storage system for adapting the impact of distributed generation and producing benefits in operation of distribution network. By establishing mathematical model of distributed generation and energy storage system, it reasonably analyses feasibility of cooperation to improve stability and revenue. According to the data of daily operation, distributed generation has seasonal characteristics and a set of typical daily scenario in spring, summer, autumn and winter is clustered by scenario reduction method. Based on IEEE 33-bus distribution network, the optimal construction planning is solved based on objective function and constraints. The configuration of energy storage is different in four seasons. However, it is mostly closed to distributed generations to reduce their influences. Last, it summarizes the working of this paper and makes some prospects on future development of distribution network.

articleTitle: A Common Bus Voltage Compensation Method for Microgrid Based on Voltage Drop Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When multiple distributed renewable energy sources with the characteristics of virtual synchronous generator are paralleled in microgrid, the power distribution of the parallel inverter is unbalanced due to the mismatch of feeder impedance, and the common bus voltage drop problem. In this paper, a mathematical model of the parallel system is established to analyze the conditions of power sharing, and the virtual impedance method is used to improve the accuracy of power sharing of the inverter. However, the virtual impedance in series will increase the voltage drop of the line and cause the voltage of the common bus to deviate from the rated value, thus affecting the power quality. Therefore, based on the theoretical analysis of the voltage drop caused by the virtual impedance method, a voltage compensation method based on the voltage drop estimation for the common bus of microgrid is proposed. Finally, using MATLAB/SIMULINK software to build a distributed sources parallel system simulation model to verify the correctness of the virtual impedance to achieve power balance distribution and common bus voltage compensation methods.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Voltage Cooperative Optimization of AC Microgrids Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A method for hierarchical voltage cooperative optimization using model predictive control (MPC) is proposed to enhance the dynamic response in an AC microgrid (MG). The method adopts a two-layer optimization strategy by minimizing predictive errors to reduce voltage fluctuations which hybrid PV-BESS system brings. In the inner-level, VSG-control is used as the primary control of distributed generation (DG). Further a secondary control action based on consistency ensures the voltage recovery and power average distribution. On this basis, the outer layer is a rolling optimization, and real-time reactive power is compensated by static var generator (SVG) whose controller is replaced by model predictive control (MPC) to prevent the further voltage drop. Meanwhile, the deviation of voltage and frequency can be eliminated gradually in the hierarchical voltage cooperative control using feedback correction, which ensures the stable operation of the MG. The efficiency of the proposed method is verified by discussion and analysis of the simulation results.

articleTitle: Dual Optimization of Wind-EVs Aggregation for Renewable Utilization and Economic Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The intermittency of wind power generation causes the risks of safety and stability of power system. Flexible loads such as Electric Vehicles (EVs) can regulate the power consumption according to the power output of wind in order to mitigate the impact of the intermittency. This paper proposes a global optimization model of typical regional grid to achieve the economic dispatch of wind power generation and EVs in the day-ahead optimization, while considering the maximum renewable power utilization in the real-time rolling optimization under time-of-use (TOU) tariff for EVs. The dual optimization takes considerations of economic dispatch and renewable power utilization simultaneously based on the constraints of load forecasting, wind forecasting, the state of charge of EVs, the charging routines of EVs, and DC power flow. The power unbalance due to wind power volatility and load volatility are stabilized under the economic dispatch of conventional generators. A case study based on practical regional grid is proposed, demonstrating that two layers of optimization is able to reconcile the components in the system under both economic and renewable power utilization target.

articleTitle: Hybrid Control Method for Dc-Dc Stage of Single-phase Photovoltaic System with Dc-link Voltage Regulation and MPPT
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that conventional control method of single-phase two-stage photovoltaic system is hard to achieve stable dc-link voltage only with inverter's control figuration, especially for variable photovoltaic array power, a new kind of hybrid control method is proposed, the proposed control method can achieve stable dc-link voltage even the photovoltaic array's power happens great fluctuation in a short time range with maintaining maximum power point tracking ability. To verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed hybrid control method, a simulation model is established based on single-phase boost converter for the dc-dc stage of photovoltaic system, and the simulation results shows that the proposed hybrid control method has better ability to regulate the dc-link voltage no matter whatever working states compared with conventional control method, and the proposed hybrid control method can also well realize maximum power point tracking ability.

articleTitle: A Demand Response Strategy for HVAC Systems for Peak Load Shedding
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems account for a large percentage of total energy use of buildings and show obvious peak-valley differences due to the occupant behavior and outdoor weather, bringing challenges for the reliability of the power grid. Demand response is an effective way to reduce the electrical power demand at peak time. In this study, a temperature-humidity demand response strategy for air conditioning systems is proposed to reduce the peak load by adjusting the indoor temperature and the humidity. By analyzing the effect of the peak load shedding and the indoor thermal environment of the proposed strategy, the results show that more than 60.3% of the electricity load can be reduced in the demand response period with only 5% more unsatisfied indoor thermal environment, which is more effective than the temperature setback strategy.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Integrated Thermoelectric Energy System Based on Interruptible Load Demand
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the scheduling optimization problem of combined heat and power systems (CHPs) with demand response, a scheduling strategy based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is proposed. Firstly, the CHPs scheduling optimization problem is modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP); secondly, based on the economic scheduling of CHPs using the deep Q network (DQN) algorithm, through interruptible electric load compensation, the introduction of electricity demand response, further reduces energy consumption costs. Studies have shown that DRL can give full play to the autonomy of the model, and obtain optimal actions through continuous interaction with the environment; through interruptible load demand response, CHPs costs are reduced by 3.50%. Finally, the DQN algorithm is verified by the mixed integer linear programming model (MILP).

articleTitle: Optimization of Regional Integrated Energy System Scheduling Based on PSO Considering Supply and Demand Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of multiple power supply bodies in regional integrated energy, and based on the complementarity of output and energy consumption on both sides of supply and demand, an optimal scheduling method of regional integrated energy considering the interaction between supply and demand was proposed. First, a regional integrated energy network consisting of photovoltaic, wind turbine, energy storage, users and large-scale electric vehicles has been established. Secondly, the comprehensive demand response strategy of electric vehicles based on price and incentive is analyzed and formulated. Then, a regional integrated energy system optimal scheduling strategy considering the interaction between supply and demand is proposed. This strategy is analyzed from the perspectives of supply side and demand side, which can not only realize the optimal allocation of energy resources on the supply side and the reasonable utilization of energy on the demand side, but also ensure the stable economic operation of the whole system. Finally, the actual parameters of comprehensive energy in a certain area of Shanghai are used as the simulation model to verify the advantages of this strategy in optimizing economic operation and suppressing load fluctuation.

articleTitle: Calculation of Maximum Distributed Photovoltaic Access Capacity Considering Protection Operation Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The access of distributed photovoltaics (PVs) to the distribution network affects the original current quick-break protection, resulting in the change of protection range and an increase in the risk of protection malfunction. This study analyzes the influence of the current increase caused by distributed PVs on the current quick-break protection of the distribution network, takes into account the different power factors of distributed PVs during the fault, and propose a calculation method for the maximum access capacity of distributed PVs on the premise that distributed PV access does not cause the malfunction of downstream current quick-break protection. The test results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method for calculating the maximum access capacity of distributed PVs, which can prevent the malfunction of current quick-break protection caused by distributed PV access to the distribution network.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Countermeasure Research on Converter Sub-module of High Voltage Large Capacity HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the voltage source converter-type high-voltage DC transmission (VSC-HVDC), as the core of the converter station, the converter is an important link in the transformation of AC & DC transmission, energy transmission and control. The valve control system is an intermediate bridge of the VSC-HVDC control system, which is functionally connected with the pole control protection equipment (PCP) and the converter valve primary equipment. Taking this as the research object, this paper conducts an in-depth analysis and research on the overvoltage bypass fault of the VSC-HVDC valve control system sub-module for the actual problem. First of all, this paper first introduces the modulation method, capacitor voltage balance control strategy and valve control subsystem structure of the modular multilevel converter, which provides a theoretical basis for the subsequent research. Secondly, according to the changes in electrical quantities such as current and voltage after the valve control system fails, an in-depth analysis of the phenomenon, causes and connections of equipment failures is carried out. Then the fault location was determined through the troubleshooting of the fault cause, and the response was proposed. Finally, the phenomenon for similar failures have been verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Power Flow Calculation Method Based on Sample Sequencing Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Distribution system analysis should fully consider the variations of loads and Distributed Energy Resources (DERs). Monte Carlo simulations is an essential tool to represent the impact made by multiple loads/DERs with different types and probabilistic features. However, the computational burden is heavy since the stochastic simulations usually refers to thousands of times. To solve this issue, this paper proposed a method based on optimized sequencing. Through searching strategy of least neighboring sample distance, the simulation sequence is optimized, aiming to reduce the overall iteration times in power flow solutions. A case study on a modified IEEE 13 bus system is carried out, and the proposed method is compared with common Monte Carlo simulation. The results evidenced the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving the computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Control Parameters Optimization Method of Energy Router-Based AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a control parameters optimization method for the energy router-based AC/DC hybrid distribution systems. First, the small signal model of the energy router-based AC/DC hybrid distribution systems consisting of high voltage AC/DC parts, medium voltage part and low voltage AC/DC parts is derived. Second, the influence of system control parameters on the system stability is analyzed. Third, an eigenvalue-based optimization problem is formulated, and a control parameters optimization method based on sensitivity analysis is proposed to optimize the control parameters jointly. Finally, stability assessment and time-domain simulations are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of 500kV Substation Based on Fault Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Substation is the important element in a power grid, its reliability is critical to the secure and stable operation of large power grid. In this paper, the fault tree analysis method in probabilistic risk assessment is used to analyze the power supply reliability of a 500kV substation, taking the insufficient power supply to the 220kV power grid as the undesired event. The fault tree describes the disruption of the transmission of energy from the power supply to the transformer. The fault combinations leading to the undesired event can be obtained by calculating the Minimum Cut Sets (MCSs) of fault tree, and quantitative reliability assessment was carried out by calculating the failure probability of undesired events based on the component reliability model and data. In addition, dominate failure contributions based on component importance measures is adopted for the weak parts identification in substation. Quantitative evaluation of the fault tree, which represents a understanding of the power supply reliability from the 500KV substation to 220kV grid, which can identify the most important components in the substation, and provide a scientific basis for power system planning, equipment reliability s Selection election and maintenance optimization.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Counterattack Lightning Overvoltage of 500 kV Transmission Line Considering Impulse Corona
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the frequent blackouts caused by lightning counterattack on transmission lines, this paper uses the electromagnetic transient simulation program ATP-EMTP to build a lightning strike model of transmission lines considering the impact of impulse corona factors, and carries out simulation analysis on the transient characteristics of lightning overvoltage generated when lightning strikes the top of transmission line tower, and obtains the results of lightning overvoltage at both ends of insulator, top of tower and three-phase conductor The characteristics of over-voltage waveform on lightning protection line are provided for reference.

articleTitle: Automatic Identification Strategy Design for Plug-and-play Functional Modules of Modular Energy Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the “cloud-pipe-edge-terminal” system of Power Internet of Things, as an emerging edge device, modular energy controller is an upgrade to the concentrator and TTU(distribution Transformer supervisory Terminal Unit). In order to meet the automation application requirements of the power information collection system, an automatic identification strategy for the functional modules of modular energy controller was designed to realize the rapid detection and automatic identification of plug-and-play functional modules. This paper briefly introduces the hardware structure design and software structure design of modular energy controllers, focusing on the automatic identification strategy design of functional modules. The automatic identification strategy combines Netlink-based USB hot plug detection and traversal query to improve identification reliability and accuracy. Finally, related functions of automatic identification of the modules were verified, and software performance was tested. The experimental results demonstrate that the automatic identification strategy of functional modules has a high accuracy and can realize rapid and accurate detection of plugging in and unplugging of modules. Compared with the other two mentioned strategies, it has a faster and more stable detection speed. Furthermore, it can run stably for a long time which is longer than 72 hours. The strategy has a low system resources occupation, and its software performance is good.

articleTitle: Research on MMC-UPQC Control Strategy Based on PIMR-RC
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve slow response speed and low compensation accuracy of MMC-UPQC under traditional control, the control command required for compensation on the series and shunt compensator is deduced according to MMC-UPQC mathematical model in this paper. An integrated control strategy based on the combination of proportional integral multiple resonance (PIMR) and repetitive control (RC) is proposed. This control strategy can track the command signals required by the series and shunt compensators without error, thereby improving the compensation capability of MMC-UPQC. At last, the simulation results show that the proposed control strategy in this paper has higher response speed and compensation accuracy under the conditions of load variation /unbalance, power voltage sag /swell as well as harmonics state.

articleTitle: Design and Assessment of Heat Interchanging System within the Local Area
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A heat interchanging system maybe formed among the existing buildings within the local area. Each user in the regional heat interchanging system has independent heat source equipment, which is a self-help and mutual-aid dual effect energy utilization system. In this study, taking two adjacent buildings in the region as the research object, the architecture of regional heat interchanging system is proposed in view of two scenarios, namely, flexible use of existing equipment and new equipment expansion. Moreover, the energy balance analysis model is built to quantitatively analyze the energy-saving effect of the heat interchanging system under the two scenarios. According to the simulation results, the introduction of local heat interchanging between adjacent two buildings results in win-win performance from the energy-saving viewpoint. Especially, by introducing the advanced energy systems (e.g., cogeneration system), the energy-saving potential can be even extended.

articleTitle: Analysis of Start and Stop Control for GE 9E Gas Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the start and stop control system of GE 9E series gas turbine. The main function of the start and stop control system is to control each equipment during the start and stop process of the gas turbine, monitor the status of the equipment in real time, and finally achieve the automatic start and stop of the gas turbine. In order to verify and improve the control effect, this paper also establishes the simulation model of gas turbine start and stop control system, and transplants the start and stop control strategy on Xinhua NetPAC control platform, making a good reference value for future gas turbine research.

articleTitle: DC Fault Detection Method for DC Grids Based on Frequency Domain Voltage Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Fast and selective DC fault detection and location schemes are needed for fault protection of DC Grids. In this paper, the frequency domain characteristics of DC voltage besides the current limiting reactors are analyzed and used to put forward a new fault detection method for DC grids. Hilbert-Huang transform is applied on the DC voltage waves to extract the transient frequency and transient amplitude of the DC voltage. The influence of fault type, fault distance and fault resistance of DC faults and the noise on the frequency domain transient characteristics on voltage waves are then studied. Support vector machine learns the mapping between the transient frequency and transient amplitude of the DC voltage and desired outputs, fault type and fault location through training process. Then, a fast and accurate fault detection scheme based on frequency-domain characteristics of DC voltage is proposed by SVM for DC fault detection and location in MTDC systems. This fault detection scheme requires no telecommunication, has anti-interference ability and good sensitivity and selectivity for detection of long-distance fault and high resistance grounding fault. Based on the four-terminal HVDC system built by PSCAD/EMTDC, simulations under different fault conditions are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed DC fault detection scheme.

articleTitle: Innovation and Practice of Transformer Test Transfer Box
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power transformer is the hub of power transmission in power network. Routine state maintenance test is an important link in the operation and maintenance of power equipment, and it is one of the effective means to ensure the safe operation of power system. In this paper, a transformer test adapter box is designed to be used in the current routine test of transformer status maintenance in substation, which needs to be climbed many times in high altitude operation. This innovative method can realize the test wiring of changing working surface. The staff only need to complete the wiring and disconnection work once on the transformer. This reduces the potential safety hazards caused by climbing transformers in several high-altitude operations, shortens the test time and improves the work efficiency. An example shows that this method has high accuracy and reliability. The application of this result has great economic and social benefits in saving human resources costs, enhancing the accuracy of test data, saving time costs, reducing planned power outage losses, reducing equipment losses, strengthening the security of power network operation, and improving the quality of operation and maintenance management.

articleTitle: Circulating Current Suppression Strategy Based on Repetitive Control in Modular Multilevel Converter with Battery Energy Storages System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The circulating current in MMC-BESS can't be avoided although battery storage units are added to the MMC to solve the absorption problem in the process of new energy grid connection. The harmonic components of circulating current will introduce extra power loss, increase current stress of power devices, and even cause instability during transients.
