A new composite circulating current control structure based on the repetitive controller is proposed in this paper to suppress the harmonics of circulating current well and have good dynamic response performance. The causes of circulating current and the principle of repetitive control are first analyzed in this paper. Considering the integral and multi-resonant function of the repetitive controller, a proportional controller is added to correct negative proportion item of the repetitive controller. In order to improve the dynamic response performance of the system, the deadbeat control is in series with the controller mentioned above. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control structure is proved by the designing the controller and simulation.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting Regional Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With large scale wind power integration, the influence of wind power with intermittence and randomness to power grid becomes more and more serious. Improving the accuracy of wind power prediction becomes a key technical to ensure the safe power grid operation with large scale wind power. In this paper, the method of regional wind power prediction is presented. The representative wind farms is selected according to the climate, terrain, landform and the operation conditions of the wind farms, then the regional wind power is calculated by the Nelder-Mead method. The simulation results demonstrate that the regional wind power prediction method improves wind power prediction accuracy effectively compared to traditional methods and is of great value to power grid accommodating large scale wind power.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Metering Chips for Smart Meters Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the smart grid has basically achieved nationwide coverage. Smart meter as the terminal of smart grid, its selection for smart grid construction has become a very important part. As the core component of smart meter, there is no unified selection standard for energy metering chip. Based on this, this paper proposes a power metering chip selection scheme based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Through the comparative analysis of ADE7752A, ATM90E36A, ATT7022EU, RN8302 and BL6513C, the performance of each chip is scored, and the weight distribution of clock frequency, ADC bits, sampling frequency and harmonic measurement is carried out by AHP, and the total score is finally calculated. The analysis results show that the ADC bits and sampling frequency of the metering chip have great influence on the chip selection, and the performance of the chip ADE7752A is the best through the evaluation function.

articleTitle: Prediction of Gearbox Oil Temperature of Wind Turbine Based on GRNN-LSTM Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The gearbox oil temperature of offshore wind turbines(WTS) is one of the important indexes of gearbox state monitoring and fault warning. Accurately predicting the change trend of gearbox oil temperature can improve the reliability of the unit and reduce operation and maintenance costs. In order to improve the accuracy of oil temperature prediction, This paper proposes a prediction model based on long short-term memory(LSTM)- generalized regression neural network(GRNN) weighted combination. From the perspective of the short-term, mid-term and long-term prediction performance of the model, this article first compares the model with GRNN and LSTM two single models, and then compares with other combined models. Through comparison, it is found that the combined model can effectively combine the good mid- and long-term prediction ability of the LSTM algorithm with the good short-term prediction ability of the GRNN algorithm, which greatly improves the accuracy and stability of oil temperature prediction.

articleTitle: An Improved Weighted Gray Correlation Method for Dissolved Gas in Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Transformer fault diagnosis is very important to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system. This paper proposes a gray correlation analysis method that uses entropy method to assign weight values, and explains the basic principle of this improved gray correlation algorithm. This method can improve the reliability and accuracy of gray correlation analysis, and reduce the error caused by system interference. And using hydrogen, methane, acetylene, ethane and ethylene as the characteristic parameters of the decomposition gas in several oils to verify the actual diagnosis effect of the new model.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Reasons of Turbine Oil Discoloration and Evaluation of Remaining Service Life
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Regarding the discoloration of turbine oil in a power plant, the reasons of discoloration and the remaining service life of the oil were analyzed through acid value testing, infrared and emission spectroscopy. The results showed that no obvious oxidation products appeared in the oil, and the acid value was in the acceptable range. Whereas the remaining content of the antioxidant in the oil was only about 22%, which was already on the verge of danger to use. The results of accelerated aging test showed that the remaining service life of the operating oil was about 15.4%, and the service life was less than one year. If the oil continued to be used, it was recommended to closely follow the changes in oil quality and regularly test whether the acid value was within the acceptable range.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization and Adjustment of Gas Turbine Combustion Based on XGBoost and NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the lack of experience in the combustion adjustment of gas turbines in China, a model of gas turbine combustion optimization is proposed, which can ensure that the gas turbine runs in a safe and stable area with low NOx emission. Based on the real-time operating data of the gas turbine, the NOx emission and pressure fluctuation prediction models of XGBoost are established respectively. In order to make the prediction model more accurate, the Bayesian optimization algorithm is used to optimize the model parameters of XGBoost; then NSGA-II optimization algorithm is used to solve the combustion optimization problem of gas turbine, so as to obtain the Pareto solution set of the gas turbine running in a safe, stable and low-emission environment. The experimental results show that the XGBoost combined with the NSGA-II optimization model is used for multi-objective optimization of gas turbine combustion optimization problem. The optimal operating parameter setting combination obtained from Pareto solution concentration has certain reference significance for the stable operation of gas turbine and reducing NOx emission, and accumulated experience for domestic combustion adjustment technology.
